text_mt: Because secondary qualities are connected with the origination sentence, there is direct scriptural statement of the cause; therefore, Soma must be the primary element.
And likewise there is indication of another purpose.
Sequential order is characterized by direct scriptural statement, because that is authoritative.
Or it should be regulated by order, because in the oneness of the sacrificial rite, it is a quality thereof.
If it is objected that this is non-textual, [we reply] it would be so, because the text consists of sentences.

sanskrit_iast: arthakṛte vānumānaṃ syāt kratvekatve parārthatvāt svena tv arthena sambandhas tasmāt svaśabdam ucyeta /
meaning: अर्थकृते वानुमानं स्यात् क्रत्वेकत्वे परार्थत्वात् स्वेन त्व् अर्थेन सम्बन्धस् तस्मात् स्वशब्दम् उच्येत /
text_mt: Or where it is effected by purpose, there would be inference, because in the oneness of the rite it serves another; but its connection is with its own purpose; therefore, it should be stated by its own word.
And likewise there is indication of another purpose.
[Order is determined] by performance in the case of secondary qualities belonging to the same time, because of starting with that.
If it is argued that it is like another sacrificial rite—
And from relative textual position, because of connection with origination.
Or [order] of subsidiary elements follows the order of the principal rite, because they serve its purpose.
In the archetypal sacrifice, however, because of its own explicit word, it would be understood according to the sequence.

sanskrit_iast: mantratas tu virodhe syāt prayogarūpasāmarthyāt tasmād utpattideśaḥ saḥ /
meaning: मन्त्रतस् तु विरोधे स्यात् प्रयोगरूपसामर्थ्यात् तस्माद् उत्पत्तिदेशः सः /
text_mt: In case of conflict, however, it follows the Vedic recitation, because of the capacity of the form of performance; therefore, that is the place of origination.
In the ectypal sacrifice, because of that statement, it should follow the principal rite.
Or in case of conflict, it should be as in the archetypal sacrifice, because of following the archetype.

sanskrit_iast: vikṛtiḥ prakṛtidharmatvāt tatkālā syād yathā śiṣṭam /
meaning: विकृतिः प्रकृतिधर्मत्वात् तत्काला स्याद् यथा शिष्टम् /
text_mt: The ectypal sacrifice, because of sharing the properties of the archetypal sacrifice, should share its time, as instructed.

sanskrit_iast: api vā kramakālasaṃyuktā sadyaḥ kriyeta tatra vidher anumānāt prakṛtidharmalopaḥ syāt /
meaning: अपि वा क्रमकालसंयुक्ता सद्यः क्रियेत तत्र विधेर् अनुमानात् प्रकृतिधर्मलोपः स्यात् /
text_mt: Or rather, being connected with order and time, it should be performed immediately on the same day; because of inferring an injunctive rule there, there would be loss of the properties of the archetypal sacrifice.
Because subsidiary elements share the time of the principal rite, upon postponement it would be as stated.
Or, because of connection, beginning with that and ending with that, upon advancement [it would be similarly adjusted].
and because of non-contradiction of verbal testimony.

sanskrit_iast: asaṃyogāt tu vaikṛtaṃ tad eva pratikṛṣyeta.
meaning: असंयोगात् तु वैकृतं तद् एव प्रतिकृष्येत.
text_mt: Due to non-connection, however, that ectypal element alone should be advanced.
And an incidental element should not be postponed, due to non-connection.
The Sāntapanīyā oblation, however, should defer the Agnihotra, just as in the case of the pressing of Soma, because of ritual defect.
However, there should be no deferral, because of the absence of a connection.
And because the occasioning condition has occurred.
The deferral of the pressing is due to a direct connection.
And the Ṣoḍaśin cup [is deferred] on account of its connection with the Ukthya.

sanskrit_iast: sannipāte prādhānānām ekaikasya guṇānāṃ sarvakarma syāt /
meaning: सन्निपाते प्राधानानाम् एकैकस्य गुणानां सर्वकर्म स्यात् /
text_mt: When principal rites concur, all operations of the subsidiaries should be performed for each one [in turn].
Or rather, [each operation should be performed] of one identical type for all [together], because an order has been established.
And with regard to the handfuls, the potsherds, the cut portions, anointing, smearing, shaving, and purifying, [the action is performed] with one [at a time].
However, all [should be performed together], because they serve a single purpose, and because these are subsidiary qualities to that [purpose].

sanskrit_iast: saṃyukte tu prakramāt tadaṅgaṃ syād itarasya tadarthatvāt /
meaning: संयुक्ते तु प्रक्रमात् तदङ्गं स्याद् इतरस्य तदर्थत्वात् /
text_mt: When, however, it is connected [to another item], that should be its subsidiary by virtue of commencement, because the other serves its purpose.
By virtue of direct scriptural statement, however, the anointing and subsequent acts should extend up to the girding.
There may be no interruption, or it may happen on account of a specific cause, just like the increase of vessels.
Or rather not, because it is caused by the Vedic text; the other is a mere analogy, while the multiplication of vessels is due to purpose.
In a group of sacrificial animals, one should finish [the acts] for each respective animal, because the animal is a single unit.
Or rather, [they should be performed together] on account of the recipient deities, because the sacrificial action is one.
And because the Vedic recitation has a purposeful meaning.
When there are different seeds, there should be a single mortar, on account of its capacity.
Or there should be an increase [of mortars], because the order is regulated, since it serves that purpose.
Or there should be one [mortar], because of the generation of rice grains, since striking serves that purpose.

meaning: विकारे त्व् अनूयाजानां पात्रभेदो ऽर्थभेदात् स्यात् /
text_mt: In a modified rite of the after-offerings, however, there should be a distinction of vessels, on account of the distinction of purpose.

sanskrit_iast: prakṛteḥ pūrvoktatvād apūrvam ante syān na hy acoditasya śeṣāmnānam /
meaning: प्रकृतेः पूर्वोक्तत्वाद् अपूर्वम् अन्ते स्यान् न ह्य् अचोदितस्य शेषाम्नानम् /
text_mt: Because the archetypal sacrifice is stated first, the non-archetypal element should come at the end; for the mention of a subsidiary does not belong to what has not been enjoined.

sanskrit_iast: mukhyānantaryamātreyas tena tulyaśrutitvād aśabdatvāt prākṛtānāṃ vyavāyaḥ syāt /
meaning: मुख्यानन्तर्यमात्रेयस् तेन तुल्यश्रुतित्वाद् अशब्दत्वात् प्राकृतानां व्यवायः स्यात् /
text_mt: Ātreya holds that it must immediately succeed the primary rite; since it has equal direct scriptural statement with it, and because they are not directly declared, there would be an intervention of the archetypal elements.
Bādarāyaṇa, however, holds that it comes at the end, because those [archetypal elements] are expressed by words designating the principal rite.
And likewise there is textual evidence for another purpose.

sanskrit_iast: kṛtadeśāt tu pūrveṣāṃ sa deśaḥ syāt tena pratyakṣasaṃyogān nayāyamātramitarat /
meaning: कृतदेशात् तु पूर्वेषां स देशः स्यात् तेन प्रत्यक्षसंयोगान् नयायमात्रमितरत् /
text_mt: However, that should be the place of the preceding elements from their appointed place; by that there is a direct connection, whereas the other is a mere deduction.
And whatever precedes the archetypal rite [remains so].
If there is a concurrence, it should be at the end, as previously stated.
An addition, on account of difference of actions, would be taught for each respective item, like the clotted butter.
Or rather, because it is an all-inclusive number, a modification should be understood.
However, they should increase from their own relative textual position, because the sequence has already been established.

sanskrit_iast: samidhyamānavatīṃ samiddhavatīṃ cāntareṇa dhāyyāḥ syur dyāvāpṛthiñyorantarālaṃ samarhaṇāt /
meaning: समिध्यमानवतीं समिद्धवतीं चान्तरेण धाय्याः स्युर् द्यावापृथिञ्योरन्तरालं समर्हणात् /
text_mt: The Dhāyyā verses should be between the verse containing the word 'being kindled' and the verse containing 'kindled', because of their appropriateness in the space between heaven and earth.
Because of the observation [of them] at the end of the Uṣṇih and Kakubh metres.

sanskrit_iast: stomavivṛddhau vahiṣpavamāne purastāt paryāsād āgantavaḥ syus tathā hi dṛṣṭaṃ dvādaśāhe /
meaning: स्तोमविवृद्धौ वहिष्पवमाने पुरस्तात् पर्यासाद् आगन्तवः स्युस् तथा हि दृष्टं द्वादशाहे /
text_mt: When there is an increase of the Stoma in the Bahiṣpavamāna hymn, the adventitious verses should be inserted before the final triplet; for so it is seen in the Twelve-Day rite.
Even if it were a modification of it, it would be [at the end] on account of being an unprecedented insertion.
However, one should place them at the end of the two subsequent verses.
Or rather, in the Gāyatrī, Bṛhatī, and Anuṣṭubh metres, by virtue of direct scriptural statement.
The bricks relating to the cups and those of the supplementary section should be considered subsidiaries of the layer of the Soma-pressing.
Or rather, they are subsidiaries of the sacrificial rite and the fire-altar, because they are enjoined, whereas their sequence is not enjoined.
In the middle layer, however, the bricks accompanied by Brāhmaṇa passages [are placed], by virtue of direct scriptural statement.
[They are placed] prior to the space-filling brick, because that brick serves the purpose of completing [the layer].
The ritual act takes place when [the altar] is consecrated, because preparatory purifications serve that purpose.
The observances immediately follow, because they pertain to that.
And [they come] before, because an indicative textual mark is observed.
Or it is a corroborative statement, because the real purpose is present.
And because there would be a conflict with the guiding principle.

sanskrit_iast: sañcite tv agnicid yuktaṃ prāpaṇān nimittasya /
meaning: सञ्चिते त्व् अग्निचिद् युक्तं प्रापणान् निमित्तस्य /
text_mt: When it is piled, however, the term 'one who has piled the fire-altar' is appropriate, because the occasioning condition has occurred.
Or [it takes place] at the end of the sacrificial rite, because of the absence of an injunctive rule of performance.
Because the fire-altar is designated as an action.
By virtue of the announcement at the end, one becomes consecrated, because of connection with all the consecrations.
Or they are at the end of the Iṣṭi, because they are intended for that, since their connection with the purpose is without distinction.
The order of succession among the sacrificial rites is like that among the subsidiary elements.
It could be [meaningful] for the purpose of instruction, as in the case of subsequent [rites] on account of the Sarvasvāra sacrifice.
[The phrase] 'who [sacrifices] with this' refers to the Agniṣṭoma, on account of the context of the ritual topic.
[In the phrase] 'then with another', [the reference is] to the ritual forms, on account of their proximity.
Or [the passage refers to] its base paradigm, because alteration and dispersal are not possible among equal rites.
And [it is a eulogy], because there is an absence of dispersal.

sanskrit_iast: vidhipratyayād vā na hy akasmāt praśaṃsā syāt /
meaning: विधिप्रत्ययाद् वा न ह्य् अकस्मात् प्रशंसा स्यात् /
text_mt: Or it is an injunctive cognition; for commendation cannot arise without a cause.
Or [the reference is] to a single Stoma, on account of its connection with the sacrificial rite.
Or rather, the commendation applies to all Stomas, because the injunction is not differentiated.
The subversion of sequence is determined by purpose and word, because direct scriptural statement is distinctive and because purpose is primary.
In the cutting, sprinkling, and placing [of oblations], the order of succession should be determined by performance.
Or according to the presentation, because they are intended for that.
The priority of the Iṣṭi is on account of direct statement.

sanskrit_iast: somaś caikeṣām agnayādheyasyartunakṣatrātikramavacanāt tadantenānarthakaṃ hi syāt /
meaning: सोमश् चैकेषाम् अग्नयाधेयस्यर्तुनक्षत्रातिक्रमवचनात् तदन्तेनानर्थकं हि स्यात् /
text_mt: And Soma [is prior] according to some, because of the statement regarding transgreßing the season and asterism of fire-installation; for otherwise it would be meaningless if ending with that [Iṣṭi].
And because of the statement of purpose, [the installation] does not serve that purpose without distinction.

sanskrit_iast: ayakṣyamāṇasya ca pavamānahaviṣāṃ kālanirdeśād ānantaryād viśaṅkā syāt /
meaning: अयक्ष्यमाणस्य च पवमानहविषां कालनिर्देशाद् आनन्तर्याद् विशङ्का स्यात् /
text_mt: And regarding one who is not going to sacrifice, a doubt might arise due to proximity, because of the designation of time for the Pavamāna offerings.
The Iṣṭi is for one who will not sacrifice [with Soma]; when it is for that purpose, Soma does not come first.
On account of deferment, Soma would be [performed first] for a Brāhmaṇa.
Or rather, the Full-Moon sacrifice [is first], on account of direct scriptural connection.
Or [it is prior] because everything constitutes a single ritual action.
Or there may be an injunctive rule based on that purpose.
However, the time is determined by the context of the ritual topic.
It should take place at its own time, because there is no contradiction.
Or there is a displacement of the fire-installation, because it has all times [permitted].
The Full-Moon sacrifice is after Soma for a Brāhmaṇa, on account of direct statement.
Or it is a single [sacrifice], by the force of the word; the whole [procedure] is enjoined beforehand.
The sacrificial cake, however, [is used] in the absence of specification, because there is no recipient deity connected with that [alternative material].
No, because it has mixed deities, as in the case of the offering to Indra-Agni.

sanskrit_iast: vikṛteḥ prakṛtikālatvāt sadyaskālottarā vikṛtis tayoḥ pratyakṣaśiṣṭatvāt /
meaning: विकृतेः प्रकृतिकालत्वात् सद्यस्कालोत्तरा विकृतिस् तयोः प्रत्यक्षशिष्टत्वात् /
text_mt: Because the modified rite shares the time of the base paradigm, the modified rite that is completed in one day takes place later, because those two are taught by direct perception.
In the case of a two-day duration, however, it proceeds according to the standard principle.
Or there could be a single time, on account of direct statement.
The modifications of the Sānnāyya and the Agnīṣomīya are performed after Soma, just like the base paradigm.
Likewise, the modifications of Soma are performed after the New- and Full-Moon sacrifices.
When substances are connected with an action, their connection is as subordinate elements.
But it cannot be accomplished [alone], because it is meant for that purpose.

sanskrit_iast: pratyarthaṃ cābhisaṃyogātkarmato hy abhisambandhas tasmāt karmopadeśaḥ syāt /
meaning: प्रत्यर्थं चाभिसंयोगात्कर्मतो ह्य् अभिसम्बन्धस् तस्मात् कर्मोपदेशः स्यात् /
text_mt: And because there is connection with each purpose, the relation is indeed through action; therefore, there should be an instruction regarding action.
Because action is for the sake of the fruit, the scripture should confer ritual eligibility upon all.

sanskrit_iast: kartur vā śrutisaṃyogād vidhiḥ kārtsnyena gamyate /
meaning: कर्तुर् वा श्रुतिसंयोगाद् विधिः कार्त्स्न्येन गम्यते /
text_mt: Or rather, because the performer has a direct scriptural connection, the injunctive rule is understood in its entirety.
Aitiśāyana holds that [the injunction] applies to men, because of the specific mention of masculine gender.
And because that is spoken of, a scriptural defect is heard in the case of one unknown.

sanskrit_iast: jātiṃ tu bādarāyaṇo 'viśeṣāt tasmāt stry api pratīyeta jātyarthasyāviśiṣṭatvāt /
meaning: जातिं तु बादरायणो ऽविशेषात् तस्मात् स्त्र्य् अपि प्रतीयेत जात्यर्थस्याविशिष्टत्वात् /
text_mt: Bādarāyaṇa, however, holds that it refers to the class, because there is no distinction; therefore, a woman too should be understood [as eligible], because the meaning of the class is non-specific.
Because it is enjoined according to direct scriptural statement.

sanskrit_iast: dravyavattvāt tu puṃsāṃ syād dravyasaṃyuktaṃ krayavikrayābhyām adravyatvaṃ strīṇāṃ dravyaiḥ samānayogitvāt /
meaning: द्रव्यवत्त्वात् तु पुंसां स्याद् द्रव्यसंयुक्तं क्रयविक्रयाभ्याम् अद्रव्यत्वं स्त्रीणां द्रव्यैः समानयोगित्वात् /
text_mt: However, men possess wealth; that which involves wealth is through buying and selling; women do not possess wealth, because they are treated as equal to wealth.
And likewise, there is the observation of another meaning.
Action serves that purpose because [a woman] serves that purpose.
And because she is inherently connected with the purpose.
Purchase is a mere formality.
Scripture also reveals ownership [by women].
Because both possess ownership, a single unified action should be performed on account of direct statement.
Ownership, however, is spoken of figuratively on account of being bought.
Ownership, however, is connected because of the desire for fruits.
And scripture reveals the possession of fruit.
And the establishment [of fires] belongs to two, like the sacrifice of two.

sanskrit_iast: guṇasya tu vidhānatvāt patnyā dvitīyaśabdaḥ syāt /
meaning: गुणस्य तु विधानत्वात् पत्न्या द्वितीयशब्दः स्यात् /
text_mt: Because it is an injunction of a secondary element, the word for the second refers to the wife.
For her, only what is expressly stated [applies], such as the benediction and celibacy, because they are not identical.
[Ritual eligibility belongs to] all four social classes, because there is no distinction.

sanskrit_iast: nirdeśād vā trayāṇāṃ syād agnyādheye 'sambandhaḥ kratuṣu brāhmaṇaśruter ity ātreyaḥ /
meaning: निर्देशाद् वा त्रयाणां स्याद् अग्न्याधेये ऽसम्बन्धः क्रतुषु ब्राह्मणश्रुतेर् इत्य् आत्रेयः /
text_mt: Or rather, by virtue of specific mention, it belongs to the three; there is no connection [for the fourth] in the establishment of the fires, and in sacrifices on account of the scriptural mention of the brāhmaṇa, so Ātreya holds.

sanskrit_iast: nimittārthe na bādaris tasmāt sarvādhikāraṃ syāt /
meaning: निमित्तार्थे न बादरिस् तस्मात् सर्वाधिकारं स्यात् /
text_mt: Bādari [holds that] it is for the sake of the occasion, and therefore there is eligibility for all.
Or rather, because another purpose is seen, it must be understood according to the direct scriptural statement.
And in the preparatory purification, because that is primary.
Or rather, on account of the mention of Vedic study, [eligibility] should be understood as excluding Śūdras.
[we reply:] because the preparatory purification serves that purpose, the scriptural mention of the person applies to knowledge.
If it is objected that it is not so, because knowledge is specified,
[we reply that] on account of lack of Vedic learning, there would be absence in the rite.
And likewise, there is an indication of another meaning.
Of the three, [only one] endowed with wealth [has eligibility], because rites are accomplished with substance.

sanskrit_iast: anityatvāt tu naivaṃ syād arthād dhi dravyasaṃyogaḥ /
meaning: अनित्यत्वात् तु नैवं स्याद् अर्थाद् धि द्रव्यसंयोगः /
text_mt: But it would not be so, because [wealth] is non-permanent; for the connection with substance arises from the need of the purpose.
And one deficient in limbs shares the same property.
Because at origination there is a constant connection.
There would be the exclusion of one who lacks three ancestral sages.
By virtue of explicit statement, [eligibility] belongs to the chariot-maker in the establishment of fires, because this is subsidiary to all.
Or it is proper [to consider him a Śūdra] on account of connection with the action, since the Śūdra has been prohibited.
But it cannot be so, because it is not that action.
And there would be purposelessness of the connection.
The Saudhanvanas, however, because of distinctness, should be understood from the wording of the mantra.
The 'lord of charioteers' must be a Niṣāda, by the force of the word.
Because each serves a single human purpose, the ritual eligibility must belong to each [person individually].

sanskrit_iast: api cotpattisaṃyogo yathā syāt satvadaryaśanaṃ tathābhāvo vibhāge syāt /
meaning: अपि चोत्पत्तिसंयोगो यथा स्यात् सत्वदर्यशनं तथाभावो विभागे स्यात् /
text_mt: Moreover, just as there is connection at origination, so that there is eating by a virtuous man, so also in division there must be the same status.
Since there is scriptural mention of the person in the performance, one would act according to desire in the performance.
If it is objected that the scriptural statement applies to each separate purpose,

meaning: तादर्थ्ये न गुणार्थतानुक्ते ऽर्थान्तरत्वात् कर्तुः प्रधानभूतत्वात् /
text_mt: [we reply:] When that is the purpose, there is no serving a subordinate quality; when unexpressed, it is another purpose, because the agent is primary.

sanskrit_iast: api vā kāmasaṃyoge sambandhāt prayogāyopadiśyeta pratyarthaṃ hi vidhiśrutir viṣāṇāvat /
meaning: अपि वा कामसंयोगे सम्बन्धात् प्रयोगायोपदिश्येत प्रत्यर्थं हि विधिश्रुतिर् विषाणावत् /
text_mt: Or rather, in connection with desire, it would be taught for performance because of the relation; for the injunctive rule is heard for each purpose, like the horn.
[we reply:] there is a connection with another purpose.
If it is objected that the desire for the fruit is the occasion,
However, by beginning, it becomes restricted, because commencement is the occasion for the action.
Or, because one desires the fruit, there is no restriction, just as before commencing.

sanskrit_iast: niyamo vā tannimittatvāt kartus tatkāraṇaṃ syāt /
meaning: नियमो वा तन्निमित्तत्वात् कर्तुस् तत्कारणं स्यात् /
text_mt: Or there is a restriction, because it is caused by that; that must be the cause for the agent.
Worldly actions are like the Vedic; from them arises the knowledge concerning the person.
And even in case of transgression, the scripture applies by means of them.

sanskrit_iast: aśāstrāt tūpasamprāptiḥ śāstraṃ syān na prakalpakaṃ tasmād arthena gamyetāprāpte śāstram arthavat /
meaning: अशास्त्रात् तूपसम्प्राप्तिः शास्त्रं स्यान् न प्रकल्पकं तस्माद् अर्थेन गम्येताप्राप्ते शास्त्रम् अर्थवत् /
text_mt: From non-scriptural sources, however, comes attainment; the scripture cannot create anew; therefore it must be understood according to the purpose; when unobtained, the scripture is purposeful.

sanskrit_iast: pratiṣedheṣv akarmatvāt kriyā syāt pratiṣiddhānāṃ vibhaktatvād akarmaṇām /
meaning: प्रतिषेधेष्व् अकर्मत्वात् क्रिया स्यात् प्रतिषिद्धानां विभक्तत्वाद् अकर्मणाम् /
text_mt: In prohibitions, because there is non-action, there would be action of prohibited things, because non-actions are distinct.

sanskrit_iast:
śāstrāṇāṃ tv arthavatvena puruṣārtho vidhīyate tayor
asamavāyitvāt tādarthye vidhyatikramaḥ /
meaning:
शास्त्राणां त्व् अर्थवत्वेन पुरुषार्थो विधीयते तयोर्
असमवायित्वात् तादर्थ्ये विध्यतिक्रमः /
text_mt: Because scriptures are purposeful, the human purpose is enjoined; because the two are not co-inherent, in serving that purpose there is transgression of the injunctive rule.
Those being taught in it would proceed by birth.
Or rather, because it is equal to the Veda, they would proceed by means.
Repetition is enjoined as serving the human purpose, because it is not subsidiary to an action.
When that is impossible, it follows from the purpose.
They are not taught in relation to times.
Because of the observation of indicative marks of time, there is an injunction of time.
Because they are primordial, one must proceed by traditional transmission.
For thus an indicative mark is seen.
Likewise are those employed within the sacrificial rite.
In the case of [practices] known from traditional conduct, it would be so, because they serve human purposes.
For a Brāhmaṇa, however, soma, learning, and offspring [are obligatory], because of the connection with the statement on debts.
Action would take place only when there is full capability, because [the sacrifice] is taught as possessing all [its factors].

sanskrit_iast: api vāpy ekadeśe syāt pradhāne hy arthanirvṛttir guṇamātram itarat tadarthatvāt /
meaning: अपि वाप्य् एकदेशे स्यात् प्रधाने ह्य् अर्थनिर्वृत्तिर् गुणमात्रम् इतरत् तदर्थत्वात् /
text_mt: Or rather, [action] should take place even partially; for the accomplishment of the purpose lies in the principal rite, whereas the other is merely a subsidiary quality, since it is for the sake of that [principal].

sanskrit_iast: tadakarmaṇi ca doṣas tasmāt tato viśeṣaḥ syāt pradhānenābhisambandhāt /
meaning: तदकर्मणि च दोषस् तस्मात् ततो विशेषः स्यात् प्रधानेनाभिसम्बन्धात् /
text_mt: And fault arises from non-performance of that [obligatory rite]; therefore, there is a distinction regarding that [principal rite], because of its direct connection with the fruit.

sanskrit_iast: karmābhedaṃ tu jaiminiḥ prayogavacanaikatvāt sarveṣām upadeśaḥ syād iti /
meaning: कर्माभेदं तु जैमिनिः प्रयोगवचनैकत्वात् सर्वेषाम् उपदेशः स्याद् इति /
text_mt: Jaimini, however, [holds that there is] no difference in the action, because the injunctive statement of performance is one, so that the instruction applies to all [elements].

sanskrit_iast: arthasya vyapavargitvād ekasyāpi prayoge syād yathā kratvantareṣu /
meaning: अर्थस्य व्यपवर्गित्वाद् एकस्यापि प्रयोगे स्याद् यथा क्रत्वन्तरेषु /
text_mt: Because the beneficial purpose terminates [with completion], [the title to perform] would apply even to a single performance, as in other sacrificial rites.
And because completion is seen even upon a transgression of an injunctive rule;
And because of the prescription of expiation;
And in the case of optional rites it would be so, because [one acts] from desire.

sanskrit_iast: asaṃyogāt tu naivaṃ syād vidheḥ śabdapramāṇatvāt /
meaning: असंयोगात् तु नैवं स्याद् विधेः शब्दप्रमाणत्वात् /
text_mt: But it would not be so [in optional rites], because of the absence of connection [with an injunction to perform unconditionally], since an injunctive rule has verbal testimony as its means of valid cognition;
And because there is no transgression upon non-performance.
Because actions depend [on substances], there would be a division [of identity] upon a different substance.

sanskrit_iast: api vāvyatirekād rūpaśabdāvibhāgāc ca gotvavad aikakarmyaṃ syān nāmadheyaṃ ca sattvavat /
meaning: अपि वाव्यतिरेकाद् रूपशब्दाविभागाच् च गोत्ववद् ऐककर्म्यं स्यान् नामधेयं च सत्त्ववत् /
text_mt: Or rather, because there is no difference and no distinction in form and word, there would be identity of action, like cowness; and the proper ritual designation is like [the name of] a concrete entity.
And because direct scriptural statement is the means of valid cognition, upon the absence of the prescribed [substance] there can be no introduction of another, because it is unprescribed;
Or rather, there should be introduction [of a substitute], because there is no difference in the purpose of the injunction.
The prescription in a certain instance is for the sake of a restrictive injunction.
That [prescribed substance] is obligatory, for the desire to perform pertains to that.
There is no [substitution] of recipient deity, fire, word, or action, because they are connected with a different purpose.
And in the case of the recipient deity, because [the sacrifice] is for its sake.
And [substitution of these] is prohibited; for its direct scriptural statement is without qualification.
Likewise [there is no substitution] of the ritual patron, because the fruit inheres in him, and the fruit is connected with the action.
When many [patrons] are engaged, however, one should bring in another, to avoid deficiency.
Or rather, [he is] a hired labourer, because he is paid;
And because the fruit is seen in that [original patron].
He should have his duties, because of connection with the action.
There is similarity, for the desire is to perform that [same action].
In the case of an option, however, that which has commenced [is continued], because of specification.

sanskrit_iast: vacanāc cānyāyyam abhāve tatsāmānyena pratinidhir abhāvād itarasya /
meaning: वचनाच् चान्याय्यम् अभावे तत्सामान्येन प्रतिनिधिर् अभावाद् इतरस्य /
text_mt: And by scriptural statement, [it is] improper; upon absence [of the prescribed], a substitute [is adopted] through similarity to it, because of the absence of the other.
Not in the case of a substitute, because they are equal.
It could be so in the case of that characterized by direct scriptural statement, because of restrictiveness.
Upon procuring the primary [substance], the primary [must be used]; for the introduction [of a substitute was only] because of its absence.
When there is conflict between substance and preparatory purification, the substance [prevails], because [the purification] is for its sake.

meaning: अर्थद्रव्यविरोधे ऽर्थो द्रव्याभावे तदुत्पत्तेर् द्रव्याणाम् अर्थशेषत्वात् /
text_mt: When there is conflict between purpose and substance, the purpose [prevails], because upon the absence of the substance it is produced [by another], since substances are subsidiary to the purpose.
The injunctive rule would apply even to a single portion.

sanskrit_iast: api vārthasya śakyatvād ekadeśena nirvartetārthānām avibhaktatvād guṇamātram itarat tadarthatvāt /
meaning: अपि वार्थस्य शक्यत्वाद् एकदेशेन निर्वर्तेतार्थानाम् अविभक्तत्वाद् गुणमात्रम् इतरत् तदर्थत्वात् /
text_mt: Or rather, because the purpose is feasible, it should be accomplished with a single portion, since purposes are undivided; the other is merely a subsidiary quality, because it is for the sake of that.
Upon destruction of the two cuttings, it should be from the remainder, because it is for that purpose.
Or because of specific mention, one should bring in another [substance].
Or rather, [the remaining rites] should belong to those entitled to the remainder, because they are the distinct cause.
Because of specific mention, the eating of the remainder is by others, as in the principal rite.
Or it should be by all, because of co-inherence.
The specific mention is for the sake of a subsidiary quality.
In the principal rite, it is characterized by direct scriptural statement.
Because the purpose inheres [in it], an expiation [is required] even upon [the destruction of] a part.

sanskrit_iast: na tv aśeṣe vaiguṇyāt tadarthaṃ hi /
meaning: न त्व् अशेषे वैगुण्यात् तदर्थं हि /
text_mt: Not, however, when none is left, because of deficiency; for it is for that purpose.

sanskrit_iast: syād vā prāptanimittatvād ataddharmo nityasaṃyogān na hitasya guṇārthenānityatvāt /
meaning: स्याद् वा प्राप्तनिमित्तत्वाद् अतद्धर्मो नित्यसंयोगान् न हितस्य गुणार्थेनानित्यत्वात् /
text_mt: Or rather, it would be [applicable], because the occasion has arisen; it does not share that duty, because of connection with what is permanent, not of that which is beneficial, since it is impermanent through being for a secondary quality.

sanskrit_iast: guṇānāṃ ca parārthatvād vacanād vyapāśraya syāt /
meaning: गुणानां च परार्थत्वाद् वचनाद् व्यपाश्रय स्यात् /
text_mt: And because subsidiary qualities are for the sake of another, the recourse would be on account of scriptural statement.
And upon the destruction of all, it would be purposeless.
In the case of scorching, however, [the expiation] applies upon total burning, because a partial [burning] is unavoidable.
Or rather, [the performance should be completed] with another [substance], because the occasion [for substitution] is obtained from scripture.
If it is objected that it is not so, because of the word 'sacrificial offering' [applied to it],

[the reply is:] it can be so; for since [the other course] is illogical, the word 'sacrificial offering' refers to what goes into the sacrifice, because of its connection with that indicative textual mark.
[we say] no, because [the statement] is an indirect characterisation, for the mishap itself is the occasion [for the rite].
And the pouring of the oblation, pressing [of Soma], and eating [follow] the same rule.

sanskrit_iast: ubhābhyāṃ vā na hi tayor dharmaśāstram /
meaning: उभाभ्यां वा न हि तयोर् धर्मशास्त्रम् /
text_mt: Or it applies to both, because there is no rule of duty regarding those two.
The re-establishment [of the fires applies to the sacrificial session], like the boiled rice [rite].
Or rather, it belongs to both, because of the production of the substance.
The five-cup offering, however, should be a substitute, because a substance is directly stated in scripture.

and because [otherwise] it would be useless when connected with the sacrificial action;

and because it is not for the sake of consecration of that [branch];

sanskrit_iast: abhyudaye kālāparādhād ijyācodanā syād yathā pañcaśarāve /

and because the words have that character;

sanskrit_iast: anirupte 'bhyudite prākṛtībhyo nirvaped ity āśmarathyas taṇḍulabhūteṣv apanayāt /
meaning: अनिरुप्ते ऽभ्युदिते प्राकृतीभ्यो निर्वपेद् इत्य् आश्मरथ्यस् तण्डुलभूतेष्व् अपनयात् /
text_mt: If the moon rises before the grain is measured out, one should measure out for the archetypal deities: thus says Āśmarathya, because the diversion occurs when they have become husked rice.

for there is connection with the non-archetypal [deities], because of occupying their position;
and it should take place due to the absence of the other.

sanskrit_iast: dīkṣākālasya śiṣṭatvād atikrame niyatānām anutkarṣaḥ prāptakālatvāt /

sanskrit_iast: utkarṣo vā dīkṣitatvād aviśiṣṭaṃ hi kāraṇam /

sanskrit_iast: tatra pratihomo na vidyate yathā pūrveṣām /

sanskrit_iast: vyāpannasyāpsu gatau yad abhojyam āryāṇāṃ tat pratīyeta /

sanskrit_iast: yady udgātā jaghanyaḥ syāt punar yajñe sarvavedasaṃ dadyād yathetarasmin /
meaning: यद्य् उद्गाता जघन्यः स्यात् पुनर् यज्ञे सर्ववेदसं दद्याद् यथेतरस्मिन् /

sanskrit_iast: ahargaṇe yasminn apacchedas tad āvarteta karma pṛthaktvāt /
meaning: अहर्गणे यस्मिन्न् अपच्छेदस् तद् आवर्तेत कर्म पृथक्त्वात् /
text_mt: In a multi-day sacrificial series, that rite in which the rupture occurs should be repeated, because of the distinctness of the rites.

sanskrit_iast: sannipātāt tu nimittavighātaḥ syād bṛhadrathantaravad vibhaktaśiṣṭatvād vasiṣṭhanirvartye /
meaning: सन्निपातात् तु निमित्तविघातः स्याद् बृहद्रथन्तरवद् विभक्तशिष्टत्वाद् वसिष्ठनिर्वर्त्ये /

sanskrit_iast: api vā kṛtsnasaṃyogād avighātaḥ pratīyeta svāmitvenābhisaṃbandhāt /
meaning: अपि वा कृत्स्नसंयोगाद् अविघातः प्रतीयेत स्वामित्वेनाभिसंबन्धात् /

sanskrit_iast: sāmnoḥ karmavṛddhyaikadeśena saṃyoge guṇatvenābhisaṃbandhas tasmāt tatra vighātaḥ syāt /
meaning: साम्नोः कर्मवृद्ध्यैकदेशेन संयोगे गुणत्वेनाभिसंबन्धस् तस्मात् तत्र विघातः स्यात् /

sanskrit_iast: vacanāt tu dvisaṃyogas tasmād ekasya pāṇivat /

sanskrit_iast: arthānāṃ ca vibhaktatvān na tacchrutena saṃbandhaḥ /

sanskrit_iast: puruṣakalpena vikṛtau kartṛniyamaḥ syād yajñasya tadguṇatvād abhāvād itarān pratyekasminn adhikāraḥ syāt /

sanskrit_iast: arthavādo vā vidhiśeṣatvāt tasmān nityānuvādaḥ syāt /

sanskrit_iast: vipratiṣedhāt tu guṇyanyataraḥ syād iti lāvukāyanaḥ /

meaning: इष्टिपूर्वत्वाद् अक्रतुशेषो होमः संस्कृतेष्व् अग्निषु स्याद् पूर्वो ऽप्य् आधानस्य सर्वशेषत्वात् /

sanskrit_iast: iṣṭitve na tu saṃstavaś caturhotṝn asaṃskṛteṣu darśayati /
meaning: इष्टित्वे न तु संस्तवश् चतुर्होतॄन् असंस्कृतेषु दर्शयति /

meaning: इष्टित्वेन संस्तुते होमः स्याद् अनारभ्याग्निसंयोगाद् इतरेषाम् अवाच्यत्वात् /

text_mt: Or rather, it is a specification for one who has not established fires, because of the context-free connection with fires.

sanskrit_iast: akarma cordhvam ādhānāt tatsamavāyo hi karmabhiḥ /
meaning: अकर्म चोर्ध्वम् आधानात् तत्समवायो हि कर्मभिः /
text_mt: And there is no ritual action before the establishment of fires, for association with ritual actions belongs [only] to that.
[No,] because there would be a conflict with direct scriptural statement.

sanskrit_iast: somapānāt tu prāpaṇaṃ dvitīyasya tasmād upayacchet /
meaning: सोमपानात् तु प्रापणं द्वितीयस्य तस्माद् उपयच्छेत् /
text_mt: But [the second wife is to be taken] because drinking Soma requires the presence of a second [wife]; therefore he should marry [another].

sanskrit_iast: pitṛyajñe tu darśanāt prāg ādhānāt pratīyeta /
meaning: पितृयज्ञे तु दर्शनात् प्राग् आधानात् प्रतीयेत /

sanskrit_iast: sthapatīṣṭiḥ prayājavad agnayādheyaṃ prayojayet tādarthyāc cāpavṛjyeta /
meaning: स्थपतीष्टिः प्रयाजवद् अग्नयाधेयं प्रयोजयेत् तादर्थ्याच् चापवृज्येत /

meaning: अपि वा लौकिके ऽग्नौ स्याद् आधानस्यासर्वशेषत्वात् /

Or it must be restricted, because it has an effective purpose.

sanskrit_iast: niyamo vaikārthyaṃ hy arthabhedād bhedaḥ pṛthavatvenābhidhānāt /
meaning: नियमो वैकार्थ्यं ह्य् अर्थभेदाद् भेदः पृथवत्वेनाभिधानात् /
text_mt: Or there is restriction, for there is identity of purpose; difference [arises] from a difference of purpose, because it is designated as having a distinct character.

It is not a modification, because the relation is primordial.
That [quality] is accidental, because the qualification of the animal is not enjoined.

sanskrit_iast: śrutipramāṇatvāc cheṣāṇāṃ mukhyabhede yathādhikāraṃ bhāvaḥ syāt /
meaning: श्रुतिप्रमाणत्वाच् छेषाणां मुख्यभेदे यथाधिकारं भावः स्यात् /
text_mt: Because direct scriptural statement is the means of valid cognition, when the primary elements differ, the state of the subsidiaries must correspond to each ritual eligibility.
Or, because the origination and purpose are undivided, they would share the same ritual procedure, as in the case of individual substances.

sanskrit_iast: codanāśeṣabhāvād vā tadbhedād vyavatiṣṭherann utpatter guṇabhūtatvāt /
meaning: चोदनाशेषभावाद् वा तद्भेदाद् व्यवतिष्ठेरन्न् उत्पत्तेर् गुणभूतत्वात् /
text_mt: Or, because they are subsidiaries of the injunction, they would be distributed according to its differences, since the origination is secondary.
If it were an entity, on account of the connection with the defining characteristic, it would be understood as applying universally.
Because there is no distinction, however, it cannot be so.
And having two purposes is contradictory.

sanskrit_iast: utpattau vidhyabhāvād vā codanāyāṃ pravṛttiḥ syāt tataś ca karmabhedaḥ syāt /
meaning: उत्पत्तौ विध्यभावाद् वा चोदनायां प्रवृत्तिः स्यात् ततश् च कर्मभेदः स्यात् /
text_mt: Or because there is no injunctive rule in the origination, the application would be in the injunction, and hence there would be difference of ritual action.

sanskrit_iast: yadi vāpy abhidhānavat sāmānyāt sarvadharmaḥ syāt /
meaning: यदि वाप्य् अभिधानवत् सामान्यात् सर्वधर्मः स्यात् /
text_mt: Or, as in the case of designations, on account of similarity, all ritual properties would apply.

sanskrit_iast: arthasya tv avibhaktatvāt tathā syād abhidhāneṣu pūrvavattvāt prayogasya karmaṇaḥ śabdabhāvyatvād vibhāgāc cheṣāṇām apravṛttiḥ syāt /
meaning: अर्थस्य त्व् अविभक्तत्वात् तथा स्याद् अभिधानेषु पूर्ववत्त्वात् प्रयोगस्य कर्मणः शब्दभाव्यत्वाद् विभागाच् छेषाणाम् अप्रवृत्तिः स्यात् /
text_mt: Because the purpose is undivided, it would be so; in designations, because performance has a precedent, because the ritual action is brought into being by the verbal testimony, and because of distinction, there would be no application of the subsidiaries.

sanskrit_iast: arthasya śabdabhāvyatvāt prakaraṇanibandhanāc chabdād evānyatra bhāvaḥ syāt /
meaning: अर्थस्य शब्दभाव्यत्वात् प्रकरणनिबन्धनाच् छब्दाद् एवान्यत्र भावः स्यात् /
text_mt: Because the purpose is brought into being by verbal testimony, on account of its connection to the context of the ritual topic, its existence elsewhere could only be from direct verbal statement.
In what is common, because it has a precedent, the ritual eligibility would belong to what has originated.

sanskrit_iast: api vā yady apūrvatvād itaradadhikārthe jyautiṣṭomikād vidhes tadvācakaṃ samānaṃ syāt /
meaning: अपि वा यद्य् अपूर्वत्वाद् इतरदधिकार्थे ज्यौतिष्टोमिकाद् विधेस् तद्वाचकं समानं स्यात् /
text_mt: Or, if on account of being an unexampled rite the other serves a further purpose, the expression denoting it would be identical with that of the injunctive rule of the Jyotiṣṭoma.
In the five recurrent offerings, there is extended application of the corroborative statement because of proximity.
Or of all, because of identity of verbal expression.
And the cake on one potsherd and the cake to Indra-Agni are likewise.

sanskrit_iast: ekakapālānāṃ vaiśvadevikaḥ prakṛtir āgrayaṇe sarvahomāparivṛttidarśanād avabhṛthe ca sakṛd dvyavadānasya vacanāt /
meaning: एककपालानां वैश्वदेविकः प्रकृतिर् आग्रयणे सर्वहोमापरिवृत्तिदर्शनाद् अवभृथे च सकृद् द्व्यवदानस्य वचनात् /
text_mt: For the single-potsherd cakes, the Vaiśvadeva rite is the archetypal sacrifice, because in the Āgrayaṇa offering no complete offering [of all parts] is seen, and because at the Avabhṛtha bath there is an express statement of taking two portions at once.
The application of a Sāman chant would occur by means of its proper name, as instructed.

sanskrit_iast: śabdais tv arthavidhitvād arthāntare 'pravṛttiḥ syāt pṛthagbhāvāt kriyāyā hy abhisambandhaḥ /
meaning: शब्दैस् त्व् अर्थविधित्वाद् अर्थान्तरे ऽप्रवृत्तिः स्यात् पृथग्भावात् क्रियाया ह्य् अभिसम्बन्धः /
text_mt: By words, however, because they enjoin the purpose, there would be no application to another purpose, because of their separate nature; for the connection is indeed with the action.

sanskrit_iast: svārthe vā syāt prayojanaṃ kriyāyās tadaṅgabhāvenopadiśyeran /
meaning: स्वार्थे वा स्यात् प्रयोजनं क्रियायास् तदङ्गभावेनोपदिश्येरन् /
text_mt: Or its utility lies in its own purpose; [the words] would be taught as subsidiaries of that action.
And in this way scripture would be devoid of purpose.
[We reply:] No, because of the absence of purpose, there is no connection with direct scriptural statement.
The accent, however, would belong to the original forms, because it is undivided from the mora and the phoneme.
But because there is no direct scriptural statement of modification in the subsequent [verses], [the tone is] according to direct scriptural statement.
And [otherwise there would be] an inconsistency of the words.

sanskrit_iast: api tu karmaśabdaḥ syād bhāvo 'rthaḥ prasiddhagrahaṇatvād vikāro hy aviśiṣṭo 'nyaiḥ /
meaning: अपि तु कर्मशब्दः स्याद् भावो ऽर्थः प्रसिद्धग्रहणत्वाद् विकारो ह्य् अविशिष्टो ऽन्यैः /
text_mt: On the contrary, it must be a word expressive of action, its object being an act, because it is grasped as well-known; for modification is not distinct from the others.

sanskrit_iast: tasya ca kriyā grahaṇārthā nānārtheṣu virūpitvād artho hy āsāmalaukiko vidhānāt /
meaning: तस्य च क्रिया ग्रहणार्था नानार्थेषु विरूपित्वाद् अर्थो ह्य् आसामलौकिको विधानात् /
text_mt: And its performance is for the purpose of acquisition, because of diversity in different purposes; for their purpose is non-empirical, by virtue of injunction.
In respect of that, there must be specific designations, because of the distinctness of the modifications.
And the verses in the matrix-hymns are enjoined equally with the other [verses].
And also, in that which is not a matrix, [a chant] is seen which does not have that matrix.
If it is said that, where there is a single purpose, there is no diversity of form;
[we reply that] it could be, because in the case of other purposes there is no accomplishment, as in cooking.
And [thus] there is consistency of the words.

sanskrit_iast: uktaṃ kriyābhidhānaṃ tacchrutāv anyatra vidhipradeśaḥ syāt /
meaning: उक्तं क्रियाभिधानं तच्छ्रुताव् अन्यत्र विधिप्रदेशः स्यात् /
text_mt: The designation of the action has been stated; when it is heard, there would be an extension of injunctive rule elsewhere.
But because the name is innate;

sanskrit_iast: pratyakṣād guṇasaṃyogāt kriyābhidhānaṃ syāt tadabhāve 'prasiddhaṃ syāt /
meaning: प्रत्यक्षाद् गुणसंयोगात् क्रियाभिधानं स्यात् तदभावे ऽप्रसिद्धं स्यात् /
text_mt: from direct perception, through connection with a secondary quality, it would be the designation of an action; in its absence, it would be unknown.

sanskrit_iast: api vā satrakarmaṇi guṇārthaiṣā śrutiḥ syāt /
meaning: अपि वा सत्रकर्मणि गुणार्थैषा श्रुतिः स्यात् /
text_mt: Or rather, in the ritual of a sacrificial session, this direct scriptural statement would be for the sake of a secondary quality.

sanskrit_iast: viśvajiti sarvapṛṣṭhe tatpūrvakatvāj jyautiṣṭomikāni pṛṣṭhāny asti ca pṛṣṭhaśabdaḥ /
meaning: विश्वजिति सर्वपृष्ठे तत्पूर्वकत्वाज् ज्यौतिष्टोमिकानि पृष्ठान्य् अस्ति च पृष्ठशब्दः /
text_mt: In the Viśvajit, which has all the Pṛṣṭhas, because it is preceded by it, the Pṛṣṭhas are those pertaining to the Jyotiṣṭoma rite, and there is the word ‘Pṛṣṭha’.
Or from the six-day rite, for the injunction is there.
The Jyotiṣṭoma rite has its ritual eligibility already established.
not so, because the word ‘all’ would be meaningless.

sanskrit_iast: dravyādeśe taddravyaḥ śrutisaṃyogāt puroḍāśas tv anādeśe tatprakṛtitvāt /
meaning: द्रव्यादेशे तद्द्रव्यः श्रुतिसंयोगात् पुरोडाशस् त्व् अनादेशे तत्प्रकृतित्वात् /
text_mt: When a substance is specified, it has that substance, because of connection with direct scriptural statement; but the sacrificial cake [is used] when there is no specification, because it is its archetypal sacrifice.
An injunctive rule of a secondary quality, however, would not adopt [it], because of equality.
And so it is in the case of the churned fire, and the like.
The bringing forward, however, is that belonging to the Soma rite, for the other is not expressible.
And the negative prohibition of the high altar is likewise.
[we reply:] the audible mention is for the purpose of exclusive specification, or for a secondary quality, or [it is] a corroborative statement.
The bringing forward is in the first and last [sacrifices], because of the negative prohibition of the high altar.
Or in the two middle ones, because of an explanatory praise of movement.
The negative prohibition of that which relates to the high altar belongs to an unattached statement.
And [so it is with] the Svarasāman, the single-cup offering, and the curd mixture, because of the observation of an indicative textual mark.
Or the form, because it is an auxiliary part.
In case of doubt, it must be worldly, because it serves all purposes.
It cannot be Vedic, because of the specification of purpose.
So also the origination of the others, because of equality.
It must be consecrated, because it has that word.
Or figuratively, because it is not an accessory to the sacrifice, since qualities are designated.
The word ‘Pṛṣṭha’ must apply to the ritual action, because it is taught as being such.

sanskrit_iast: abhidhānopadeśād vā vipratiṣedhād dravyeṣu pṛṣṭhaśabdaḥ syāt /
meaning: अभिधानोपदेशाद् वा विप्रतिषेधाद् द्रव्येषु पृष्ठशब्दः स्यात् /
text_mt: Or, because of the teaching of the designation, the word ‘Pṛṣṭha’ would apply to the substances on account of contradiction.
Because of the injunctive rule of modal procedure, the sacrifice has that which preceded it.
It would be worldly, because its operation is seen.
By virtue of Vedic statement, however, it is different from that.
Or it should be restricted by an indicative textual mark, because an indicative textual mark is a subordinate quality of it.
Or rather, because it is preceded by illogicality where there are statements that are permanent reiterations.

sanskrit_iast: mitho vipratiṣedhāc ca guṇānāṃ yathārthatalpanā syāt /
meaning: मिथो विप्रतिषेधाच् च गुणानां यथार्थतल्पना स्यात् /
text_mt: And because of mutual contradiction, the assumption of secondary qualities would be according to the purpose.

sanskrit_iast: bhāgitvāt tu niyamyeta guṇānām abhidhānatvāt sambandhād abhidhānavad yathā dhenuḥ kiśoreṇa /
meaning: भागित्वात् तु नियम्येत गुणानाम् अभिधानत्वात् सम्बन्धाद् अभिधानवद् यथा धेनुः किशोरेण /
text_mt: It must, however, be restricted because it is a recipient, since qualities are designations, as a designation by virtue of connection, like a cow by her calf.

sanskrit_iast: utpattīnāṃ samatvād vā yathādhikāraṃ bhāvaḥ syāt /
meaning: उत्पत्तीनां समत्वाद् वा यथाधिकारं भावः स्यात् /
text_mt: Or, because originations are equal, the presence would be according to ritual eligibility.
And the statement of origination and auxiliary is contradictory in one [and the same rite].

sanskrit_iast: vidhyanto vā prakṛtivac codanāyāṃ pravarteta tathā hi liṅgadarśanam /
meaning: विध्यन्तो वा प्रकृतिवच् चोदनायां प्रवर्तेत तथा हि लिङ्गदर्शनम् /
text_mt: Or the ritual details would operate in the injunction like the archetypal sacrifice; for thus is the observation of an indicative textual mark.
Because the indicative textual mark is the cause, in the absence of an indicative textual mark it would be worldly.

sanskrit_iast: liṅgasya pūrvavattavāc codanāśabdasāmānyād ekenāpi nirūpyeta yathā sthālīpulākena /
meaning: लिङ्गस्य पूर्ववत्तवाच् चोदनाशब्दसामान्याद् एकेनापि निरूप्येत यथा स्थालीपुलाकेन /
text_mt: Because the indicative textual mark has a precedent, and because of the commonness of the injunctive word, it could be ascertained even by a single one, as [the boiling of rice in] a pot by a single grain.

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśāhikam ahargaṇe tatprakṛtitvād aikāhikam adhikāgamāt tadākhyaṃ syād ekāhavat /
meaning: द्वादशाहिकम् अहर्गणे तत्प्रकृतित्वाद् ऐकाहिकम् अधिकागमात् तदाख्यं स्याद् एकाहवत् /
text_mt: In a group of days, that which belongs to the twelve-day rite [is extended], because it is its archetypal sacrifice; that which belongs to the one-day rite [is extended only] when there is an additional factor; it would have that name like a one-day rite.
Or rather not so, because [the term] designates a sacrificial rite, and the excess [days] are not expressed by the word.
The indicative textual mark would belong to the aggregate, because the purpose applies to that, just as in the case of a substance.
Or rather not so, because properties belong to the purpose, the aggregate being secondary.
In the case of substances, the attainment of properties would occur because the purpose applies [to them].
There is perception of an indicative textual mark of that which is restricted by the performance.
The mention of the distribution of sacred fires refers to what is qualified, because statements not commenced under a specific topic apply to the archetypal sacrifice.
[The property belongs to that rite] whose indicative textual mark [is found], on account of connection with the purpose, just as with a designation.
Because it is a performance, there would be application of the [archetypal] iṣṭi in the Soma sacrifice.
Or rather, [the Soma sacrifice] has a transcendental potency of its own, because of its complete injunction.
And because the absence of besprinkling the ladle is an obligatory restatement.
There is perception of the [properties] of the iṣṭi.
There should be the application of the New- and Full-Moon sacrifices to [other] iṣṭis.
And because an indicative textual mark is observed in the animal sacrifice.
In the eleven animal sacrifices, [the archetype is] the animal sacrifice of the Soma-pressing day, because of the observation of two ropes.
Its application should be in groups [of sacrifices], because a sacrificial post is observed for each animal.
And in group-series rites, the application of the prior should be in the subsequent ones.

sanskrit_iast: karmaṇas tv apravṛttitvāt phalaniyamakartṛ samudāyasyānanvayas tadbandhanatvāt /
meaning: कर्मणस् त्व् अप्रवृत्तित्वात् फलनियमकर्तृ समुदायस्यानन्वयस् तद्बन्धनत्वात् /
text_mt: But because the ritual action does not transfer, the collection of fruit, restriction, and agent does not connect, because it is bound to that [original rite].
And even if it were to transfer, [it would not connect] because it is for the sake of that [archetype].
In optional secondary elements, there would be application, because they are based [on the action].
Or rather, there is non-application, on account of the difference in ritual actions.
Or rather, because it is not a modification thereof and because it serves the sacrificial rite, application would take place.
In a single ritual action there is alternative adoption, for there is no distinction, because the injunction is one.
There would be alternative adoption on account of the commonality of the indicative textual mark.

sanskrit_iast: aikārthyād vā niyamyeta pūrvavattvād vikāro hi /
meaning: ऐकार्थ्याद् वा नियम्येत पूर्ववत्त्वाद् विकारो हि /
text_mt: Or rather, it should be restricted by unity of purpose, for a modified rite possesses [properties] like the prior [archetype].
And likewise, there is observation of another purpose.
In case of conflict, it should be restricted by the sacrificial offering, because the ritual action is named after it.
The direct scriptural mention of the deity is by way of a subordinate qualification.
Gold has the properties of clarified butter, because of brilliance.
Or rather, it is [a modification of] vegetable oblation, because of solidity.
And because cooking is directly heard in scriptural text regarding it.
In the case of honey-water, it should be a modification of milk, on account of the commonality of substance.
Or rather clarified butter, on account of the commonality of color.
And because the former has no specific distinction.

sanskrit_iast: vājine somapūrvatvaṃ sautrāmaṇyāñ ca graheṣu tācchabdyāt /
meaning: वाजिने सोमपूर्वत्वं सौत्रामण्याञ् च ग्रहेषु ताच्छब्द्यात् /
text_mt: In the case of whey, and in the Sautrāmaṇī cups, the Soma sacrifice is the prior [archetype], on account of the use of that word.
And on account of consuming after an invitation.
And purchasing, cooking, reciting the introductory verse, holding in a vessel, placing, and wrapping in cloth are likewise.
Or rather, it should be restricted by the sacrificial offering, because it is a modification thereof.
And there is observation of an indicative textual mark of the animal-cake offering.
The animal offering should be a modification of the sacrificial cake, on account of the commonality of deity.
Rather, [the animal offering is a modification of] the curd-and-milk oblation, because of originating from it;
And because its vessel is observed [in the ritual texts];
[It should be a modification] of the curd, on account of the common property of solid form;
The curdled milk clot (āmikṣā), because it is produced from both, should be a modification of both;
Because of the common property of solidity with curd;

sanskrit_iast: payo vā tatpradhānatvāl lokavad dadhnas tadarthatvāt /
meaning: पयो वा तत्प्रधानत्वाल् लोकवद् दध्नस् तदर्थत्वात् /
text_mt: Or [a modification] of milk, because that is the principal constituent, as in worldly matters, since curd exists for the sake of it;

sanskrit_iast: satramahīnaś ca dvādaśāhas tasyobhayathā pravṛttir aikakarmyāt /
meaning: सत्रमहीनश् च द्वादशाहस् तस्योभयथा प्रवृत्तिर् ऐककर्म्यात् /
text_mt: The twelve-day rite is both a sacrificial session and a multi-day sacrifice: its application is twofold, because of its identical performance;

sanskrit_iast: api vā yajatiśruter ahīnabhūtapravṛttiḥ syāt prakṛtyā tulya śabdatvāt /
meaning: अपि वा यजतिश्रुतेर् अहीनभूतप्रवृत्तिः स्यात् प्रकृत्या तुल्य शब्दत्वात् /
text_mt: Rather, by the direct scriptural statement of the verb 'he sacrifices' (yajati), it functions as a multi-day sacrifice, because the wording is equal to the archetypal sacrifice;
[The rites] from the two-day up to the eleven-day rite have the character of a multi-day sacrifice, because of the injunction with the verb 'he sacrifices' (yajati);
In rites of thirteen days and upward, it has the nature of a sacrificial session, because in them there is the injunction of 'sitting' and 'undertaking';

sanskrit_iast: anyatarato 'tirātratvāt pañcadaśarātrasyāhīnatvaṃ kuṇḍapāyināmayanasya ca tadbhūteṣv ahīnatvasya darśanāt /
meaning: अन्यतरतो ऽतिरात्रत्वात् पञ्चदशरात्रस्याहीनत्वं कुण्डपायिनामयनस्य च तद्भूतेष्व् अहीनत्वस्य दर्शनात् /
text_mt: The fifteen-day rite and the Kuṇḍapāyins' session have the nature of a multi-day sacrifice because there is an Atirātra at only one end, and because the nature of a multi-day sacrifice is seen in rites of that type;
And [scripture] displays an indicative textual mark of a sacrificial session;
In a group of sacrificial offerings, the subsequent one [follows the archetypal details] of the subsequent, because of the common spatial order;
Or it should be determined by the recipient deity, because of verbal expression, while the other [relation] is not directly stated by scriptural text;
When a group [of days] is enjoined, repetition should be understood of that [day] whose indicative textual mark is present, as in the case of the Āgneya;
Or [they are] distinct days, because of being an aggregate, since the injunction is accompanied by the indicative textual mark of continuous progression;
And thus another purpose is seen [in the texts];
Even when there is repetition of the time, [there are distinct days], so says Bādari, because of difference in ritual action;
Jaimini, however, [holds that] it is repetition of that [same rite], because the number of days is not directly perceived;
In groups of soma-terminations, repetition of that [same archetype] should be understood, because an established characteristic is apprehended;

sanskrit_iast: adhikārād vā prakṛtis tadviśiṣṭā syād abhidhānasya tannimittatvāt /
meaning: अधिकाराद् वा प्रकृतिस् तद्विशिष्टा स्याद् अभिधानस्य तन्निमित्तत्वात् /
text_mt: Or, by virtue of ritual eligibility, the archetypal sacrifice must be differentiated by that [order], because the naming is caused by that;
The accumulation [of days] is derived from the group [of days], because that is its archetypal base;
Or [it is derived] from the one-day rite, because they are equal;

sanskrit_iast: gāyatrīṣu prākṛtīnām avacchedaḥ prakṛtyādhikārāt saṃkhyātvād agniṣṭomavad avyatirekāt tadākhyatvam /
meaning: गायत्रीषु प्राकृतीनाम् अवच्छेदः प्रकृत्याधिकारात् संख्यात्वाद् अग्निष्टोमवद् अव्यतिरेकात् तदाख्यत्वम् /
text_mt: In the case of the Gāyatrī verses, there is a limitation of the archetypal verses, because of the context of the archetype, because of the number, and because, as in the case of the Agniṣṭoma, it is named after it due to non-difference;
And because it is regularly mentioned, that statement applies to distinct verses;
Or the word for the substance denotes a secondary quality, because it does not apply to all;
And there is coordination, as in the case of the cow-genus;
And because the number is verbally expressed;
Because it does not reside in another substance, it would be differentiated by the omissions of the Ukthya;
And because it is not characterized by scriptural teaching;
Because it is an originary proper name, it would apply figuratively to distinct verses;

sanskrit_iast: apūrve ca vikalpaḥ syād yadi saṃkhyāvidhānam /
meaning: अपूर्वे च विकल्पः स्याद् यदि संख्याविधानम् /
text_mt: And with regard to what is novel, there would be an option if it were the injunction of a number;
If it be objected that it is not so, because an already established [object] is apprehended;

sanskrit_iast: yadi vāviśaye niyamaḥ prakṛtyupabandhāc chareṣv api prasiddhaḥ syāt /
meaning: यदि वाविशये नियमः प्रकृत्युपबन्धाच् छरेष्व् अपि प्रसिद्धः स्यात् /
text_mt: If there were a restrictive rule in an ambiguous case, it would also be established in the case of reed grass, because of the connection with the archetype;

sanskrit_iast: arthasya cāsamāptatvān na tāsām ekadeśe syāt /
meaning: अर्थस्य चासमाप्तत्वान् न तासाम् एकदेशे स्यात् /
text_mt: And because the purpose is not completed, it cannot apply to a single part of them;
The ladle-homa (darvihoma) is the name of a sacrifice, because of its connection with the word 'homa';
It must belong to worldly rites, because the agent is named by that [designation].
Or rather, [it applies] to all, because it is seen in the Vāstuhoma.
Or rather, [it applies] to the injunctions with juhoti, because of connection with that.
Or rather, because of the teaching of the substance, it should be an expression of an accessory.
Not of worldly [rites], because of relying on traditional custom, and because what is accompanied by Vedic words is enjoined for another purpose.
And because of the observation of a different vessel.
And the relation to the purpose has been stated.
In that case, Soma would apply, because it is unmanifest.

sanskrit_iast: na vā svāhākāreṇa saṃyogād vāṣaṭkārasya ca nirdeśāt tantretena vipratiṣedhāt /
meaning: न वा स्वाहाकारेण संयोगाद् वाषट्कारस्य च निर्देशात् तन्त्रेतेन विप्रतिषेधात् /
text_mt: Not so, because of the connection with the svāhā-call, and because of the mention of the vaṣaṭ-call, through the procedure [of the archetypal rite] there would be contradiction with it.

sanskrit_iast: uttarārthas tu svāhākāro yathā sāptadaśyaṃ tatrāvipratiṣiddhā punaḥ pravṛttir liṅgadarśanāt paśuvat /
meaning: उत्तरार्थस् तु स्वाहाकारो यथा साप्तदश्यं तत्राविप्रतिषिद्धा पुनः प्रवृत्तिर् लिङ्गदर्शनात् पशुवत् /
text_mt: However, the svāhā-call is for the subsequent rite, like the seventeen-fold state; its recurring application there is not contradictory, because of seeing an indicative textual mark, as in the case of the animal [sacrifice].

sanskrit_iast: anuttarārtho vārthavattvād ānarthakyād dhi prākṛtasyoparodhaḥ syāt /
meaning: अनुत्तरार्थो वार्थवत्त्वाद् आनर्थक्याद् धि प्राकृतस्योपरोधः स्यात् /
text_mt: Or rather, it is not for a subsequent rite, because of having its own purpose; for from purposelessness there would be the obstruction of the archetypal [element].
The subsequent weakness in co-occurrence has been stated.
Or rather, its injunction would be an injunctive rule, because the iṣṭi is already established in application.
Because the absence [of an archetype] is the reason there, non-perception would be for the sake of an accessory.

sanskrit_iast: na vākyaśeṣatvād guṇārthe ca samādhānaṃ nānātvenopapadyate /
meaning: न वाक्यशेषत्वाद् गुणार्थे च समाधानं नानात्वेनोपपद्यते /
text_mt: No, because it is the remainder of a sentence, and a conciliation for the sake of an accessory is established through diversity.

sanskrit_iast: yeṣāṃ vāparayor hemas teṣāṃ syād avirodhāt /
meaning: येषां वापरयोर् हेमस् तेषां स्याद् अविरोधात् /
text_mt: Or rather, for those whose offering is in the other two [fires], [it belongs] to them, because of non-contradiction.
Herbs are enjoined there; they would be understood by spatial order.

sanskrit_iast:
pratipatti tu te bhavatas tasmād atādvikāratvam /
sannipāte virodhinām apravṛttiḥ pratīyeta vidhyutpattivyavasthānād arthasyāpariṇeyatvād vacanād atideśaḥ syāt /
meaning:
प्रतिपत्ति तु ते भवतस् तस्माद् अताद्विकारत्वम् /
सन्निपाते विरोधिनाम् अप्रवृत्तिः प्रतीयेत विध्युत्पत्तिव्यवस्थानाद् अर्थस्यापरिणेयत्वाद् वचनाद् अतिदेशः स्यात् /
text_mt:
However, those two are disposal rites; therefore there is absence of modification from that.

In the clash of conflicting elements, non-application would be recognized, because of the settlement of origin by injunctive rule; because the purpose cannot be transposed, extended application would be [only] by explicit statement.

sanskrit_iast: yajñakarma pradhānaṃ tad dhi codanābhūtaṃ tasya dravyeṣu saṃskāras tatprayuktas tadarthatvāt /
meaning: यज्ञकर्म प्रधानं तद् धि चोदनाभूतं तस्य द्रव्येषु संस्कारस् तत्प्रयुक्तस् तदर्थत्वात् /
text_mt: The sacrificial action is the primary element, for that constitutes the injunction; the preparatory purification regarding its substances is prompted by it, because of serving its purpose.
It would be prompted by that [purification], because those employed in a preparatory purification exist for its sake.

sanskrit_iast: tena tvarthena yajñasya saṃyogād dharmasambandhas tasmād yajñaprayuktaṃ syāt saṃskārasya tadarthatvāt /
meaning: तेन त्वर्थेन यज्ञस्य संयोगाद् धर्मसम्बन्धस् तस्माद् यज्ञप्रयुक्तं स्यात् संस्कारस्य तदर्थत्वात् /
text_mt: Rather, because of the connection of the sacrifice with that purpose, there is relation to duty; therefore, it is prompted by the sacrifice, because the preparatory purification exists for its sake.
No, for an injunction does not possess that quality.

sanskrit_iast: devatā vā prayojayed atithivad bhojanasya tadarthatvāt /
meaning: देवता वा प्रयोजयेद् अतिथिवद् भोजनस्य तदर्थत्वात् /
text_mt: Or rather, the recipient deity should prompt [the rite], as in the case of a guest, because feeding exists for his sake.
And from that follows the relation with that.

sanskrit_iast: api vā śabdapūrvatvād yajñakarma pradhānaṃ syād guṇatve devatāśrutiḥ /
meaning: अपि वा शब्दपूर्वत्वाद् यज्ञकर्म प्रधानं स्याद् गुणत्वे देवताश्रुतिः /
text_mt: Or rather, because verbal testimony is primary, the sacrificial action must be the primary element; the direct scriptural statement of the recipient deity is in a subordinate capacity.

sanskrit_iast: atithau tatpradhānatvam abhāvaḥ karmaṇi syāt tasya prītipradhānatvāt /
meaning: अतिथौ तत्प्रधानत्वम् अभावः कर्मणि स्यात् तस्य प्रीतिप्रधानत्वात् /
text_mt: In the case of a guest, predominance belongs to him; in a ritual action, there would be absence [of that], because his [pleasure] is primarily satisfaction.
Or the aggregate of substance, number, and cause, because of connection with direct scriptural statement.

sanskrit_iast: arthakārite ca dravyeṇa na vyavasthā syāt /
meaning: अर्थकारिते च द्रव्येण न व्यवस्था स्यात् /
text_mt: And in what is caused by purpose, there would be no fixed limitation through the substance.

sanskrit_iast: artho vā syāt prayojanam itareṣām acodanāt tasya ca guṇabhūtatvāt /
meaning: अर्थो वा स्यात् प्रयोजनम् इतरेषाम् अचोदनात् तस्य च गुणभूतत्वात् /
text_mt: Or the purpose would be the motive, because the others are not enjoined, and because it is subordinate.
Because of transcendental potency, there would be a fixed limitation.
And if it were prompted by that, the duty would have scope over everything.

sanskrit_iast: tulyeṣu nādhikāraḥ syād acoditaś ca sambandhaḥ pṛthaksatāṃ yajñārthenābhisambandhas tasmādyajñaprayojanam /
meaning: तुल्येषु नाधिकारः स्याद् अचोदितश् च सम्बन्धः पृथक्सतां यज्ञार्थेनाभिसम्बन्धस् तस्माद्यज्ञप्रयोजनम् /
text_mt: In equals, there would be no ritual eligibility, and the connection is not enjoined; for things existing separately, there is connection with the purpose of the sacrifice; therefore, the purpose of the sacrifice [is the prompter].

sanskrit_iast: deśabaddham upāṃśutvaṃ teṣāṃ syāc chrutinirdeśāt tasya ca tatrabhāvāt /
meaning: देशबद्धम् उपांशुत्वं तेषां स्याच् छ्रुतिनिर्देशात् तस्य च तत्रभावात् /
text_mt: Muttered performance would belong to them as bound to place, because of direct scriptural designation and because of its absence there.
Or of the sacrifice, because of connection with it.
And restatement is like having that purpose.
Or of those belonging to that place, because the collection is enjoined.
The duty of the fire applies to each brick, from the collection, as in the case of the Full-Moon sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: agner vā syād dravyaikatvād itarāsāṃ tadarthatvāt /
meaning: अग्नेर् वा स्याद् द्रव्यैकत्वाद् इतरासां तदर्थत्वात् /
text_mt: Or rather, it belongs to the fire, because the substance is one, and because the others exist for its sake.
However, in the Full-Moon sacrifice it would be so because of the aggregate of injunctions.
Terminating with the Patnīsaṃyājas belongs to all, because there is no distinction.

sanskrit_iast: anuvādo vā dīkṣā yathā naktaṃ saṃsthāpanasya /
meaning: अनुवादो वा दीक्षा यथा नक्तं संस्थापनस्य /
text_mt: Or a restatement, like the initiation in the concluding by night.

sanskrit_iast: syād vānārabhya vidhānād ante liṅga virodhāt /
meaning: स्याद् वानारभ्य विधानाद् अन्ते लिङ्ग विरोधात् /
text_mt: Or rather, it must be at the end, because of being enjoined without reference to a context, and because of contradiction with an indicative textual mark.
The repetition of the kindling verses, due to being first, would be a duty of spatial order.
Upon repetition of the iṣṭi, the Ārambhaṇīyā should be repeated, like the fore-offerings.
Or [it should be performed] only once, because of the connection with the initiation [of the whole cycle]; for there is a single ongoing undertaking, since the performance lasts as long as life.

sanskrit_iast: arthābhidhānasaṃyogān mantreṣu śeṣabhāvaḥ syāt tatrācoditam aprāptaṃ coditābhidhānāt /
meaning: अर्थाभिधानसंयोगान् मन्त्रेषु शेषभावः स्यात् तत्राचोदितम् अप्राप्तं चोदिताभिधानात् /
text_mt: Because of their connection with denoting the meaning, there should be subsidiary status in the mantras; therein what is not enjoined does not apply, because they denote what has been enjoined.
And from that it follows that the non-recitation of those [words] serves another purpose.
If it be argued that a secondary word behaves in the same way,
When enjoined, however, since it is for the sake of something else, there should be no modification, just as in the injunctive rule.
Modification should occur when it is principal.
Because there is no connection [otherwise], with respect to those purposes it should be understood as qualified by that.
If it be argued that this is so because of the absence of the act,
Because of the specification of gender, among rites of identical injunction the Sārasvatī [female victim] does not apply, owing to female gender.

sanskrit_iast: paśvabhidhānād vā tad dhi codanābhūtaṃ puṃviṣayaṃ punaḥ paśutvam /
meaning: पश्वभिधानाद् वा तद् धि चोदनाभूतं पुंविषयं पुनः पशुत्वम् /
text_mt: Or, because of the expression "animal"; for that animalhood constitutes the injunction, while the masculine domain is reiterative.
Or there is a specific restriction, because of the designation of its purpose.
And animalhood [is meant], because of single expression.
Or it is as stated, because of proximity.

sanskrit_iast: āmnātād anyad adhikāre vacanād vikāraḥ syāt /
meaning: आम्नाताद् अन्यद् अधिकारे वचनाद् विकारः स्यात् /
text_mt: When another than what is handed down in the text [is used] in the rite, modification should occur on the authority of scriptural declaration.

sanskrit_iast: dvaidhaṃ vā tulyahetutvāt sāmānyād vikalpaḥ syāt /
meaning: द्वैधं वा तुल्यहेतुत्वात् सामान्याद् विकल्पः स्यात् /
text_mt: Or there should be a split; because reasons are equal, there should be an option, on account of commonality.
Or there should be a restriction, because of direct scriptural specificity; the other case is like the seventeen-fold [sāmidhenī rule].
Because of the absence of singing, when the words are different, the instruction would apply to what is of such a character.
Or in the place of which [the chant is taught], there should be its melody, because other words are primary.
Some consider the sāman chants to be a mantra, on the basis of Smṛti and direct instruction.
Or it is an action characterised by an injunctive rule.
Such is the offering substance, on the authority of scriptural declaration, as in the case of the pākayajña.
Therein, exclusion and transfer to another substance are not contradicted.
However, because it pertains to the meaning of words, this could not be so.
And because words are for the sake of something else.
And there is no connection with the ritual action, because the two words have distinct meanings.
And outside the context of the ritual topic, the consecration would be like that of the fire, because it is employed.
And because words are not products, non-employment would be understood.
It would be employed for the sake of comprehension.
It should be on a triplet of verses, because of the direct scriptural designation.
Because the modification pertains to the words.

sanskrit_iast: vākyānāṃ tu vibhaktatvāt pratiśabdaṃ samāptiḥ syāt saṃskārasya tadarthatvāt /
meaning: वाक्यानां तु विभक्तत्वात् प्रतिशब्दं समाप्तिः स्यात् संस्कारस्य तदर्थत्वात् /
text_mt: However, because sentences are distinct, the completion of the consecration should occur at each word, because it serves that purpose.
And likewise there is an indication of another purpose.
And the instruction on chanting without drawing breath is similar.
Its repetition should be on equal verses.
The character of being the subsequent verse, however, is contingent; it should be understood from immediate succession.
And its repetition is on account of having a single purpose.
Because an indicative textual mark is seen and there is no exclusion.
Because the purpose is one, there should be an option.
Because the purpose is one, there should be an option between the ṛk verse and the sāman chant, because they serve that purpose.
Subsidiary application should follow direct scriptural statement.
In the transfer of a sāman chant, modification should depend on that, because it is effected by scripture.
With respect to the syllables, however, Bādari holds that it is according to the substance, because of the exclusion of the substance.
Some hold the cessation of the chanted interjection in another substance, as in the case of the ṛk verse.

sanskrit_iast: sarvātideśas tu sāmānyāl lokavad vikāraḥ syāt /
meaning: सर्वातिदेशस् तु सामान्याल् लोकवद् विकारः स्यात् /
text_mt: However, the extended application is of the whole, because of generality; modification should be as in common life.
And it also shows the contextual agreement.
Or the continuity would be a corroborative statement.

sanskrit_iast: adhikañ ca vivarṇañ ca jaiminiḥ stobhaśabdatvāt /
meaning: अधिकञ् च विवर्णञ् च जैमिनिः स्तोभशब्दत्वात् /
text_mt: Moreover, [elements that are] additional or altered [are maintained], says Jaimini, because they are musical syllables (stobha).

Because duty is determined by purpose, in the case of prohibition against change or transgression of substance and quality, the injunction is connected [with the modified rite] through inherent relation.
However, there is cessation of that which originates there, because it is produced by that [archetype].
Or rather, they should enter into it, because they serve a purpose, since preparatory purification serves that [substance's] purpose.

sanskrit_iast: ākhyā caivaṃ tadāveśād vikṛtau syād apūrvatvāt /
meaning: आख्या चैवं तदावेशाद् विकृतौ स्याद् अपूर्वत्वात् /
text_mt: And so its designation would apply in the modified rite through its entrance into it, because it is unprecedented.
However, by being subordinate to another, there is identity of purpose, since preparatory purification serves that purpose.
Or rather, they should be performed, because the purpose is accomplished.
Because they have a single purpose, there should be no division.
Or they should be distributed, on account of specific designation.
In a non-archetypal rite, owing to modification of it, they should be distributed because of conflict.
And in the case of [a rite with] both Sāmans, it is likewise, because a single purpose would result.
Or there would be distribution because they serve their own purpose, just as in the archetypal sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: pārvaṇahomayos tv apravṛttiḥ samudāyārthasaṃyogāt tadabhījyā hi /
meaning: पार्वणहोमयोस् त्व् अप्रवृत्तिः समुदायार्थसंयोगात् तदभीज्या हि /
text_mt: However, there is no application of the two joint-offerings (pārvaṇahoma), because they are connected with the purpose of the aggregate; for the sacrifice is directed toward that [aggregate].
If it be argued that in its absence it is like Agni;
Or rather, they pertain to that for which the sacrifice is performed.

sanskrit_iast: prakṛtau yathotpattivacanam arthānāṃ tathottarasyāṃ tatau tatprakṛtitvātvād arthe cākāryatvāt /
meaning: प्रकृतौ यथोत्पत्तिवचनम् अर्थानां तथोत्तरस्यां ततौ तत्प्रकृतित्वात्वाद् अर्थे चाकार्यत्वात् /
text_mt: Just as in the archetypal sacrifice the mention of entities corresponds to their origination, so in the subsequent extension [it is so], because that is its base paradigm and because with respect to the purpose it is not an effect to be produced.
That which is conditioned by class [takes place] according to its relative textual position.
Some hold that there is no modification, because it is not of ṛṣi-authorship.
Or rather, modification is the reason stated for that [very purpose].
The indicative textual mark is for the purpose of the desire to perform the Vedic recitation.
Or there is a restrictive injunction, because it pertains to both.

sanskrit_iast: laukike doṣasaṃyogād apavṛkte hi codyate nimittena prakṛtau syād abhāgitvāt /
meaning: लौकिके दोषसंयोगाद् अपवृक्ते हि चोद्यते निमित्तेन प्रकृतौ स्याद् अभागित्वात् /
text_mt: For in the worldly [use of a vehicle], connection with fault is enjoined when it is broken because of the occasioning condition; in the archetypal sacrifice it should apply [thus], because there is no [such restriction].

sanskrit_iast: anyāyas tv avikāreṇā draṣṭapratighātitvād aviśeṣāc ca tenāsya /
meaning: अन्यायस् त्व् अविकारेणा द्रष्टप्रतिघातित्वाद् अविशेषाच् च तेनास्य /
text_mt: However, there is impropriety in not modifying, because it would obstruct what is directly seen, and because for it there is no distinction by that [fact].
Or rather, there must be modification, because it serves that purpose.

sanskrit_iast: api tv anyāyasambandhāt prakṛtivat pareṣv api yathārthaṃ syāt /
meaning: अपि त्व् अन्यायसम्बन्धात् प्रकृतिवत् परेष्व् अपि यथार्थं स्यात् /
text_mt: Indeed, because of connection with an improper reading, even in the case of subsequent [rites] it should be according to the [actual] object, just as in the archetypal sacrifice.
However, it is according to the object, because an improper reading is not enjoined.
In Vedic texts, however, it is according to what is observed.

sanskrit_iast: vipratipattau vikalpaḥ syāt tatsatvād guṇe tv anyāyakalpanaikadeśatvāt /
meaning: विप्रतिपत्तौ विकल्पः स्यात् तत्सत्वाद् गुणे त्व् अन्यायकल्पनैकदेशत्वात् /
text_mt: In case of conflict there should be an option, because both are present; but regarding a secondary quality, the assumption of an impropriety belongs to one part.

sanskrit_iast: arthābhāvāt tu naivaṃ syād guṇamātram itarat /
meaning: अर्थाभावात् तु नैवं स्याद् गुणमात्रम् इतरत् /
text_mt: However, because of the absence of purpose, it would not be so; the other is a mere secondary quality.
In an unprecedented rite, however, non-modification should be understood, because there is no transfer.
And also in a modified rite, on account of direct scriptural statement to that effect.
The Adhrigu formula [applies] in the savanīya animal offerings in like manner, if they share a common rule.
And in the case of a substitute, because there is no modification.
Because it is not traditionally handed down, it would have no verbal authority, and because the other [original substance] is absent.

sanskrit_iast: tādarthyād vā tadākhyaṃ syāt saṃskārair aviśiṣṭatvāt /
meaning: तादर्थ्याद् वा तदाख्यं स्यात् संस्कारैर् अविशिष्टत्वात् /
text_mt: Or rather, it may bear that name because it serves that purpose, since it is not distinguished in terms of preparatory purifications.
And in the case of combined substances, because the object has an indefinite quantity.
Since 'together' (ekadhā) is connected with one [action], there would be mention by repetition.
Or there is no modification, as in the case of a single action concerning many [objects].

sanskrit_iast: sakṛttvaṃ caikadhyaṃ syād ekatvāt tvaco 'nabhipretaṃ tatprakṛtitvāt pareṣv abhyāsena vivṛddhāv abhidhānāṃ syāt /
meaning: सकृत्त्वं चैकध्यं स्याद् एकत्वात् त्वचो ऽनभिप्रेतं तत्प्रकृतित्वात् परेष्व् अभ्यासेन विवृद्धाव् अभिधानां स्यात् /
text_mt: And 'togetherness' would mean doing it once; but because the skin is singular, that is not intended; being its archetype, in the subsequent [rites] there would be mention by repetition upon increase [of victims].

sanskrit_iast: medhapatitvaṃ svāmidevatasya samavāyāt sarvatra ca prayuktatvāt tasyācānyāyanigadatvāt sarvatraivāvikāraḥ syāt /
meaning: मेधपतित्वं स्वामिदेवतस्य समवायात् सर्वत्र च प्रयुक्तत्वात् तस्याचान्यायनिगदत्वात् सर्वत्रैवाविकारः स्यात् /
text_mt: The role of 'lord of sacrifice' (medhapati) belongs to the patron and the deity through inherent relation, and because it is employed everywhere, and because it is an improperly applied mention, there should be non-modification everywhere.

sanskrit_iast: api vā dvisamavāyo 'rthānyatve yathāsaṃkhyaṃ prayogaḥ syāt /
meaning: अपि वा द्विसमवायो ऽर्थान्यत्वे यथासंख्यं प्रयोगः स्यात् /
