text_mt: Or rather, it is an inherent relation to both; when the entity is different, the employment would be according to their respective number.

sanskrit_iast: svāmino vaikaśabdyād utkarṣo devatāyāṃ syāt patnyāṃ dvitīyaśabdaḥ syāt /
meaning: स्वामिनो वैकशब्द्याद् उत्कर्षो देवतायां स्यात् पत्न्यां द्वितीयशब्दः स्यात् /
text_mt: Or, because there is a single word for the patron, there would be transfer to the deity; the second word would apply to the wife.

sanskrit_iast: devatā tu tadāśīṣṭvāt samprāptatvāt svāminy anarthikā syāt /
meaning: देवता तु तदाशीष्ट्वात् सम्प्राप्तत्वात् स्वामिन्य् अनर्थिका स्यात् /
text_mt: However, the deity is the recipient of that benediction; being already attained, it would be purposeless with respect to the patron.

sanskrit_iast: utsargāc ca bhaktyā tasmin patitvaṃ syāt /
meaning: उत्सर्गाच् च भक्त्या तस्मिन् पतित्वं स्यात् /
text_mt: And on account of dedication, lordship over it would belong [to the deity] figuratively.
[The formula] connected with a single [deity] should be transferred away in the case of two deities, because [its application there] is impossible.
Or rather, [it is applied to] one, because of inherent connection, since it characterizes that [one].

sanskrit_iast: saṃsargitvāc ca tasmāt tena vikalpaḥ syāt /
meaning: संसर्गित्वाच् च तस्मात् तेन विकल्पः स्यात् /
text_mt: And because there is association [of both deities], there would be an option with that [other formula].
In the case of many deities, there would be a restrictive rule or modification.

sanskrit_iast: arthāntare vikāraḥ syād devatāpṛthaktvād ekābhisamavāyāt syāt /
meaning: अर्थान्तरे विकारः स्याद् देवतापृथक्त्वाद् एकाभिसमवायात् स्यात् /
text_mt: In the case of a different purpose, there would be modification, because deities are separate, [or] it would be [unmodified] because of inherence in one.

sanskrit_iast: ṣaḍviṃśatir abhyāsena paśugaṇe tatprakṛtitvād gaṇasya pravibhaktatvād avikāre hi tāsām akārtsnyenābhisambandho vikārān na samāsaḥ syād asaṃyogāc ca sarvābhiḥ /
meaning: षड्विंशतिर् अभ्यासेन पशुगणे तत्प्रकृतित्वाद् गणस्य प्रविभक्तत्वाद् अविकारे हि तासाम् अकार्त्स्न्येनाभिसम्बन्धो विकारान् न समासः स्याद् असंयोगाच् च सर्वाभिः /
text_mt: [The word] 'twenty-six' [would apply] by repetition in a group of sacrificial animals, because it is the base paradigm of that, because the group is divided into parts; for if there is no modification, their connection would not be in entirety, [and] because of modification there cannot be a compound [number], and because of the absence of connection with all [at once].
No, because it is a secondary element and because it is made for the purpose.

sanskrit_iast: svābhiś ca vacanaṃ prakṛtau tatheha syāt /
meaning: स्वाभिश् च वचनं प्रकृतौ तथेह स्यात् /
text_mt: And the statement [is made] by its own [terms] in the archetypal sacrifice; so it should be here.

sanskrit_iast: vaṅkrīṇāṃ tu pradhānatvāt samāsenābhidhānaṃ syāt prādhānyam adhrigos tadarthatvāt /
meaning: वङ्क्रीणां तु प्रधानत्वात् समासेनाभिधानं स्यात् प्राधान्यम् अध्रिगोस् तदर्थत्वात् /
text_mt: However, because the ribs are primary, there should be expression by a compound [total]; primacy belongs to the Adhrigu [formula], because it serves that purpose.
And because there is mention of them in their entirety.

sanskrit_iast: api tv asannipātitvāt patnīvad āmnātenābhidhānaṃ syāt /
meaning: अपि त्व् असन्निपातित्वात् पत्नीवद् आम्नातेनाभिधानं स्यात् /
text_mt: On the contrary, because [the number] does not directly operate [on the object], the expression should be by what is handed down in the sacred text, as in the case of the wife.
There is, however, modification because it is an extended application, as in the case of the sacrificer.
So [too] in the case of the wife, because of being unprecedented.
What is not handed down in the sacred text, however, [should not be used], because there is no modification [of text], since numbers apply universally.

sanskrit_iast: saṅkhāyā tv evaṃ pradhānaṃ syād vaṅkrayaḥ punaḥ pradhānam /
meaning: सङ्खाया त्व् एवं प्रधानं स्याद् वङ्क्रयः पुनः प्रधानम् /
text_mt: In this way, however, number would be the primary element; but the ribs are the primary element.

sanskrit_iast: anāmnātavacanam avacanena hi vaṅkrīṇāṃ syān nirdeśaḥ /
meaning: अनाम्नातवचनम् अवचनेन हि वङ्क्रीणां स्यान् निर्देशः /
text_mt: [It would be] expression of what is not handed down in the sacred text, for there would be indication of the ribs by what is not directly expressed.
Or there should be repetition, because there is no modification [of the word].

sanskrit_iast: paśus tv evaṃ prādhānaṃ syād abhyāsasya tannimittatvāt tasmāt samāsaśabdaḥ syāt /
meaning: पशुस् त्व् एवं प्राधानं स्याद् अभ्यासस्य तन्निमित्तत्वात् तस्मात् समासशब्दः स्यात् /
text_mt: In this way, however, the sacrificial animal would be the primary element, because repetition is caused by that; therefore, there should be a compound word.
[The number] thirty-four belongs to the horse, [and] it is specific because of explicit statement of it.

sanskrit_iast: tat pratiṣidhya prakṛtir niyujyate sā catustriṃśadvācyatvāt /
meaning: तत् प्रतिषिध्य प्रकृतिर् नियुज्यते सा चतुस्त्रिंशद्वाच्यत्वात् /
text_mt: Having prohibited that, the archetypal [formula] is employed, because that [archetypal formula] is capable of denoting thirty-four.

sanskrit_iast: ṛg vā syād āmnātatvād avikalpaś ca nyāyyaḥ /
meaning: ऋग् वा स्याद् आम्नातत्वाद् अविकल्पश् च न्याय्यः /
text_mt: Or it must be a verse, because it is handed down in the sacred text, and absence of option is proper.
In that [verse], however, because of explicit statement, there would be modification of the word, as in the case of 'airā'.
Or there is complete prohibition, because of non-connection with the word.
Because of proximity to the rectum, the omentum is denoted by 'urūka'.
In the case of 'śyena', 'śalā', 'kaśyapa', 'kavaṣa', 'srekaparṇa', there is expression of shape, because of proximity to what is well known.
Or it denotes entirety, because of being so.
And because the Adhrigu [formula] serves that purpose.

sanskrit_iast: prāsaṅgike prāyaścittaṃ na vidyate parārthatvāt tadarthe hi vidhīyate /
meaning: प्रासङ्गिके प्रायश्चित्तं न विद्यते परार्थत्वात् तदर्थे हि विधीयते /
text_mt: In an incidental element there is no expiation, because it serves another purpose; for it is enjoined for the sake of that [other].
And in the case of holding [the vessel], because it serves another purpose.
Because they serve the action, the act should take place in the other [cases].
Not, however, when it has already arisen, because its injunctive rule has an attained time.

sanskrit_iast: pradānadarśanaṃ śrapaṇe taddharmabhojanārthatvāt saṃsargāc ca madhūdakavat /
meaning: प्रदानदर्शनं श्रपणे तद्धर्मभोजनार्थत्वात् संसर्गाच् च मधूदकवत् /
text_mt: The perception of offering [the praṇītā water] is in cooking, because [the boiled oblation] has the property of that, because its purpose is consumption, and because of mixture, as in the case of honey and water.
And the prohibition of preparatory purification is likewise.
And in the prohibition of that, because of the avoidance of what has become such.

sanskrit_iast: adharmatvam apradānāt praṇītārthe vidhānād atulyatvād asaṃsargaḥ /
meaning: अधर्मत्वम् अप्रदानात् प्रणीतार्थे विधानाद् अतुल्यत्वाद् असंसर्गः /
text_mt: There is absence of [its] ritual status, because of non-offering, because it is enjoined for the purpose of the praṇītā water, because of inequality, [and thus] there is no mixture.
The other [statement] must be an obligatory restatement of known fact.

sanskrit_iast: varjane guṇabhāvitvāt taduktapratiṣedhāt syāt kāraṇāt kevalāśanam /
meaning: वर्जने गुणभावित्वात् तदुक्तप्रतिषेधात् स्यात् कारणात् केवलाशनम् /
text_mt: In avoidance, because of being a subordinate quality, consumption of it alone may take place on account of a cause, from the prohibition of that which has been stated.
And from the rule of observance, as in the case of the remnants.
Or it is a prohibition of taste, because it serves the human purpose.
When [the moon] rises [prematurely], the removal of milk would retain its own ritual status, because it has already commenced.
Or it is a removal, because it is enjoined for another purpose, as in the case of the milk of the caru.
The direct scriptural statement 'boiled' has the purpose of secondary indication.

sanskrit_iast: śrayaṇānāṃ tv apūrvatvāt pradānārthe vidhānaṃ syāt /
meaning: श्रयणानां त्व् अपूर्वत्वात् प्रदानार्थे विधानं स्यात् /
text_mt: Because the mixing ingredients are unprecedented, however, there should be an injunction for the sake of offering.
Or it is a secondary element, because it serves the purpose of mixing.
And because direct scriptural statement shows that that is the primary element.
And the explanatory praise has that purpose.

sanskrit_iast: saṃskāraṃ prati bhāvāc ca tasmād apy apradhānam /
meaning: संस्कारं प्रति भावाच् च तस्माद् अप्य् अप्रधानम् /
text_mt: And because it exists in relation to preparatory purification, for that reason also it is not primary.
In the release of [animals] carried around the fire, serving that purpose is like the laying down [of bricks].
Or there is prohibition of the remaining [rites], because of the absence of purpose, as in the case of [rites] ending with the iḍā.
And because the word is prior, and [the word] 'completes' is intelligible only when [the rest] has not commenced.

sanskrit_iast: prabṛtter yajñahetutvāt pratiṣedhe saṃskārāṇām akarma syāt tatkāritatvād yathā prayājapratiṣedhe grahaṇam ājyasya /
meaning: प्रबृत्तेर् यज्ञहेतुत्वात् प्रतिषेधे संस्काराणाम् अकर्म स्यात् तत्कारितत्वाद् यथा प्रयाजप्रतिषेधे ग्रहणम् आज्यस्य /
text_mt: Because commencement is the cause of the sacrifice, when there is a negative prohibition, there would be non-performance of the preparatory purifications, since they are brought about by it, just as when there is a negative prohibition of the prayājas, [there is non-performance of] the taking of the clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast: kriyā vā syād avacchedād akarma sarvahānaṃ syāt /
meaning: क्रिया वा स्याद् अवच्छेदाद् अकर्म सर्वहानं स्यात् /
text_mt: Or rather, there should be an action, because of the delimited termination; non-performance would result in the abandonment of everything.
There should be a substitute up to the concluding rite of clarified butter, because of the abandonment of the substance.

sanskrit_iast: codanā vā karmotsargād anyaiḥ syād aviśiṣṭatvāt /
meaning: चोदना वा कर्मोत्सर्गाद् अन्यैः स्याद् अविशिष्टत्वात् /
text_mt: Or it is an injunctive rule; because of the abandonment of the action, it would be [completed] by others, since there is no distinction.
And [scripture] shows the non-offering of Vanaspati by an established conclusion.
The concluding rite should occur because of having that [particular] deity.
Because the injunctive rule is transferred into another context, all actions would occur.
Or rather, the naming, the preparatory purification, and the substance should be performed in relation to the beneficial purpose, because they are for its sake.
Because they are qualified by what is not directly perceived.
The iṣṭi, because of its connection with commencement, should desist from being a subsidiary element, because commencement is connected with the primary element.
And [the iṣṭi] should desist from the commencement of all [rites] when connected with something other than the primary element, because it is not a subsidiary element [to them].
In it, however, it should exist, just like the prayājas.

sanskrit_iast: karma ca dravyasaṃyogārtham arthābhāvān nivarteta tādarthyaṃ śrutisaṃyogāt /
meaning: कर्म च द्रव्यसंयोगार्थम् अर्थाभावान् निवर्तेत तादर्थ्यं श्रुतिसंयोगात् /
text_mt: And an action meant for connection with a substance would desist in the absence of that beneficial purpose, because being for its sake arises from direct scriptural statement.
In the case of the post-stump, however, because it is merely a place, non-cessation would be understood.
Or rather, because it is an auxiliary part, a preparatory purification should be understood.
And the wording of the Vedic recitation is likewise.
And in the case of the prayāja, because of that rule.
If it be said: so too the fire of the clarified butter portions;
[We reply:] it is another deity, because of the distinct designation.

sanskrit_iast: guṇo vā syāt kapālavad guṇabhūtavikārāc ca /
meaning: गुणो वा स्यात् कपालवद् गुणभूतविकाराच् च /
text_mt: Or it would be a secondary quality, like the potsherd, and because of the modification of what has become a secondary quality.

sanskrit_iast: api vā śeṣabhūtatvāt tatsaṃskāraḥ pratīyeta svāhākāravad aṅgānām arthasaṃyogāt /
meaning: अपि वा शेषभूतत्वात् तत्संस्कारः प्रतीयेत स्वाहाकारवद् अङ्गानाम् अर्थसंयोगात् /
text_mt: Or rather, because it is an auxiliary part, a preparatory purification of it should be understood, like the svāhā-call, because subsidiary elements have a connection with the beneficial purpose.
And the statement regarding what has failed is because it is for that purpose when there is a conflict.
And when there is an agreement of the cups, that statement is because of that purpose.
And in the absence of cups, there is that statement.

sanskrit_iast: devatāyāś ca hetutvaṃ prasiddhaṃ tena darśayati /
meaning: देवतायाश् च हेतुत्वं प्रसिद्धं तेन दर्शयति /
text_mt: And thereby [scripture] shows the known causality of the deity.
The occurrence is uncontradicted, because of presumption; like cooked food, it would be a modification of what is produced.

sanskrit_iast: sa dvyarthaḥ syād ubhayoḥ śrutibhūtatvād vipratipattau tādarthyād vikāratvam uktaṃ tasyārthavādatvam /
meaning: स द्व्यर्थः स्याद् उभयोः श्रुतिभूतत्वाद् विप्रतिपत्तौ तादर्थ्याद् विकारत्वम् उक्तं तस्यार्थवादत्वम् /
text_mt: It would have two beneficial purposes, because both are directly revealed; in case of conflict, because it is for its sake, it has been stated to be a modification, and that is a corroborative statement.
In case of conflict, there should be a modification of their designation.
Or it is a repetition, like the prayājas, one part belonging to another deity.
The boiled rice offering would be a modification of the sacrificial offering, because of its connection with sacrifice.
And because it is grasped as well known.
Or it is a modification of the potsherds, in case of doubt, through purpose and applicability.
And when that is directly stated in scripture, because of being another sacrificial offering.
And likewise is the presence of an indicative textual mark.

sanskrit_iast: sa kapāle prakṛtyā syād anyasya cāśrutitvāt /
meaning: स कपाले प्रकृत्या स्याद् अन्यस्य चाश्रुतित्वात् /
text_mt: It should be in the potsherd, by virtue of the archetypal sacrifice, and because no other [vessel] is directly stated in scripture.
Or in a single one, because there is no contradiction.

sanskrit_iast: na vārthāntarasaṃyogād apūpe pākasaṃyuktaṃ dhāraṇārthaṃ carau bhavati tatrārthāt pātralābhaḥ syād aniyamo 'viśeṣāt /
meaning: न वार्थान्तरसंयोगाद् अपूपे पाकसंयुक्तं धारणार्थं चरौ भवति तत्रार्थात् पात्रलाभः स्याद् अनियमो ऽविशेषात् /
text_mt: Not so; because of connection with another purpose, [in the case of the cake] it is connected with baking, whereas in the boiled rice offering it is for the purpose of holding; therefore, the obtaining of a vessel would be from necessity, and there is no restriction, because there is no distinction.
Or rather, [it is cooked] in a pot, because of the presence of an indicative textual mark.
In its case, grinding should occur, because of the non-loss of purpose.
Or non-performance, because [grinding] is the cause of the cake.
And mixing with water [desists], because its purpose is the dough-mass.
And pouring into the vessel [desists], because it is for the sake of that.
Warming [desists], because of baking underneath.
And the laying [of the potsherds] [is omitted], because its purpose is that [baking of the cake].
Or [the spreading of] broad and smooth [potsherds is omitted], because [the boiled rice] is not a sacrificial cake.
And covering [with burning coals is omitted], because its purpose is baking from above.
And setting down after lifting out [is omitted], because it is not directly prescribed in the archetypal sacrifice.
In the case of gold pieces (kṛṣṇala), there would be omission of the action [of cooking], because of the absence of purpose.
Or rather, [cooking] should take place, because it is directly taught, like the offering itself.
In the case of the under-spreading and the basting [of clarified butter], there would be no performance, because their purpose is [basting] an immortal [food].
Or they should be performed, because [that statement] is an explanatory praise, and because the two serve to create contact.

sanskrit_iast: akarma vā caturbhir āptivacanāt saha pūrṇaṃ punaś caturavattam /
meaning: अकर्म वा चतुर्भिर् आप्तिवचनात् सह पूर्णं पुनश् चतुरवत्तम् /
text_mt: Or there is non-performance, because the text states completion by four, [as in] 'replenished together, it is again a fourfold portioning'.
Or there is performance, because of the measure of the primary portion; from resemblance, it has that subordinate quality.
And because they have a single portioning.
[Their] completion is by number, because of equality.
If [the two bastings] existed, however, the statement of completion would be meaningless.
Rather, there is an option, because of the single portioning.

sanskrit_iast: sarvavikāre tv abhyasānarthakyaṃ haviṣo hītarasya syād api vā sviṣṭakṛtaḥ syād itarasyānyāyyatvāt /
meaning: सर्वविकारे त्व् अभ्यसानर्थक्यं हविषो हीतरस्य स्याद् अपि वा स्विष्टकृतः स्याद् इतरस्यान्याय्यत्वात् /
text_mt: If, however, [the gold pieces] are a modification of the whole, repetition would be useless, for it would belong to the other sacrificial offering; or it would belong to the Sviṣṭakṛt, because the other is improper.
Or there is non-performance, because the purpose of contact has ceased; therefore, the statement of completion is justified.
As for the consumptions, however, there would be non-performance, because they serve a distinct purpose [of digestion].
Or rather, [consumption] should take place, because swallowing is observed [in the text].
Or the text may refer to the consumption of clarified butter, because in the archetypal sacrifice [gold] is not a subject of consumption.
Or the text refers to gold, as in the offering, because the clarified butter has become subordinate.
In the case of simultaneous offering, there is togetherness, because the consumptions of the Brahman priest are prescribed in the archetypal sacrifice.
And there would be entire possession by them, because of entitlement.
Or rather, there is removal of the person, because they are not expressed [in the injunction].
Because of the removal of the person, it has its own proper time.
Because of having a single purpose, there would be no division.
Giving to the officiating priests would serve only ritual duty, because of the capacity of the root 'to give'.
Or it serves for hiring, because of its connection with work, as in worldly affairs.
And because of the text referring to 'those yoked with the sacrificial fee (dakṣiṇā)'.
And one would not be hired by anything else, since hiring pertains to work serving another.
Because wages are spoken of indeed as an acquisition.
And because of praise by comparison with a hired laborer.
Or it is a preparatory consecration, because the substance serves another purpose.
And because [consumption] is seen in the ritual patron, the others are likewise by resemblance to him.
And likewise, there is textual indication of another purpose.
The selection of the officiating priests, because its purpose is securing services, would not occur in a sacrificial session (sattra), because it is their own work.
And hiring [is absent], because its purpose is that [securing of services].
And there is direct prohibition, just like that of [hired] work.
Or rather, [a gift] would exist, because the prāsarpika [gift] serves only ritual duty.
Not so, because of the word 'sacrificial fee'; therefore, it would be a reiteration of the permanent [fee].

sanskrit_iast: udavasānīyaḥ satradharmā syāt tadaṅgatvāt tatra dāne dharmamātraṃ syāt /
meaning: उदवसानीयः सत्रधर्मा स्यात् तदङ्गत्वात् तत्र दाने धर्ममात्रं स्यात् /
text_mt: The concluding rite (udavasānīyā) should have the characteristics of a sacrificial session, because it is an auxiliary thereof; in that case, the gift would serve only ritual duty.

sanskrit_iast: na tv etat prakṛtitvād vibhaktacoditatvāc ca /
meaning: न त्व् एतत् प्रकृतित्वाद् विभक्तचोदितत्वाच् च /
text_mt: Not so, however, because it is an archetypal sacrifice, and because it is enjoined separately.
However, because of a direct statement, their simultaneous performance would be like a two-sacrifice rite.
There, they should choose other officiating priests.
Rather, [they perform it] individually, because of non-conflict, and because the archetypal sacrifice is connected with a single [patron].
And in the optional sacrifice (kāmeṣṭi), because of the word 'giving'.
And in the case of a hated rival, because of an injunction, there is removal of the sacrificial fee.

meaning: अस्थियज्ञो ऽविप्रतिषेधाद् इतरेषां स्याद् विप्रतिषेधाद् अस्थ्नाम् /
text_mt: The bone sacrifice (asthiyajña) would belong to the others because of non-conflict, [and not to the bones] because of conflict in the case of the bones.
The employment should be as much as is stated.

sanskrit_iast:
yadi tu vacanāt teṣāṃ japasaṃskāram arthaluptaṃ seṣṭi tadarthatvāt /
kratvarthaṃ tu kriyeta guṇabhūtatvāt /
meaning:
यदि तु वचनात् तेषां जपसंस्कारम् अर्थलुप्तं सेष्टि तदर्थत्वात् /
क्रत्वर्थं तु क्रियेत गुणभूतत्वात् /
text_mt:
If, however, [it is performed] due to a direct statement, then their silent muttering and consecration, whose purpose has vanished, along with the offering [are omitted], because [they] serve that purpose.

On the other hand, [it] should be performed serving the sacrificial rite, because [it] has become subordinate.

sanskrit_iast: kāmyāni tu na vidyante kāmā jñānād yathetarasyānucyamānāni /
meaning: काम्यानि तु न विद्यन्ते कामा ज्ञानाद् यथेतरस्यानुच्यमानानि /
text_mt: The optional prayers, however, do not exist, because the desires are unknown, like the unuttered desires of another.
And because of the absence of an object of striving, as in the Sūktavāka formula.
Not so, because they express desire, and because of the absence thereof in the other [who is deceased].

sanskrit_iast: sarvasvārasya diṣṭagatau samāpanaṃ na vidyate karmaṇo jīvasaṃyogāt /
meaning: सर्वस्वारस्य दिष्टगतौ समापनं न विद्यते कर्मणो जीवसंयोगात् /
text_mt: In the Sarvasvāra rite, upon [the sacrificer's] entering into destiny (death), there is no completion of the rite, because the rite is connected with a living person.
Or there should be [completion], because both are directly enjoined by scripture.
Once he has departed, the rite proceeds as in the sacrifice of the bones.
While he is alive, there is no utterance of the prayer for long life, because it serves that purpose.
Or there is an utterance, because he is an entitled participant prior to what has been stated.
There should be performance of only the prescriptive duties.
If the fistful is omitted, however, the omission of the number would occur, because it is an attribute thereof.

sanskrit_iast: saṃkhyā tu codanāṃ prati sāmānyāt tadvikāraḥ saṃyogāc ca paraṃ muṣṭheḥ /
meaning: संख्या तु चोदनां प्रति सामान्यात् तद्विकारः संयोगाच् च परं मुष्ठेः /
text_mt: The number, however, relates to the injunction because it is generic; its modification [occurs], and in connection with it, it is beyond the fistful.
Not so, because of its syntactical relation to the injunction, since in the archetypal sacrifice it is connected with a preparatory purification.

sanskrit_iast: autpattike tu dravyato vikāraḥ syād akāryātvāt /
meaning: औत्पत्तिके तु द्रव्यतो विकारः स्याद् अकार्यात्वात् /
text_mt: In the primordial relation, however, modification would result from the substance, because it is not an effect.

sanskrit_iast: naimittike tu kāryatvāt prakṛteḥ syāt tadāpatteḥ /
meaning: नैमित्तिके तु कार्यत्वात् प्रकृतेः स्यात् तदापत्तेः /
text_mt: In the occasional rite, however, being an effect, it would derive from the archetypal sacrifice, because it has attained that state.

sanskrit_iast: vipratiṣedhe tadvacanāt prākṛtaguṇalopaḥ syāt tena ca karmasaṃyogāt /
meaning: विप्रतिषेधे तद्वचनात् प्राकृतगुणलोपः स्यात् तेन च कर्मसंयोगात् /
text_mt: In case of conflict, because of that direct statement, an omission of the archetypal secondary quality would occur, and because the rite is connected through that.
There would be a prohibition of the subsequent ones.
In the absence of a distinct purpose, it would be a preparatory purification.
And when reversed with the purpose, its true nature would remain identical because of serving that purpose.

sanskrit_iast: vikṛtau śabdavattvāt pradhānasya guṇānām adhikotpattiḥ sannidhānāt /
meaning: विकृतौ शब्दवत्त्वात् प्रधानस्य गुणानाम् अधिकोत्पत्तिः सन्निधानात् /
text_mt: In the ectypal sacrifice, because the primary element is expressed by the word, the additional production of secondary qualities occurs due to proximity.
And there is non-obstruction of it, as in the archetypal sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: pradhānaṃ tv aṅgasaṃyuktaṃ tathābhūtam apūrvaṃ syāt tasya vidhyupalakṣaṇāt sarvo hi pūrvavān vidhir aviśeṣāt pravartitaḥ /
meaning: प्रधानं त्व् अङ्गसंयुक्तं तथाभूतम् अपूर्वं स्यात् तस्य विध्युपलक्षणात् सर्वो हि पूर्ववान् विधिर् अविशेषात् प्रवर्तितः /
text_mt: The primary rite, however, being connected with subsidiaries, would produce an unprecedented transcendental potency as so constituted, because it is indicated by the injunctive rule; for every injunctive rule possessing a precedent operates without distinction.
And an injunctive rule for a subsidiary element cannot apply to a non-subsidiary.

sanskrit_iast: karmaṇaś caikaśabdyāt sannidhāne vidher ākhyāsaṃyogo guṇena tadvikāraḥ syāc chabdasya vidhigāmitvād guṇasya copadeśyatvāt /
meaning: कर्मणश् चैकशब्द्यात् सन्निधाने विधेर् आख्यासंयोगो गुणेन तद्विकारः स्याच् छब्दस्य विधिगामित्वाद् गुणस्य चोपदेश्यत्वात् /
text_mt: And because the ritual action is expressed by a single word in proximity to the injunctive rule, the connection with the proper name would be its modification by the secondary quality, because the word goes to an injunctive rule and a secondary quality is to be directly taught.
If it is argued that in this way everything is the primary rite—
[We reply:] because of connection with what is thus constituted, the injunctive rules would accord with their beneficial purposes.

sanskrit_iast: vidhitvaṃ cāviśiṣṭham evaṃ prākṛtānāṃ vaikṛtaiḥ karmaṇāyogāt tasmāt sarvaṃ pradhānārtham /
meaning: विधित्वं चाविशिष्ठम् एवं प्राकृतानां वैकृतैः कर्मणायोगात् तस्मात् सर्वं प्रधानार्थम् /
text_mt: And injunctive force is indistinguishable; thus, because the archetypal elements cannot be combined into one action with ectypal elements, therefore everything serves the purpose of the primary rite.

sanskrit_iast: samatvāc ca tadutpatteḥ saṃskārair adhikāraḥ syāt /
meaning: समत्वाच् च तदुत्पत्तेः संस्कारैर् अधिकारः स्यात् /
text_mt: And because of the equality of its arising, ritual eligibility would exist through the preparatory purifications.
The 'Hiraṇyagarbha' formula belongs to the first, because of the indicative textual mark of the Vedic recitation.
And because of non-obstruction of the archetypal sacrifice.
Or it belongs to the subsequent one, because of the meaning-requirement of the Vedic recitation.

sanskrit_iast: vidhyatideśāt tacchrutau vikāraḥ syād guṇānām upadeśyatvāt /
meaning: विध्यतिदेशात् तच्छ्रुतौ विकारः स्याद् गुणानाम् उपदेश्यत्वात् /
text_mt: Due to the extended application of the injunctive rule, upon hearing that, a modification would occur, because secondary qualities are to be directly taught.
And because absence of a Vedic recitation is seen in the first.
In the case of a preparatory purification, however, it is another action, because it enjoins that.
And because of non-obstruction of the archetypal sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: vidhes tu tatra bhāvāt sandehe yasya śabdas tadarthaḥ syāt /
meaning: विधेस् तु तत्र भावात् सन्देहे यस्य शब्दस् तदर्थः स्यात् /
text_mt: Because the injunctive rule is present there, in case of doubt, the purpose would belong to that which the word expresses.
Because of the capacity of the preparatory purification and because of connection with the secondary quality.
Because of conflict, it would belong in the context of the ritual action.
In the text 'He consecrates with six', there is a modification of those Vedic recitations, because of direct scriptural connection.
Rather, it is due to repetition of the primary rite.
The ritual action with Vedic recitations would occur through repetition.

sanskrit_iast: api vā pratimantratvāt prākṛtānām ahāniḥ syād anyāyaś ca kṛte 'bhyāsaḥ /
meaning: अपि वा प्रतिमन्त्रत्वात् प्राकृतानाम् अहानिः स्याद् अन्यायश् च कृते ऽभ्यासः /
text_mt: Or rather, because there is one Vedic recitation per action, there would be no abandonment of the archetypal ones, and repetition when already done is improper.
And sequence is not possible in repetition, because it is an occasional rite.
And [scripture] shows their separateness.
And there would not be a designation without distinction.

sanskrit_iast: agnyādheyasya naimittike guṇavikāre dakṣiṇādānam adhikaṃ syād vākyasaṃyogāt /
meaning: अग्न्याधेयस्य नैमित्तिके गुणविकारे दक्षिणादानम् अधिकं स्याद् वाक्यसंयोगात् /
text_mt: In the occasional modification of a secondary quality of the establishment of the fires, the giving of the sacrificial fee would be an addition, because of the sentential context.
And because the other ones are enjoined in their proper textual positions.
It is a modification, however, because outside the context of the ritual topic they are optional rites.

sanskrit_iast: śaṅkate ca nivṛtter ubhayatvaṃ hi śrūyate /
meaning: शङ्कते च निवृत्तेर् उभयत्वं हि श्रूयते /
text_mt: And there is doubt regarding cessation, for both are heard in scripture.
The garment and the calf also, due to similarity.
Due to necessary presumption of purpose, its prescriptive duties would apply, because of connection with the occasional name.
In the gift, cooking is indicated by the practical purpose.
And cooking is present because it produces food.
In proximity to the injunction of substances, the number would belong to them, because it is their attribute.
Rather, because the secondary qualities are equal, it relates to one, because of direct scriptural connection.

sanskrit_iast: yasya vā sannidhāne syād vākyato hy abhisambandhaḥ /
meaning: यस्य वा सन्निधाने स्याद् वाक्यतो ह्य् अभिसम्बन्धः /
text_mt: Or it would belong to that in whose proximity it stands, for the syntactical connection arises from the sentential context.

sanskrit_iast: asaṃyuktās tu tulyavad itarābhir vidhīyante tasmāt sarvādhikāraḥ syāt /
meaning: असंयुक्तास् तु तुल्यवद् इतराभिर् विधीयन्ते तस्मात् सर्वाधिकारः स्यात् /
text_mt: But [the others], being unconnected, are enjoined on a par with the rest; therefore, they would apply to all.

sanskrit_iast: asaṃyogād vidhiśrutāv ekajātādhikāraḥ syāc chrutyākopāt kratoḥ /
meaning: असंयोगाद् विधिश्रुताव् एकजाताधिकारः स्याच् छ्रुत्याकोपात् क्रतोः /
text_mt: Because there is no connection in the injunctive text, it should apply to a single class, so that the direct scriptural statement of the rite is not violated.
And the meaning of the word is just as in worldly usage.
[It belongs] to the animal [sacrifices], because of their original division.
Or rather, it must belong to the cows, because they are the recipients of shares.
In that case, the giving is by division, because the donations are distinct.
And [scripture] also shows the division.

sanskrit_iast: atulyāḥ syuḥ parikraye viṣamākhyā vidhiśrutau parikrayān na karmaṇy upapadyate darśanād viśeṣasya tathābhyudaye /
meaning: अतुल्याः स्युः परिक्रये विषमाख्या विधिश्रुतौ परिक्रयान् न कर्मण्य् उपपद्यते दर्शनाद् विशेषस्य तथाभ्युदये /
text_mt: They cannot be equal in the hiring; there are unequal designations in the injunctive text; because it is a hiring, [equality] does not hold for the work, since a distinction is seen; and likewise at the sunrise.

sanskrit_iast: tasya dhenur iti gavāṃ prakṛtau vibhaktacoditatvāt sāmānyāt tadvikāraḥ syād yatheṣṭir guṇaśabdena /
meaning: तस्य धेनुर् इति गवां प्रकृतौ विभक्तचोदितत्वात् सामान्यात् तद्विकारः स्याद् यथेष्टिर् गुणशब्देन /
text_mt: In the case of "his milch cow", because cows are enjoined as divided in the archetypal sacrifice, it should be a modification of that on account of generic similarity, just as the isṭi is by means of a qualitative word.

sanskrit_iast: sarvasya vā kratusaṃyogād ekatvaṃ dakṣiṇārthasya guṇānāṃ kāryaikatvād arthe vikṛtau śrutibhūtaṃ syāt tasmāt samavāyād dhi karmabhiḥ /
meaning: सर्वस्य वा क्रतुसंयोगाद् एकत्वं दक्षिणार्थस्य गुणानां कार्यैकत्वाद् अर्थे विकृतौ श्रुतिभूतं स्यात् तस्मात् समवायाद् धि कर्मभिः /
text_mt: Or rather, because everything is connected with the rite, the purpose of the sacrificial fee is single; because the secondary items share a single function, it would constitute a direct scriptural statement in the purpose in the ectypal sacrifice; therefore, indeed, because of its combination with the actions.
Because the injunctions have no [other] basis, there should be a restriction by means of an indicative textual mark.
And likewise is seen the indicative textual mark.

sanskrit_iast: eke tu śrutibhūtatvāt saṅkhyayā gavāṃ liṅgaviśeṣeṇa /
meaning: एके तु श्रुतिभूतत्वात् सङ्ख्यया गवां लिङ्गविशेषेण /
text_mt: Some, however, [say that] because it serves as a direct scriptural statement, [it applies] through the number of cows by means of the distinctive indicative mark.

sanskrit_iast: api tv avayavārthatvād vibhaktaprakṛtitvād guṇedantāvikāraḥ syāt /
meaning: अपि त्व् अवयवार्थत्वाद् विभक्तप्रकृतित्वाद् गुणेदन्ताविकारः स्यात् /
text_mt: No; because they serve the purpose of a part, and because the archetypal sacrifice is divided, it must be a modification of a secondary quality and specificity.

sanskrit_iast: dhenuvac cāśvadakṣiṇā sa brahmaṇa iti puruṣāpanayo yathā hiraṇyasya /
meaning: धेनुवच् चाश्वदक्षिणा स ब्रह्मण इति पुरुषापनयो यथा हिरण्यस्य /
text_mt: And like the milch cow, the horse sacrificial fee, with the words "It belongs to the brahman priest", is a removal of the person, just like the gold.

sanskrit_iast: eke tu kartṛsaṃyogāt sragvat tasya liṅgaviśeṣeṇa /
meaning: एके तु कर्तृसंयोगात् स्रग्वत् तस्य लिङ्गविशेषेण /
text_mt: Some, however, [say that] because of connection with the agent, like the garland, it is through his distinctive mark.

sanskrit_iast: api vā tadadhikārād dhiraṇyavad vikāraḥ syāt /
meaning: अपि वा तदधिकाराद् धिरण्यवद् विकारः स्यात् /
text_mt: Or rather, because of his ritual eligibility, it must be a modification, like the gold.
Or it is a modification of the whole, because the animals are prohibited in that which serves the sacrificial rite.
If it is said that it is undifferentiated in the gift to the brahman priest—

sanskrit_iast: utsargasya kratvarthatvāt pratiṣiddhasya karma syānn a ca gauṇaḥ prayojanam arthaḥ sa dakṣiṇānāṃ syāt /
meaning: उत्सर्गस्य क्रत्वर्थत्वात् प्रतिषिद्धस्य कर्म स्यान्न् अ च गौणः प्रयोजनम् अर्थः स दक्षिणानां स्यात् /
text_mt: Because giving away serves the sacrificial rite, the action would apply to what is prohibited, and a secondary meaning cannot be the purpose; that must be the purpose of the sacrificial fees.

sanskrit_iast: yadi tu brahmaṇas tadūnaṃ tadvikāraḥ syāt /
meaning: यदि तु ब्रह्मणस् तदूनं तद्विकारः स्यात् /
text_mt: If, however, it belongs to the brahman priest, what is deficient therein would be its modification.
Or it is the whole, because of the removal of the persons, since they are principal to the rite.
In the case of "yoked with a yajus", the adhvaryu priest's sacrificial fee would be a modification.

sanskrit_iast: api vā śrutibhūtatvāt sarvāsāṃ tasya bhāgo niyamyate /
meaning: अपि वा श्रुतिभूतत्वात् सर्वासां तस्य भागो नियम्यते /
text_mt: Or rather, because it is directly stated by scripture, his share of all of them is restricted.
Because there is no connection with the indicative mark of the archetypal sacrifice, the ritual consecration in the ectypal sacrifice must be additional.
When there is a connection with the indicative mark of the injunction, it would be recognized as a modification of that, because of proximity to the archetypal sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: sarvatra tu grahāmnānam adhikaṃ syāt prakṛtivat /
meaning: सर्वत्र तु ग्रहाम्नानम् अधिकं स्यात् प्रकृतिवत् /
text_mt: Everywhere, however, the mention of the cups must be additional, just as in the archetypal sacrifice.
And because there is a single unified statement with the additional ones.
And because of the mention among the Prajāpatya offerings.
In the case of the Upagas, it should be like the reed, because of connection with the indicative mark of the archetypal sacrifice.
On the contrary, it must be additional, so that it is not purposeless.
And because, in the consecration, there is connection with something else.

sanskrit_iast: ācchādane tv aikārthyāt prākṛtasya vikāraḥ syāt /
meaning: आच्छादने त्व् ऐकार्थ्यात् प्राकृतस्य विकारः स्यात् /
text_mt: In the case of the covering, however, because of identity of purpose, it must be a modification of the archetypal one.
Or it is additional, because it serves another purpose.
And [scripture] shows cumulative application.
In the case of the Sāman melodies, because another purpose is heard in scripture, it should be understood as non-modification.

sanskrit_iast: arthe tv aśrūyamāṇe śeṣatvāt prākṛtasya vikāraḥ syāt /
meaning: अर्थे त्व् अश्रूयमाणे शेषत्वात् प्राकृतस्य विकारः स्यात् /
text_mt: When, however, the purpose is not heard, it must be a modification of the archetypal one, because it is an accessory.
Or of one only, because of the force of the direct scriptural statement, and because the archetypal model is not modified.

sanskrit_iast: stomavibṛddhau tv adhikaṃ syād avibṛddhau dravyavikāraḥ syād itarasyāśrutitvāc ca /
meaning: स्तोमविबृद्धौ त्व् अधिकं स्याद् अविबृद्धौ द्रव्यविकारः स्याद् इतरस्याश्रुतित्वाच् च /
text_mt: When there is an increase of stomas, however, it must be additional; when there is no increase, it must be a modification of the substance, and because the other is not heard in scripture.
The two should be in the pavamāna chant, because insertion and excision are observed therein.
The statements, however, [are authoritative], because they are unprecedented.

sanskrit_iast: vidhiśabdasya mantratve bhāvaḥ syāt tena codanā /
meaning: विधिशब्दस्य मन्त्रत्वे भावः स्यात् तेन चोदना /
text_mt: When an injunctive word is a mantra, its presence holds, and by means of it the injunction operates.

sanskrit_iast: śeṣāṇāṃ vā codanaikatvāt tasmāt sarvatra śrūyate /
meaning: शेषाणां वा चोदनैकत्वात् तस्मात् सर्वत्र श्रूयते /
text_mt: Or rather, because the injunction of the subsidiary parts is single, therefore it is heard everywhere.
Likewise in the subsequent performance, because it has that as its archetypal sacrifice.
When a quality of the archetypal element is directly stated, the designation must be by means of that which has the quality.
Or there should be no modification, because the word expressing the object does not disappear, just as in the case of the substance.

sanskrit_iast: tathārambhāsamavāyād vā coditenābhidhānaṃ syād arthasya śrutisamavāyitvād avacane ca guṇaśāstram anarthakaṃ syāt /
meaning: तथारम्भासमवायाद् वा चोदितेनाभिधानं स्याद् अर्थस्य श्रुतिसमवायित्वाद् अवचने च गुणशास्त्रम् अनर्थकं स्यात् /
text_mt: Or, because there is no connection at the commencement [in the base paradigm], the designation should be by what is directly enjoined, since the object is connected with direct scriptural statement; and if it is not uttered, the teaching of the secondary quality would be meaningless.
With regard to substances, because they pertain to the commencement [of action], there is modification with respect to the purpose, owing to functional capacity.
[The mention] 'having budha' is like 'pavamāna', because of the specification of a distinguishing quality.
Because of the specific direction in the mantra, there should be no modification of the deity.

sanskrit_iast: vidhinigamabhedāt prakṛtau tatprakṛtitvād vikṛtāv api bhedaḥ syāt /
meaning: विधिनिगमभेदात् प्रकृतौ तत्प्रकृतित्वाद् विकृताव् अपि भेदः स्यात् /
text_mt: Because there is a distinction between the injunctive rule and the ritual mention in the base paradigm, and because it has that as its archetype, there should be a distinction in the modified rite as well.
Or as has been stated, because of contradiction, there is no injunction [of modification].
When the deity of the sviṣṭakṛt is different, [the original name] should cease, because [the mantra] contains that word.
Or there is connection, because of the presumption of fact, since designation arises from the action.
In the case of [a deity] possessed of a secondary quality, when the quality is omitted, in the ritual mentions only what is stated should remain.
Or all [should remain], because of single ritual purpose.

sanskrit_iast: sviṣṭakṛd āvāpiko 'nuyāje syāt prayojanavad aṅgānām arthasaṃyogāt /
meaning: स्विष्टकृद् आवापिको ऽनुयाजे स्यात् प्रयोजनवद् अङ्गानाम् अर्थसंयोगात् /
text_mt: The additional sviṣṭakṛt should occur in the after-offering, like that which has a purpose, because of the connection of the subsidiaries with the beneficial purpose.
And because [the text] says 'he recites', it should be an action like the recitation of hymns, owing to a separate injunction.
Or it is a preparatory purification, because the enjoined word serves the purpose of utterance.
In the case of the Manotā hymn, however, by virtue of direct statement there should be no modification.

meaning: पृष्ठार्थे ऽन्यद् रथन्तरात् तद्योनिपूर्वत्वाद् ऋचां प्रविभक्तत्वात् /
text_mt: For the purpose of the pṛṣṭha stotra, [the verse] should be other than the Rathantara, because it has its matrix verse preceding, and because the verses are distinctly divided.
Or it should be upon its own matrix verse, because the name applies to the whole.
Because they are products, the latter two [verses] should be in accordance with the base paradigm.
Or both have the same deity, because of the indivisibility of the triplet.

sanskrit_iast: grahāṇāṃ devatānyatve stutaśastrayoḥ karmatvād avikāraḥ syāt /
meaning: ग्रहाणां देवतान्यत्वे स्तुतशस्त्रयोः कर्मत्वाद् अविकारः स्यात् /
text_mt: When the deity of the cups is different, there should be no modification of the stotra and śastra, because they are actions [directed toward another end].

sanskrit_iast: ubhayapānāt pṛṣadājye dadhnaḥ syād upalakṣaṇaṃ nigameṣu pātavyasyopalakṣaṇāt /
meaning: उभयपानात् पृषदाज्ये दध्नः स्याद् उपलक्षणं निगमेषु पातव्यस्योपलक्षणात् /
text_mt: Because both are consumed, in speckled clarified butter there should be an implied reference to the curd, because in the ritual mentions what is to be drunk is referred to.
Or rather not, because it serves another's purpose, just like the sacrificer.
Or it should be [referred to], because invocation is for its sake.
Or rather not, because the word denotes a preparatory purification.
Or it should be, because of the designation of the substance.

sanskrit_iast: dadhnas tu guṇabhūtatvād ājyapānigamāḥ syur guṇatvaṃ śruter ājyapradhānatvāt /
meaning: दध्नस् तु गुणभूतत्वाद् आज्यपानिगमाः स्युर् गुणत्वं श्रुतेर् आज्यप्रधानत्वात् /
text_mt: Curd, however, being subordinate, the ritual mentions should refer to drinkers of clarified butter; its subordination is from direct scriptural statement, because clarified butter is the principal element.

sanskrit_iast: dadhi vā syāt pradhānam ājye prathamāntyasaṃyogāt /
meaning: दधि वा स्यात् प्रधानम् आज्ये प्रथमान्त्यसंयोगात् /
text_mt: Or curd should be the principal element, because of its connection with the first and the last [in the compound] clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast: api vājyapradhānatvād guṇārthe vyapadeśe bhaktyā saṃskāraśabdaḥ syāt /
meaning: अपि वाज्यप्रधानत्वाद् गुणार्थे व्यपदेशे भक्त्या संस्कारशब्दः स्यात् /
text_mt: Or rather, because clarified butter is the principal element, when designated in a subordinate sense the word expressive of consecration would be figurative.
Or rather, because it is a modification of the name, there should be implied reference through that.
Or rather it should not be so, because it is an injunctive rule of a secondary quality.
In the taking of a portion from those having a fixed sequence, the omission should be of the final, as in the case of insertion.
According to the order, an addition should occur at the end.
The indicative textual mark is non-distinct, for that statement refers to the number.

sanskrit_iast: ādito vā pravṛttiḥ syād ārambhasya tadāditvād vacanād antyavidhiḥ syāt /
meaning: आदितो वा प्रवृत्तिः स्याद् आरम्भस्य तदादित्वाद् वचनाद् अन्त्यविधिः स्यात् /
text_mt: Or the commencement should be from the beginning, because commencement begins with that; the rule regarding the final would be due to direct statement.
In the Ekatrika rite, [the selection should be] from the beginning of the triplets at the midday pressing, because the meters are directly expressed by scriptural statement.
Or [it should be] from the beginning, because that is the rule, the other being inferential.
And according to arrangement, as in the base paradigm, because it is a modification only of the number.
A triplet should occur in the triplet of the dhurya.
Or upon a single verse, because the stoma has the characteristic of repetition.

sanskrit_iast: codanāsu tv apūrvatvāl liṅgena dharmaniyamaḥ syāt /
meaning: चोदनासु त्व् अपूर्वत्वाल् लिङ्गेन धर्मनियमः स्यात् /
text_mt: In the injunctions, however, because of their being primary originations, the restrictive determination of the rule would be by means of an indicative textual mark.
The application, however, is due to the connection with the word 'rātri'.

sanskrit_iast: apūrvāsu tu saṅkhyāsu vikalpaḥ syāt sarvāsām arthavattvāt /
meaning: अपूर्वासु तु सङ्ख्यासु विकल्पः स्यात् सर्वासाम् अर्थवत्त्वात् /
text_mt: With regard to primary numbers, however, there should be an option, because all of them have a beneficial purpose.

sanskrit_iast: stomavivṛddhau prākṛtānām abhyāsena saṅkhyāpūraṇam avikārāt saṅkhyāyāṃ guṇaśabdatvād anyasya cāśrutitvāt /
meaning: स्तोमविवृद्धौ प्राकृतानाम् अभ्यासेन सङ्ख्यापूरणम् अविकारात् सङ्ख्यायां गुणशब्दत्वाद् अन्यस्य चाश्रुतित्वात् /
text_mt: When the stoma is increased, the completion of the number is by repetition of the archetypal [verses], because of non-modification, because in the number there is a secondary quality, and because any other is not directly stated by scripture.
Or by insertion, because repetition is not directly stated by scripture;
And because number is applied to distinct entities;
There can be an injunctive rule of measure for those enjoined by functional purpose;
And the statement of insertion is not compatible with repetition;
And because of the capacity of the original production of the Sāman chants.
In the Bahiṣpavamāna there is no insertion of ṛc verses, because the Sāman chant is one.
The completion of the number, however, is by repetition in the case of the sāmidhenī verses, because the base paradigm has repetition.
it should be so, because it shares that characteristic; as in the archetypal sacrifice, there should be repetition until the number is filled;
or rather, only as far as stated, because a fixed measure has been established;
The Ṣoḍaśin cup belongs to the ectypal sacrifice, because it is fully enjoined there;
and because its absence is observed in the archetypal sacrifice;
the textual mention is for the sake of exclusive specification;
Its drawing is [done] after the Āgrayaṇa cup;
It should be at the third pressing, because of direct statement;
in case of no repetition, because the word 'parāk' ('beyond') has that purpose;
and because of the statement regarding the separation of the Ukthya.
Or rather, after the Āgrayaṇa, because the word 'parāk' denotes a place, as in the case of the Punarādheya;
and the separation is on account of a common stoma.

sanskrit_iast: ukthyāgniṣṭomasaṃyogād astutaśastraḥ syāt sati hi saṃsthānyatvam /
meaning: उक्थ्याग्निष्टोमसंयोगाद् अस्तुतशस्त्रः स्यात् सति हि संस्थान्यत्वम् /
text_mt: Because of connection with Ukthya and Agniṣṭoma, it would be without chant and recitation; for when it exists, there is a difference of terminal form.
Or rather, it has chant and recitation, because they are its subsidiaries;
the difference of terminal form is due to direct scriptural statement.
Because of absence [elsewhere], it is drawn in the Atirātra rites;
or rather, it has general application, because it is enjoined without specific context.

sanskrit_iast: caturthecaturthe 'hany ahīnasya gṛhyata ity abhyāsena pratīyeta bhojanavat /
meaning: चतुर्थेचतुर्थे ऽहन्य् अहीनस्य गृह्यत इत्य् अभ्यासेन प्रतीयेत भोजनवत् /
text_mt: In the statement 'on every fourth day of an ahīna it is drawn,' it should be understood as repetition [within a single sacrifice], as in the case of eating;

sanskrit_iast: api vā saṅkhyāvattvān nānāhīneṣu gṛhyate pakṣavad ekasmin saṃkhyārthabhāvāt /
meaning: अपि वा सङ्ख्यावत्त्वान् नानाहीनेषु गृह्यते पक्षवद् एकस्मिन् संख्यार्थभावात् /
text_mt: or rather, having a numerical specification, it is drawn in distinct ahīnas, as in the case of a fortnight, because within a single [sacrifice] the purpose of the number does not exist;
in the case of eating, that number would indeed apply [differently].
In the case of the Jagatsāman rite, since the sāman is absent, the sāman and its designation would proceed from the ṛc verse;
in a rite having both sāmans, the incidental action would be by alternative adoption, because of equality;
or rather, through the frustration of the occasion, the action should belong to the one combined with the sacrifice.
Because of the statement of priority for the Aindravāyava cup, there should be anticipation from the very beginning;

sanskrit_iast: api vā dharmāviśeṣāt taddharmāṇāṃ svasthāne prakaraṇād agratvam ucyate /
meaning: अपि वा धर्माविशेषात् तद्धर्माणां स्वस्थाने प्रकरणाद् अग्रत्वम् उच्यते /
text_mt: or rather, because the ritual characteristics do not differ, priority is stated for those having that ritual characteristic in their own place, on account of the context;

sanskrit_iast: kāmasaṃyoge tu vacanād āditaḥ pratikarṣaḥ syāt /
meaning: कामसंयोगे तु वचनाद् आदितः प्रतिकर्षः स्यात् /
text_mt: However, in connection with a specific desire, because of direct statement, there should be anticipation from the very beginning;

sanskrit_iast: taddeśānāṃ vāgrasaṃyogāt tadyuktaṃ kāmaśāstraṃ syān nityasaṃyogāt /
meaning: तद्देशानां वाग्रसंयोगात् तद्युक्तं कामशास्त्रं स्यान् नित्यसंयोगात् /
text_mt: or rather, because of connection with priority in their own place, the rule for desire would be connected with that, owing to connection with the obligatory;
and with regard to the subsequent cups, the word 'priority' would apply as before, to those headed by that;
or rather, there is anticipation, because priority does not have that connection with the purpose of the obligatory;
and [scripture] shows anticipation;
because the priority of the Aindravāyava has a designated place before;
and likewise an indicative textual mark is observed.
The offering also [is anticipated], just like the setting down.

sanskrit_iast: na vā pradhānatvāc cheṣatvāt sādanaṃ tathā /
meaning: न वा प्रधानत्वाच् छेषत्वात् सादनं तथा /
text_mt: Not so; because it is the principal rite, whereas the setting down is such because it is a subsidiary element.
In the tryanīkā arrangement, the textual mention regarding cases established by general rule must be for the purpose of a secondary detail;
or rather, in groups of days, there should be an equal injunction, as in the case of the fires;
the modified and unmodified forms of the Dvādaśāha should be governed by equal injunction, like the Pṛṣṭha;
or rather, the modified form [vyūḍha] is a modification of the unmodified form [samūḍha], because an indicative textual mark is observed;
and its application occurs in both ways, because it is a single action.
Like the set of eleven animals, the tryanīkā should involve a cyclical recurrence;
or rather, there is expansion in their own places, because the days do not have directly perceptible numbers;

sanskrit_iast: pṛṣṭhyāvṛttau cāgrayaṇasya darśanāt trayastriṃśe parivṛttau punaraindravāyavaḥ syāt /
meaning: पृष्ठ्यावृत्तौ चाग्रयणस्य दर्शनात् त्रयस्त्रिंशे परिवृत्तौ पुनरैन्द्रवायवः स्यात् /
text_mt: and because upon the repetition of the Pṛṣṭhya, the Āgrayaṇa is observed, upon repetition on the thirty-third day, the Aindravāyava should occur again;
the cyclical recurrence among the sets of eleven is due to direct statement;

sanskrit_iast: chandovyatikramād vyūḍhe bhakṣapavamānaparidhikapālasyama ntrāṇāṃ yathotpattivacanam ūhavat syāt /
meaning: छन्दोव्यतिक्रमाद् व्यूढे भक्षपवमानपरिधिकपालस्यम न्त्राणां यथोत्पत्तिवचनम् ऊहवत् स्यात् /
text_mt: Because of the transposition of metres in the Vyūḍha [Dvādaśāha], the recitation according to their original form of the mantras for the cup-drinking, the Pavamāna hymns, the enclosing sticks, and the potsherds would be like an adaptative modification of formulas.
[The mantras for single-verse cups] should be situated on a single verse in the sacrifice, as in the personal Vedic study.
Looking at the Svardṛś [verse] is merely an indication of time, because it serves another purpose.
Because of the simultaneous injunctive rule of the Pṛṣṭha [sāmans], there is the possession of two sāmans, as in the single-day sacrifice.
Or rather, [they are applied] in division, because of the collective injunction; in its division, there would be a conflict.
But there is combination in the case of the sets of eleven [victims], because of having that [archetype] as base paradigm.
Or rather, according to direct scriptural statement, there should be a distribution, as in ordinary life.
No, because of equality, as in the case of the fore-offerings.

sanskrit_iast: sarvapṛṣṭhe pṛṣṭhaśabdāt teṣāṃ syād ekadeśatvaṃ pṛṣṭhasya kṛtadeśatvāt /
meaning: सर्वपृष्ठे पृष्ठशब्दात् तेषां स्याद् एकदेशत्वं पृष्ठस्य कृतदेशत्वात् /
text_mt: In the Sarvapṛṣṭha rite, because of the word 'Pṛṣṭha', they would form a part, because the Pṛṣṭha has an assigned place.
However, the injunctive rule would suffer an excessive removal.
That which has the Vairūpa sāman would have a single sāman, because of its connection with the sacrificial rite, as in the case of the Trivṛt [stoma].
Or rather, it is for the sake of the Pṛṣṭha, because of the connection with the indicative textual mark of the base paradigm.
No, because in the base paradigm it is not connected with the whole.
In case of doubt, it would be [governed] by that principle, because the ritual action is not divided.
In the Trivṛt, as a number, there would be a modification of all numbers.
Or rather, [it is a modification] of the stoma, because it has its characteristic mark.
In the case of that which has both sāmans, there would be a distribution, as in the Viśvajit.
Or rather, it is for the purpose of the Pṛṣṭha, because it does not serve that [other] purpose.

sanskrit_iast: pṛṣṭhe rasabhojanam āvṛtte saṃsthite trayastriṃśe 'hani syāt tadānantaryāt prakṛtivat /
meaning: पृष्ठे रसभोजनम् आवृत्ते संस्थिते त्रयस्त्रिंशे ऽहनि स्यात् तदानन्तर्यात् प्रकृतिवत् /
text_mt: In the Pṛṣṭha [stotra], the eating of sweet juice should take place when the thirty-third day has completed its turn, because of immediate sequence to that, as in the base paradigm.

sanskrit_iast: abhyāse ca tadabhyāsaḥ karmaṇaḥ punaḥ prayogāt /
meaning: अभ्यासे च तदभ्यासः कर्मणः पुनः प्रयोगात् /
text_mt: And in the case of repetition, there should be its repetition, because of the repeated performance of the ritual action.
Repetition, however, would occur when there is an intervention, on account of the difference in time.
The consecrated patrons should not consume honey, because they are students of sacred learning.
It should be consumed, because it serves the purpose of the sacrificial rite.
The Mānasa cup would be a distinct day, because of its distinct designation.
And the injunction [of another action] comes after the end of the day.
The number applies to the fortnight, as in the case of the thousand.
Or rather, it is a subsidiary element of the day, like the Aṃśu [cup], because there is no injunction [as a distinct day].
And because there is a statement about the tenth discharge.
And because of the rule of secondary qualification stating 'on the tenth day'.
And because, in the case of a surplus of sacrificial animals, one is present.
The mention by way of eulogy would be contradicted by being a subsidiary element, as in the case of the Vrata.
A single person [performs] a sacrificial session, as in the base paradigm.
However, by virtue of direct statement, it must belong to many.
And [scripture] shows a joint offering.
And the qualifying statement 'of many' would be meaningless in the case of a single person.
Others should be the officiating priests, as in the base paradigm.

sanskrit_iast: api vā yajamānāḥ syur ṛtvijām abhidhānasaṃyogāt teṣāṃ syād yajamānatvam /
meaning: अपि वा यजमानाः स्युर् ऋत्विजाम् अभिधानसंयोगात् तेषां स्याद् यजमानत्वम् /
text_mt: Or rather, the sacrificers themselves should be [the officiating priests], because of their connection with the designation of officiating priests; they possess the status of sacrificer.
If it be argued that it is a preparatory purification of the agent by virtue of direct statement, as in the case of the consecrator of sacred fires—
In case of doubt, it would be [governed] by that principle, as in the base paradigm.
If it be argued that they are called 'owners', as in the case of the householder—
No, because conventional usage is adopted for that which is not connected with its ritual properties.
And the designation of 'consecrated' and 'unconsecrated' would not be appropriate, because both states are obligatory.

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśāhasya satratvam āsanopāyicodanena yajamānabahutvena ca satraśabdābhisaṃyogāt /
meaning: द्वादशाहस्य सत्रत्वम् आसनोपायिचोदनेन यजमानबहुत्वेन च सत्रशब्दाभिसंयोगात् /
text_mt: The twelve-day rite is a sacrificial session because of the injunction using the terms 'they sit' and 'they undertake', and because of the plurality of sacrificers, through connection with the word 'sattra'.
[Its] character as a multi-day sacrifice [follows] from the injunctive use of the root yaj- ('to sacrifice') and because the number of masters is not fixed.

sanskrit_iast: ahīne dakṣiṇāśāstraṃ guṇatvāt pratyaha karmabhedaḥ syāt /
meaning: अहीने दक्षिणाशास्त्रं गुणत्वात् प्रत्यह कर्मभेदः स्यात् /
text_mt: In a multi-day sacrifice, the rule concerning sacrificial fees, being a secondary factor, would differ for each day.
Or rather, [they are given for] the whole [rite], because it is a single action.
Or, like the speckled clarified butter, there would be an injunction of a secondary factor for the [individual] days.

sanskrit_iast: jyautiṣṭomyas tu dakṣiṇāḥ sarvāsām ekakarmatvāt prakṛtivat tasmān nāsāṃ vikāraḥ syāt /
meaning: ज्यौतिष्टोम्यस् तु दक्षिणाः सर्वासाम् एककर्मत्वात् प्रकृतिवत् तस्मान् नासां विकारः स्यात् /
text_mt: The sacrificial fees, however, are those of the Jyotiṣṭoma rite, because all [days] constitute a single action, as in the archetypal sacrifice; therefore there should be no modification of them.

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśāhe tu vacanāt pratyahaṃ dakṣiṇābhedas tatprakṛtitvāt pareṣu tāsāṃ saṃkhyāvikāraḥ syāt /
meaning: द्वादशाहे तु वचनात् प्रत्यहं दक्षिणाभेदस् तत्प्रकृतित्वात् परेषु तासां संख्याविकारः स्यात् /
text_mt: In the twelve-day sacrifice, however, by virtue of direct text, there is a differentiation of fees day by day; and since it serves as the archetypal sacrifice, there would be a numerical modification of them in subsequent [rites].
Or, because hiring is indivisible, the modification would apply to the whole aggregate.
The differentiation, however, is due to the connection with a secondary detail.
Every day there is a preparatory purification of all [the fees], as in the archetypal sacrifice, because all [fees] belong to the whole [sacrifice].
[We reply:] It could be so, because there is a difference of time at the origin [of each day's performance].
However, direct text enjoins preparatory purification after dividing [them], as in the twelve-day sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: liṅgena dravyanirdeśe sarvatra pratyayaḥ syāl liṅgasya sarvagāmitvād āgneyavat /
meaning: लिङ्गेन द्रव्यनिर्देशे सर्वत्र प्रत्ययः स्याल् लिङ्गस्य सर्वगामित्वाद् आग्नेयवत् /
text_mt: When a substance is indicated by an indicative textual mark, it should apply everywhere, because the indicative textual mark applies generally, as in the case of the cake to Agni.

sanskrit_iast: yāvad arthaṃ vārthaśeṣatvād alpena parimāṇaṃ syāt tasmiṃś ca liṅgasāmarthyam /
meaning: यावद् अर्थं वार्थशेषत्वाद् अल्पेन परिमाणं स्यात् तस्मिंश् च लिङ्गसामर्थ्यम् /
text_mt: Or rather, as much as serves the purpose, because it is subordinate to that purpose, the quantity would be small, and the indicative capacity of the mark is confined to that.

sanskrit_iast: ṛjīṣasya pradhānatvād ahargaṇe sarvasya pratipattiḥ syāt /
meaning: ऋजीषस्य प्रधानत्वाद् अहर्गणे सर्वस्य प्रतिपत्तिः स्यात् /
text_mt: Because the pressed-out residue is primary, there should be disposal of the whole [at the end] of the series of days.
The measuring and taking down are done on a cloth, because in the archetypal sacrifice [this is] prescribed for Soma.
There, in a series of days, from the practical purpose, the cloth would be the archetype.

sanskrit_iast: mānaṃ pratyutpādayet prakṛtau tena darśanād upāvaharaṇasya /
meaning: मानं प्रत्युत्पादयेत् प्रकृतौ तेन दर्शनाद् उपावहरणस्य /
text_mt: One should produce [a cloth] for measuring, because in the archetypal sacrifice taking down is seen on that [same cloth].

sanskrit_iast: haraṇe vā śrutyasaṃyogād arthād vikṛtau tena /
meaning: हरणे वा श्रुत्यसंयोगाद् अर्थाद् विकृतौ तेन /
text_mt: Or, with regard to taking down, since there is no direct scriptural connection, [it is done] with that [same cloth] in the modified rite on account of practical purpose.
The animal has the character of a single sacrificial offering, because it is enjoined as a whole.
Or rather, each limb [is a distinct offering], like the cups, because the limbs are separately conceived.

sanskrit_iast: havir bhedāt karmaṇe 'bhyāsas tasmāt tebhyo 'vadānaṃ syāt /
meaning: हविर् भेदात् कर्मणे ऽभ्यासस् तस्मात् तेभ्यो ऽवदानं स्यात् /
text_mt: Because of the difference of sacrificial offerings, there is repetition of the action; therefore cuttings must be made from each of them.
Or, like the butter portions, because of specific designation there would be exclusive specification.

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ vā dvyavadānatvaṃ vivakṣann abhinirdiśet paśoḥ pañcāvadānatvāt /
meaning: तेषां वा द्व्यवदानत्वं विवक्षन्न् अभिनिर्दिशेत् पशोः पञ्चावदानत्वात् /
text_mt: Or wishing to express the twofold cutting of them, one specifies them, because the animal involves five cuttings.

sanskrit_iast: aṃsaśiro'nūkasakthipratiṣedhaś ca tadanyaparisaṅkhyāne 'narthakaḥ syāt pradānatvāt teṣāṃ niravadānapratiṣedhaḥ syāt /
meaning: अंसशिरोऽनूकसक्थिप्रतिषेधश् च तदन्यपरिसङ्ख्याने ऽनर्थकः स्यात् प्रदानत्वात् तेषां निरवदानप्रतिषेधः स्यात् /
text_mt: And the negative prohibition regarding the shoulder, head, backbone, and thighs would be meaningless if there were exclusive specification of other parts; since [these parts] are given [elsewhere], it must be a negative prohibition against cutting from them.
Or rather, it is an exclusive specification, because of the expression 'unfit for cutting'.
And because there is instruction regarding cooked and uncooked [portions], like the discarded portions, they do not constitute remnants of the sacrifice.
The Sviṣṭakṛt offering should be sacrificed from the remnants of the offering, as in the archetypal sacrifice.
Or there would be modification through the three limbs, like the reed-grass.
The adhyūdhnī portion for the Hotṛ would be a modification of the eating of the iḍā, like the three limbs.

sanskrit_iast: śeṣe vā samavaiti tasmād rathavan niyamaḥ syāt /
meaning: शेषे वा समवैति तस्माद् रथवन् नियमः स्यात् /
text_mt: Or it is included in the remnant; therefore it would be a restrictive injunction, like the chariot.
However, it cannot be so, because it is not based on scriptural injunction.
Or rather, it would be a mere gift, because there is no connection with the word 'eating'.

sanskrit_iast: dātus tv avidyamānatvād iḍābhakṣavikāraḥ syāc cheṣaṃ pratyaviśiṣṭatvāt /
meaning: दातुस् त्व् अविद्यमानत्वाद् इडाभक्षविकारः स्याच् छेषं प्रत्यविशिष्टत्वात् /
text_mt: However, since no giver is mentioned, it would be a modification of the eating of the iḍā, because it is not distinguished from the remnant.
And the vaniṣṭhu portion of the Āgnīdhra is like the adhyūdhnī.
Since he is not in the archetypal sacrifice, the Maitrāvaruṇa has no eating portion.
Or he would have one, because he is a modification of the Hotṛ and the Adhvaryu, due to connection with their actions.
There should be two shares, because he performs two actions.
Or there should be a single share because he is one person, since a share is not taught in direct scriptural statement.
And [a share belongs] to the Pratiprasthātṛ, on account of the cooking of the omentum.
Or there is no eating portion, because of the difference of action, and because that [omentum] is offered in its entirety.

sanskrit_iast: vikṛtau prākṛtasya vidher grahaṇāt punaḥ śrutir anarthikā syāt /
meaning: विकृतौ प्राकृतस्य विधेर् ग्रहणात् पुनः श्रुतिर् अनर्थिका स्यात् /
text_mt: In a modified rite, since the archetypal rule is already received, a restatement would be purposeless.
Or, as in the case of the cake to Agni, there would be two statements.

sanskrit_iast: adhikaṃ vārthavattvāt syād arthavādaguṇābhāve vacanād avikāre teṣu hi tādarthyaṃ syād apūrvatvāt /
meaning: अधिकं वार्थवत्त्वात् स्याद् अर्थवादगुणाभावे वचनाद् अविकारे तेषु हि तादर्थ्यं स्याद् अपूर्वत्वात् /
text_mt: Or it could be an additional detail because it serves a purpose; when corroborative statements and secondary qualities are absent, by virtue of direct text where there is no modification, [the details] would serve that purpose because of their transcendental potency.
If it is objected: 'It would be a negative prohibition';
It would, however, indicate transcendental potency, because the reception serves a purpose.
Even from that, only what is expressly stated would result.
There would be a negative prohibition of the Sviṣṭakṛt eating, because the reason is equal.
Or there would be an exclusion with regard to the iḍā, on account of textual mention.
Or it is a negative prohibition, because text preceded by an injunctive rule is seen.

sanskrit_iast: śaṃyviḍāntatve vikalpaḥ syāt pareṣu patnyanuyājapratiṣedho 'narthakaḥ syāt /
meaning: शंय्विडान्तत्वे विकल्पः स्यात् परेषु पत्न्यनुयाजप्रतिषेधो ऽनर्थकः स्यात् /
text_mt: When ending with Śaṃyu or with iḍā, there would be an option; [otherwise] the negative prohibition of the patnisaṃyājas in subsequent rites would be meaningless.
Or it would be a restatement of known fact regarding an obligatory action, because it is not directly expressed by words.
And because the negative prohibition serves a purpose, there would be a negative prohibition of what comes subsequent to the latter.

sanskrit_iast: prāpter vā pūrvasya vacanād atikramaḥ syāt /
meaning: प्राप्तेर् वा पूर्वस्य वचनाद् अतिक्रमः स्यात् /
text_mt: Or, because of the application [of the later], there would be an omission of the earlier by explicit statement.
Because the prohibition is connected with haste, and it has no other place.
In the Upasad rites, whatever is not explicitly stated would be a non-action.
Or, because the dipping-ladle is a secondary element, there would be a prohibition of the rest.
Or there is no prohibition, because there is a re-admission of what was prohibited.
Or there is non-offering of the rest, because the principal deities are not to be sacrificed to.
At the purificatory bath, because of the prohibition of the sacred grass, there would be the performance of the rest.
Or, because the two portions of clarified butter are secondary elements, there would be a prohibition of the rest.

sanskrit_iast: prayājānāṃ tv ekadeśapratiṣedhād vākyaśeṣatvaṃ tasmān nityānuvādaḥ syāt /
meaning: प्रयाजानां त्व् एकदेशप्रतिषेधाद् वाक्यशेषत्वं तस्मान् नित्यानुवादः स्यात् /
text_mt: But because there is a prohibition of only a part of the fore-sacrifices, it is a syntactic continuation; therefore, it would be a restatement of known fact.

sanskrit_iast: ājyabhāgayor grahaṇaṃ vityānuvādo vā gṛhamedhīyavat syāt /
meaning: आज्यभागयोर् ग्रहणं वित्यानुवादो वा गृहमेधीयवत् स्यात् /
text_mt: Or the mention of the two portions of clarified butter would be a restatement of known fact, as in the case of the Gṛhamedhīya rite.

sanskrit_iast: virodhinām ekaśrutau niyamaḥ syād grahaṇasyārthavattvāc charavac ca śrutito viśiṣṭatvāt /
meaning: विरोधिनाम् एकश्रुतौ नियमः स्याद् ग्रहणस्यार्थवत्त्वाच् छरवच् च श्रुतितो विशिष्टत्वात् /
text_mt: When conflicting elements are directly stated in a single direct scriptural statement, there would be a restrictive injunction, because the mention has purpose, and like the reed-grass, it is distinguished by direct scriptural statement.
If it is objected: 'Not so, because of the transfer of both'—
If it is objected: 'It is so in the case of the reed-grass, because of the non-mention of any conflicting element'—
If it is objected: '[Then there is] purposelessness of the direct scriptural statement'—
[We reply:] Because the mention has purpose, the mention would concern non-application.

sanskrit_iast: sarvāsāṃ ca guṇānām arthavattvād grahaṇam apravṛtte syāt /
meaning: सर्वासां च गुणानाम् अर्थवत्त्वाद् ग्रहणम् अप्रवृत्ते स्यात् /
text_mt: And because all the secondary qualities have purpose, the mention would concern non-application.

sanskrit_iast: tathaikārthavikāre prākṛtasyāpravṛttiḥ pravṛttau hi vikalpaḥ syāt /
meaning: तथैकार्थविकारे प्राकृतस्याप्रवृत्तिः प्रवृत्तौ हि विकल्पः स्यात् /
text_mt: Likewise, when there is modification for the same purpose, there is non-application of the archetypal element; for if there were application, there would be alternative adoption.
[We reply:] No, because in the archetypal sacrifice it is not expressed by the word.

sanskrit_iast: vikṛtau tv aniyamaḥ syāt praṣadājyavad grahaṇasya guṇārthatvād ubhayoś ca pradiṣṭatvād guṇaśāstraṃ yadeti syāt /
meaning: विकृतौ त्व् अनियमः स्यात् प्रषदाज्यवद् ग्रहणस्य गुणार्थत्वाद् उभयोश् च प्रदिष्टत्वाद् गुणशास्त्रं यदेति स्यात् /
text_mt: In the ectypal sacrifice, however, there would be no restriction, as in the case of speckled butter, because the mention is for the sake of a secondary quality, and because both are transferred, the teaching on the secondary quality would be [understood as] 'whenever'.
Or it should be restricted, because they have the same purpose, and because it is distinguished by direct scriptural statement.
And because they are conflicting, as in the world.

sanskrit_iast: virodhināñ ca tacchrutāv aśabdatvād vikalpaḥ syāt /
meaning: विरोधिनाञ् च तच्छ्रुताव् अशब्दत्वाद् विकल्पः स्यात् /
text_mt: And when there is direct scriptural statement of conflicting elements, there would be alternative adoption, because it is not expressed by the word [which one applies].
In the case of speckled butter, because of cumulative application, the mention is for the sake of a secondary quality.

sanskrit_iast: yady api caturavattīti tu niyame nopapadyate /
meaning: यद्य् अपि चतुरवत्तीति तु नियमे नोपपद्यते /
text_mt: However, the statement 'even if he makes four cuttings' would not make sense under a restrictive injunction.
Or it applies to another sacrificial rite, because of that rule, due to the difference of actions.

sanskrit_iast: pratiṣedhaḥ pradeśe 'nārabhyavidhāne ca prāptapratiṣiddhatvād vikalpaḥ syāt /
meaning: प्रतिषेधः प्रदेशे ऽनारभ्यविधाने च प्राप्तप्रतिषिद्धत्वाद् विकल्पः स्यात् /
text_mt: A negative prohibition in a transfer and in an unattached general prescription would result in alternative adoption, because there is both applicability and prohibition.
If it is objected: '[It is] like what is practically obtained'—
[We reply:] No, because their grounds are equal; both are characterized by verbal testimony.

sanskrit_iast: api tu vākyaśeṣaḥ syād anyāyyatvād vikalpasya vidhīnām ekadeśaḥ syāt /
meaning: अपि तु वाक्यशेषः स्याद् अन्याय्यत्वाद् विकल्पस्य विधीनाम् एकदेशः स्यात् /
text_mt: Rather, it would be a syntactic continuation, because alternative adoption is improper; it would be a part of the injunctive rules.
And in an unprecedented rite, it would be a corroborative statement.
Having enjoined, however, it would be a negative prohibition.

sanskrit_iast: na ced anyaṃ prakalpayet prakḷptāv arthavādaḥ syād ānarthakyāt parasāmarthyāc ca /
meaning: न चेद् अन्यं प्रकल्पयेत् प्रकॢप्ताव् अर्थवादः स्याद् आनर्थक्यात् परसामर्थ्याच् च /
text_mt: If it does not construct another [injunction]; if it were constructed, it would be a corroborative statement, because of purposelessness and because of the capacity of the other.
And because it is of the same time as the earlier ones.
If it is objected: 'Because of the prohibition, it is a non-action'—
The prohibition of giving, offering, and cooking for the consecrated sacrificer, due to the absence of distinction, would be a prohibition of all giving, offering, and cooking.

sanskrit_iast: akratuyuktānāṃ vā dharmaḥ syāt kratoḥ pratyakṣaśiṣṭatvāt /
meaning: अक्रतुयुक्तानां वा धर्मः स्यात् क्रतोः प्रत्यक्षशिष्टत्वात् /
text_mt: Or it would be a rule for things unconnected with the sacrificial rite, because the sacrificial rite is taught by direct perception.
Or even for that, it is inferential, due to the absence of distinction.

sanskrit_iast: api tu vākyaśeṣatvād itaraparyudāsaḥ syāt pratiṣedhe vikalpaḥ syāt /
meaning: अपि तु वाक्यशेषत्वाद् इतरपर्युदासः स्यात् प्रतिषेधे विकल्पः स्यात् /
text_mt: Rather, because it is a syntactic continuation, there would be an exclusion of the other; under a negative prohibition, there would be alternative adoption.

sanskrit_iast: aviśeṣeṇa yac chāstram anyāyyatvād vikalpasya tat sandigdham ārād viśeṣaśiṣṭaṃ syāt /
meaning: अविशेषेण यच् छास्त्रम् अन्याय्यत्वाद् विकल्पस्य तत् सन्दिग्धम् आराद् विशेषशिष्टं स्यात् /
text_mt: That teaching which is without distinction, because alternative adoption is improper, being ambiguous, would be enjoined with specific distinction from afar.

sanskrit_iast: aprakaraṇe tu yac chāstraṃ viśeṣe śruyamāṇam avikṛtam ājyabhāgavat prākṛtapratiṣedhārtham /
meaning: अप्रकरणे तु यच् छास्त्रं विशेषे श्रुयमाणम् अविकृतम् आज्यभागवत् प्राकृतप्रतिषेधार्थम् /
text_mt: But the teaching that is outside the context, being heard with reference to a specific element without modification, is for the purpose of prohibiting the archetypal element, like the portions of clarified butter.
In the case of modification, however, it would serve that purpose.

sanskrit_iast: vākyaśeṣo vā kratunā grahaṇāt syād anārabhyavidhānasya /
meaning: वाक्यशेषो वा क्रतुना ग्रहणात् स्याद् अनारभ्यविधानस्य /
text_mt: Or there would be a syntactic continuation of the unattached general prescription, because of its comprehension by the sacrificial rite.
In the case of Vedic recitations, there is non-continuation of the sentence, because there is teaching of a secondary quality.
Because of the teaching of the extra-graha cup for Agni in the ectypal sacrifice, there would be non-application [in the archetype].
And the drawing in the month is likewise.
The drawing would have the same injunctive status.
The mention of 'in the month' is for the purpose of prohibiting repetition.

sanskrit_iast: utpattitādarthyāc caturavattama pradhānasya homasaṃyogād adhikam ājyam atulyatvāl lokavad utpatter guṇabhūtatvāt /
meaning: उत्पत्तितादर्थ्याच् चतुरवत्तम प्रधानस्य होमसंयोगाद् अधिकम् आज्यम् अतुल्यत्वाल् लोकवद् उत्पत्तेर् गुणभूतत्वात् /
text_mt: Because it exists for the purpose of the originative action, the fourfold-cut portion belongs to the principal rite; on account of its connection with the oblation, the additional clarified butter [is used], because of inequality, as in worldly matters, since the origin is secondary.

sanskrit_iast: tābhyāṃ vā saha sviṣṭakṛtaḥ sakṛttve dvipabhighāraṇena tadāptivacanāt /
meaning: ताभ्यां वा सह स्विष्टकृतः सकृत्त्वे द्विपभिघारणेन तदाप्तिवचनात् /
text_mt: Or, together with those two [principal portions], [there is an offering] to Sviṣṭakṛt, because in its single performance its fulfillment is declared through a double pouring of clarified butter.
And because, having stated it as equal, the enumeration takes place by distribution among all.
It should be restricted, like the rule of seventeen [kindling verses].
Or rather, because the sacrificial offering is subordinate, such an intention should exist.

sanskrit_iast: puroḍāśābhyām itya dhikṛtānāṃ puroḍāśayor upadeśas tacchrutitvād vaiśyastomavat /
meaning: पुरोडाशाभ्याम् इत्य धिकृतानां पुरोडाशयोर् उपदेशस् तच्छ्रुतित्वाद् वैश्यस्तोमवत् /
text_mt: In the phrase 'by the two sacrificial cakes,' there is an instruction concerning the two sacrificial cakes of those entitled [to perform], because of direct scriptural statement of that, as in the case of the Vaiśyastoma.

sanskrit_iast: na tv anityādhikāro 'sti vidhau nityena sambandhas tasmād avākyaśeṣatvam /
meaning: न त्व् अनित्याधिकारो ऽस्ति विधौ नित्येन सम्बन्धस् तस्माद् अवाक्यशेषत्वम् /
text_mt: However, there is no non-obligatory eligibility in an injunctive rule; the connection is with that which is obligatory; therefore, it is not a complementary sentence.
And when it exists, [the eligibility] cannot be by a mere part, because the agent is the primary element.
On the other hand, in the stoma it is so because of completeness.
No, because it serves a secondary purpose; and when already obtained, there is no purpose in an instruction.

sanskrit_iast: karmaṇos tu prakaraṇe tannyāyatvād guṇānāṃ liṅgena kālaśāstraṃ syāt /
meaning: कर्मणोस् तु प्रकरणे तन्न्यायत्वाद् गुणानां लिङ्गेन कालशास्त्रं स्यात् /
text_mt: However, in the context of the two ritual actions, because that is the logical rule for secondary qualities, there should be an injunction of time by means of the indicative textual mark.

sanskrit_iast: yadi tu sānnāyyaṃ somayājino na tābhyāṃ samavāyo 'sti vibhaktakālatvāt /
meaning: यदि तु सान्नाय्यं सोमयाजिनो न ताभ्यां समवायो ऽस्ति विभक्तकालत्वात् /
text_mt: If, however, the curd-and-milk oblation belongs to a performer of the Soma sacrifice, there is no combination with those two, because their times are distinct.

sanskrit_iast: api vā vihitatvād guṇārthāyāṃ punaḥ śrutau sandehe śrutir dvidevatārthā syād yathānabhipretas tathāgneyo darśanād ekadevate /
meaning: अपि वा विहितत्वाद् गुणार्थायां पुनः श्रुतौ सन्देहे श्रुतिर् द्विदेवतार्था स्याद् यथानभिप्रेतस् तथाग्नेयो दर्शनाद् एकदेवते /
text_mt: Or rather, since it is already enjoined, when there is doubt regarding a reiteration for the sake of a secondary quality, the direct scriptural statement must pertain to two deities, just as that which is not intended [is discarded], so the Āgneya oblation is seen to belong to a single deity.
Or [it is known] from the comprehension of a prohibition.
And likewise there is indication of another purpose.

sanskrit_iast: upāṃśuyājam antarā yajatīti havirliṅgāśrutitvād yathākāmī pratīyeta /
meaning: उपांशुयाजम् अन्तरा यजतीति हविर्लिङ्गाश्रुतित्वाद् यथाकामी प्रतीयेत /
