text_mt: In the text 'He offers the low-tone sacrifice in between,' since there is no direct scriptural statement of an indicative mark of the sacrificial offering, it would be understood as according to one's desire.
Or [it should be taken] from the Dhruvā ladle, on account of its connection with all [rites].
And likewise it would be with respect to the recipient deity.
Or it should be Prajāpati, because of the ritual duty.

sanskrit_iast: devatāyās tv anirvacanaṃ tatra śabdasyeha mṛdutvaṃ tasmād ihādhikāreṇa /
meaning: देवतायास् त्व् अनिर्वचनं तत्र शब्दस्येह मृदुत्वं तस्माद् इहाधिकारेण /
text_mt: The unuttered nature of the deity applies there, [whereas] here there is softness of the word; therefore, it is by title in this rite.

sanskrit_iast: viṣṇur vā syād dhautrāmnānād amāvāsyāhaviś ca syād dhautrasya tatra darśanāt /
meaning: विष्णुर् वा स्याद् धौत्राम्नानाद् अमावास्याहविश् च स्याद् धौत्रस्य तत्र दर्शनात् /
text_mt: Or it should be Viṣṇu, because of his recitation in the Hotṛ formulas; and it should be an offering of the New-Moon day, because the Hotṛ recitation is found there.

sanskrit_iast: api vā paurṇamāsyāṃ syāt pradhānaśabdasaṃyogād guṇatvān mantro yathā pradhānaṃ syāt /
meaning: अपि वा पौर्णमास्यां स्यात् प्रधानशब्दसंयोगाद् गुणत्वान् मन्त्रो यथा प्रधानं स्यात् /
text_mt: Or rather, it should be on the Full-Moon day, on account of connection with the word denoting the principal rite; since it is subordinate, the mantra should follow the principal rite.

sanskrit_iast: ānantaryañ ca sānnāyyasya puroḍāśena darśayaty amāvāsyāvikāre /
meaning: आनन्तर्यञ् च सान्नाय्यस्य पुरोडाशेन दर्शयत्य् अमावास्याविकारे /
text_mt: And [scripture] shows the curd-and-milk oblation immediately following the sacrificial cake in the modification of the New-Moon sacrifice.
However, because of the injunction of Agnī-Soma, it is enjoined in both places at the Full Moon.
Or, because of the prohibition of the injunction, Viṣṇu would occupy the same place.
And likewise there is indication of another purpose.

sanskrit_iast: na cānaṅga sakṛc chrutāv ubhayatra vidhīyotāsambandhāt /
meaning: न चानङ्ग सकृच् छ्रुताव् उभयत्र विधीयोतासम्बन्धात् /
text_mt: Nor can a non-subsidiary element, when heard only once, be enjoined in both places, because of the absence of connection.

sanskrit_iast: guṇānāṃ ca parārthatvāt pravṛttau vidhiliṅgāni darśayati /
meaning: गुणानां च परार्थत्वात् प्रवृत्तौ विधिलिङ्गानि दर्शयति /
text_mt: And because secondary qualities exist for the sake of another, [scripture] displays injunctive textual marks upon performance.
It should be in a rite having two sacrificial cakes, because of the purpose of [being] 'in between.'
And because of the purpose of preventing monotonous repetition.
If it be said that it exists for that purpose, no; because it is the principal element.
And because of the connection with that which is not taught.

sanskrit_iast: utpattes tu niveśaḥ syād guṇasyānuparodhenārthasya vidyamānatvād vidhānād antarārthasya naimittikatvāt tadabhāve 'śrutau syāt /
meaning: उत्पत्तेस् तु निवेशः स्याद् गुणस्यानुपरोधेनार्थस्य विद्यमानत्वाद् विधानाद् अन्तरार्थस्य नैमित्तिकत्वात् तदभावे ऽश्रुतौ स्यात् /
text_mt: The placement, however, belongs to the originative action without obstruction to the subordinate quality, since the purpose exists; because of the injunction, the purpose of being 'in between' is occasional; in its absence, it would apply in the absence of direct scriptural statement.

sanskrit_iast: guṇānāñ ca parārthatvād upaveṣavad yadeti syāt /
meaning: गुणानाञ् च परार्थत्वाद् उपवेषवद् यदेति स्यात् /
text_mt: And because secondary qualities exist for the sake of another, the word 'when' would function just as in the case of the Upaveṣa stick.

sanskrit_iast: anapāyaś ca kālasya lakṣaṇaṃ hi puroḍāśau /
meaning: अनपायश् च कालस्य लक्षणं हि पुरोडाशौ /
text_mt: And there is no departure of time, for the two sacrificial cakes serve as the distinguishing mark.
Non-monotony is for the sake of praise.

sanskrit_iast: prayojanābhisambandhāt pṛthak satāṃ tataḥ syād aikakarmyam ekaśabdābhisaṃyogāt /
meaning: प्रयोजनाभिसम्बन्धात् पृथक् सतां ततः स्याद् ऐककर्म्यम् एकशब्दाभिसंयोगात् /
text_mt: Because of connection with a single purpose, there should be single action for those that are separate, on account of their connection with a single word.

sanskrit_iast: śeṣavad vā prayojanaṃ pratijanaṃ pratikarma vibhajyeta /
meaning: शेषवद् वा प्रयोजनं प्रतिजनं प्रतिकर्म विभज्येत /
text_mt: Or, like the remnant, the purpose would be divided per person and per ritual action.
However, it cannot be so, because of the absence of an injunction.

sanskrit_iast: śeṣasya hi parārthatvād vidhānāt pratipradhānabhāvaḥ syāt /
meaning: शेषस्य हि परार्थत्वाद् विधानात् प्रतिप्रधानभावः स्यात् /
text_mt: For since the remnant exists for the sake of another, its application would be to each principal rite because of the injunction.

sanskrit_iast: aṅgānāṃ tu śabdabhedāt kratuvat syāt phalānayatvam /
meaning: अङ्गानां तु शब्दभेदात् क्रतुवत् स्यात् फलानयत्वम् /
text_mt: However, for subsidiary elements, because of the difference of words, the non-leading of fruit would be just as in the sacrifice.
There, however, is a difference of purpose, whereas here, because of unity of purpose, there is oneness of ritual action.
Because it exists for the purpose of the action, the application of that word in performance would be due to that purpose.
Because the injunctive rule of the agent has multiple purposes among the primary and secondary elements.
Because beginning is preceded by the Vedic word.

sanskrit_iast: ekenāpi samāpyeta kṛtārthatvād yathā kratvantareṣu prāpteṣu cottarāvat syāt /
meaning: एकेनापि समाप्येत कृतार्थत्वाद् यथा क्रत्वन्तरेषु प्राप्तेषु चोत्तरावत् स्यात् /
text_mt: It would be completed even by one, because the purpose is accomplished, as when other sacrifices are obtained, and it would be like the Uttarā verses.
No; because of connection with the ritual action, there would be the defect of non-injunctive verbal statement of the purpose.
No; because of the distinctness of purpose, and because of equality, there is no secondary status.

sanskrit_iast: vidhes tv ekaśrutitvād aparyāyavidhānān nityavac chrutabhūtābhisaṃyogād arthena yugapatprāpter yathāprāptaṃ svaśabdo nivītavat sarvaprayoge pravṛttiḥ syāt /
meaning: विधेस् त्व् एकश्रुतित्वाद् अपर्यायविधानान् नित्यवच् छ्रुतभूताभिसंयोगाद् अर्थेन युगपत्प्राप्तेर् यथाप्राप्तं स्वशब्दो निवीतवत् सर्वप्रयोगे प्रवृत्तिः स्यात् /
text_mt: However, because the injunctive rule has a single direct statement, because non-alternating injunction is made, because of connection with what is directly heard as obligatory, and because it is obtained simultaneously with the purpose, its own word applies as obtained, like the wearing of the sacred thread around the neck, in every performance.
Likewise, because it is an instruction of ritual action.
[The repeated mention of an action] in other sacrificial rites is a reiteration [for another purpose].

sanskrit_iast: uttarāsvaśrutitvād viśeṣāṇāṃ kṛtārthatvāt saṃdohe yathākāmī pratīyeta /
meaning: उत्तरास्वश्रुतित्वाद् विशेषाणां कृतार्थत्वात् संदोहे यथाकामी प्रतीयेत /
text_mt: In the case of subsequent [milch cows], because they are not [individually] specified in direct scriptural statement, and because the particular details have fulfilled their beneficial purpose, it should be understood as at will in milking.

sanskrit_iast: karmaṇy ārambhabhāvyatvāt kṛṣivat pratyārambhaṃ phalāni syuḥ /
meaning: कर्मण्य् आरम्भभाव्यत्वात् कृषिवत् प्रत्यारम्भं फलानि स्युः /
text_mt: [Objection:] Because [the fruit] is to be brought about by beginning an action, like agriculture, there should be fruits for each undertaking.

sanskrit_iast: adhikāraś ca sarveṣāṃ kāryatvād upapadyate viśeṣaḥ /
meaning: अधिकारश् च सर्वेषां कार्यत्वाद् उपपद्यते विशेषः /
text_mt: And the title to perform applies to all, because an effect is to be accomplished, so a distinction is justified.
[Reply:] But it should be [performed] only once, because [the title] has fulfilled its purpose, just like a subsidiary element.
And such is the meaning of words in ordinary life.

sanskrit_iast: api vā saṃprayoge yathākāmī pratīyetāśrutitvād vidhiṣu vacanāni syuḥ /
meaning: अपि वा संप्रयोगे यथाकामी प्रतीयेताश्रुतित्वाद् विधिषु वचनानि स्युः /
text_mt: [Objection:] Or rather, in practical application, [the option] would be understood as at will, because [any restriction] is not directly stated by scriptural statement; the texts would be injunctive rules.
So also in the case of subsidiary elements, on account of using a single word.
In worldly life, an action is characterized by its purpose.
Because actions are subordinate to a purpose, completion comes through the perceptible accomplishment of that [purpose].
In the case of pure duty, however, since [the result] is imperceptible, completion comes by the verbal meaning [of the injunction].
[Objection:] And like sacrificial rites, through inference there should be an increase of fruit in repetition.
[Reply:] Or [it is performed] once, because the operative cause is single.
And the quantity would be without restriction.
Because the fruit is accomplished by undertaking [the rite], there is a difference of fruits among sacrificial rites.

sanskrit_iast: arthavāṃs tu naikatvād abhyāsaḥ syād anarthako yathā bhojanam ekasminn arthasyāparimāṇatvāt pradhāne ca kriyārthatvād aniyamaḥ syāt /
meaning: अर्थवांस् तु नैकत्वाद् अभ्यासः स्याद् अनर्थको यथा भोजनम् एकस्मिन्न् अर्थस्यापरिमाणत्वात् प्रधाने च क्रियार्थत्वाद् अनियमः स्यात् /
text_mt: However, that which has a purpose [is achieved once]; repetition would be purposeless because [the result] is one, as with eating; because in a single instance the purpose is not limited [by scriptural measure], and in the principal rite it is for the sake of the action, there would be no restriction.
Because of distinctness, the measure would be from injunctive rule.

sanskrit_iast: anabhyāso vā prayogavacanaikatvāt sarvasya yugapacchāstrād aphalatvāc ca karmaṇaḥ syāt kriyārthatvāt /
meaning: अनभ्यासो वा प्रयोगवचनैकत्वात् सर्वस्य युगपच्छास्त्राद् अफलत्वाच् च कर्मणः स्यात् क्रियार्थत्वात् /
text_mt: Or there is no repetition, because the injunctive text of performance is single, all [acts] are taught simultaneously, and the action has no independent fruit, because it is for the sake of the [main] action.
[Objection:] Or there is repetition, because singleness is expressly stated in cutting, cleaning, and portioning.
[Reply:] But there is no repetition, because [only what is directly meant] is to be expressed.
Because the plural number covers all, there would be an option.

sanskrit_iast: prathamaṃ vā niyamyeta kāraṇād atikramaḥ syāt /
meaning: प्रथमं वा नियम्येत कारणाद् अतिक्रमः स्यात् /
text_mt: Or the first should be restricted; any departure would be for a specific cause.
And likewise, there is an indication of another meaning.
And because of the base paradigm, as previously, due to its proximity.
In the subsequent [cows], each according to its capacity, because of transcendental potency.
Or 'each according to its capacity' would be a reiteration of known fact, because of the injunction of another.
And in the Agnihotra, the restriction to barley gruel without leaving any remainder is a prohibition for children.
Even that which obtains everywhere is connected by indicative textual mark, on account of connection with the recipient deity.

sanskrit_iast: pradhānakarmārthatvād aṅgānāṃ tadbhedāt karmabhedaḥ prayoge syāt /
meaning: प्रधानकर्मार्थत्वाद् अङ्गानां तद्भेदात् कर्मभेदः प्रयोगे स्यात् /
text_mt: [Objection:] Because the subsidiary elements are for the purpose of the primary action, then upon the difference of those [primary acts] there would be a difference of actions in performance.
And there would be a disruption of order due to simultaneity.

sanskrit_iast: tulyānāṃ tu yaugapadyam ekaśabdopadeśāt syād viśeṣāgrahaṇāt /
meaning: तुल्यानां तु यौगपद्यम् एकशब्दोपदेशात् स्याद् विशेषाग्रहणात् /
text_mt: But there is simultaneity of equals, because of instruction by a single word, since no distinction is apprehended.
Because they have a single purpose, there should be no intervention.
And likewise, Kāmukāyana holds there is an indication of another meaning.

sanskrit_iast: tannyāyatvād aśakter ānupūrvyaṃ syāt saṃskārasya tadarthatvāt /
meaning: तन्न्यायत्वाद् अशक्तेर् आनुपूर्व्यं स्यात् संस्कारस्य तदर्थत्वात् /
text_mt: Because of that principle, due to incapacity, there would be succession, because the preparatory purification is for that purpose.
Even if uncombined, it is because it serves that purpose.
Or because of pervading capacity, like a lamp.

sanskrit_iast: arthāt tu loke vidhitaḥ pratipradhānaṃ syāt /
meaning: अर्थात् तु लोके विधितः प्रतिप्रधानं स्यात् /
text_mt: In worldly life [this holds] from purpose; but from injunctive rule, it should be for each primary element.
Kāmukāyana holds that the sacrifice [is performed] once, because of conflict with the measure.

sanskrit_iast: vidhes tv itarārthatvāt sakṛd ijyāśrutivyatikramaḥ syāt /
meaning: विधेस् त्व् इतरार्थत्वात् सकृद् इज्याश्रुतिव्यतिक्रमः स्यात् /
text_mt: Because the injunctive rule is for the sake of the other, there would be a transgression of the direct scriptural statement of a single sacrifice.
Bādarāyaṇa holds that performance is according to the injunctive rule, when there is no division in the context of the ritual topic.
Moreover, proximity to one is an unspecifying reason.
If it is objected that it is not so because of an injunction somewhere;
Simultaneity of equals whose distinctions are not apprehended has been explained.

sanskrit_iast: bhedas tu kālabhedāc codanāvyavāyāt syād viśiṣṭānāṃ vidhiḥ pradhānakālatvāt /
meaning: भेदस् तु कालभेदाच् चोदनाव्यवायात् स्याद् विशिष्टानां विधिः प्रधानकालत्वात् /
text_mt: A distinction, however, arises from difference of time, because of the intervention of injunctions; the injunctive rule applies to the specified [elements], because they belong to the time of the primary element.
And likewise, there is an indication of another meaning.
If it is said to be an injunctive rule, [we say] no, because of reference to the present.
There is identity of place, time, and performer for the principal rites, because of instruction by a single word.

sanskrit_iast: avidhiś cet karmaṇām abhisambandhaḥ pratīyeta tallakṣaṇārthābhisaṃyogād vidhitvāc cetareṣāṃ pratipradhānabhāvaḥ syāt /
meaning: अविधिश् चेत् कर्मणाम् अभिसम्बन्धः प्रतीयेत तल्लक्षणार्थाभिसंयोगाद् विधित्वाच् चेतरेषां प्रतिप्रधानभावः स्यात् /
text_mt: If it is not an injunctive rule, a mutual connection among the actions would be understood, because of connection with an object characterized by that; and because the others are injunctive rules, there would be application to each primary element.
And in the subsidiary elements that [separation] is absent, because they are indicated in relation to the primary element.

sanskrit_iast: yadi tu karmaṇo vidhisambandhaḥ syād aikaśabdyāt pradhānārthābhidhāsaṃyogāt /
meaning: यदि तु कर्मणो विधिसम्बन्धः स्याद् ऐकशब्द्यात् प्रधानार्थाभिधासंयोगात् /
text_mt: If, however, there were an injunctive connection of the action, [it would be] because of a single expression, on account of connection with expressing the purpose of the primary element.
And likewise, there is an indication of another meaning.
And their direct scriptural statement is like that of the primary element, because the scriptural mention of the action is for the sake of another.

sanskrit_iast: aṅgāni tu vidhānatvāt pradhānenopadiśyeraṃs tasmāt syād ekadeśatvam /
meaning: अङ्गानि तु विधानत्वात् प्रधानेनोपदिश्येरंस् तस्मात् स्याद् एकदेशत्वम् /
text_mt: The subsidiary elements, however, because they have the nature of being enjoined, would be taught along with the principal rite; therefore there would be unity of locus.
If it be argued that the substance and the deity are likewise [the same];
No, because being auxiliary to the injunctive rule, the distinctive qualification serves for restrictive limitation.

sanskrit_iast: teṣu samavetānāṃ samavāyāt tantram aṅgāni bhedas tu tadbhedāt karmabhedaḥ prayoge syāt teṣāṃ pradhānaśabdatvāt tathā cānyārthadarśanam /
meaning: तेषु समवेतानां समवायात् तन्त्रम् अङ्गानि भेदस् तु तद्भेदात् कर्मभेदः प्रयोगे स्यात् तेषां प्रधानशब्दत्वात् तथा चान्यार्थदर्शनम् /
text_mt: For those [subsidiary elements] inherent in them, the ritual procedure is common (tantra) because of their co-inherence; but difference [of procedure arises] from difference among them; there would be difference of ritual actions in actual performance because they are designated by the word for the principal rite; and likewise there is an indication of another meaning.
In the Iṣṭis, the Rājasūya, and the Cāturmāsya sacrifices, there should be a single common procedure (tantra) for the subsidiary elements, because of their being a single ritual action.
No, because it forms a single unit, as in the case of the animal sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: api vā karmapṛthaktvāt teṣāṃ tantravidhānāt sāṅgānām upadeśaḥ syāt /
meaning: अपि वा कर्मपृथक्त्वात् तेषां तन्त्रविधानात् साङ्गानाम् उपदेशः स्यात् /
text_mt: Or rather, because the rites are separate, and because their common procedure is enjoined, the teaching must apply to them along with their subsidiary elements.
And likewise there is an indication of another meaning.
Likewise would it be with their component parts.

sanskrit_iast: paśau tu codanaikatvāt tantrasya viprakarṣaḥ syāt /
meaning: पशौ तु चोदनैकत्वात् तन्त्रस्य विप्रकर्षः स्यात् /
text_mt: In the animal sacrifice, however, because the injunction is single, there is an extension of the common procedure.
So it would be in the Adhvarakalpā Iṣṭi, because the specific rites share a single time.
And the scriptural word 'iṣṭi' is singular.

sanskrit_iast: api vā karmapṛthakatvāt teṣāṃ ca tantravidhānāt sāṅgānām upadeśaḥ syāt /
meaning: अपि वा कर्मपृथकत्वात् तेषां च तन्त्रविधानात् साङ्गानाम् उपदेशः स्यात् /
text_mt: Or rather, because the rites are separate, and because their common procedure is enjoined, the teaching must apply to them along with their subsidiary elements.
Or the statement of time applies only to the first.
Because of the oneness of the result, the word 'iṣṭi' is used, as elsewhere.
The omentum oblation should be common (tantra) for rites having the same deity, because the presentation occurs at the same time.
But when the deities differ, there is repetition because of difference in time.
And because the places are not prescribed by scripture.

sanskrit_iast: avabhṛthe pradhāne 'gnivikāraḥ syān na hi taddhetur agnisaṃyogaḥ /
meaning: अवभृथे प्रधाने ऽग्निविकारः स्यान् न हि तद्धेतुर् अग्निसंयोगः /
text_mt: In the Avabhṛtha (purificatory bath), the modification regarding the fire applies to the principal rite, for the connection with fire is not the cause of that.
Or it applies to the whole along with the subsidiary elements, because the injunctive statement of performance is single.
And because of the distinction of verbal statements, there is no displacement of the deity.

meaning: दक्षिणे ऽग्नौ वरुणप्रधासेषु देशभेदात् सर्वं क्रियते /
text_mt: In the Varuṇapraghāsa rites, everything is done on the southern fire because of difference of place.
Here too the performance of the offering to the Maruts is enjoined.
No, because of syntactic unity with what follows.
If it be said that difference of performers implies the same;
Because there is a single fire, there should be a common procedure (tantra) for the others.

sanskrit_iast: paryagnikṛtānām utsarge prājāpatyānāṃ karmotsargaḥ śrutisāmānayād āraṇyavat tasmād brahmasāmni codanāpṛthaktavaṃ syāt /
meaning: पर्यग्निकृतानाम् उत्सर्गे प्राजापत्यानां कर्मोत्सर्गः श्रुतिसामानयाद् आरण्यवत् तस्माद् ब्रह्मसाम्नि चोदनापृथक्तवं स्यात् /
text_mt: In the case of letting loose those around which fire has been carried, there is abandonment of the rite in the case of the Prājāpatya animals, because of identity of scriptural text, as in the case of the forest animals; therefore, at the Brahma-sāman, there would be a separate injunction.
Or rather, it is a prohibition of the preparatory consecration, on account of syntactic unity and the commonality of the sacrifice.
On account of syntactic unity and the commonality of the sacrifice.
And because non-basting of the omenta is observed.
If it be said that the Pañcaśāradīya sacrifices are like that;
No, because of the syntactic unity of the injunction.
And because the preparatory consecrations are observed to be such.

sanskrit_iast: daśapeye krayapratikarṣāt pratikarṣas tataḥ prācāṃ tatsamānaṃ tantraṃ syāt /
meaning: दशपेये क्रयप्रतिकर्षात् प्रतिकर्षस् ततः प्राचां तत्समानं तन्त्रं स्यात् /
text_mt: In the Daśapeya, by anticipating the time of the purchase [of Soma], there is anticipation of the rites prior to it; their ritual procedure would be identical.
Or rather, there is postponement, because it serves the purpose.
And because the purificatory bath is observed in the former.
In the case of the scraping [of porridge] in the Avabhṛtha, because it is a part thereof, there should be a protraction of the offering, as in the case of the animal sacrifice.
Or there is removal, because of association with what is well-established.
If it be said to be a disposal rite, no, because of its connection with an action.
Or it is a disposal rite, because of lack of connection with an action.

sanskrit_iast: arthakarma vā śeṣatvāc chrayaṇavat tadarthena vidhānāt /
meaning: अर्थकर्म वा शेषत्वाच् छ्रयणवत् तदर्थेन विधानात् /
text_mt: Or it is a primary functional action, because it is an auxiliary element, like mixing, since it is enjoined for that beneficial purpose.
Because the subsidiary elements belong to the time of the principal rite, their occurrence at another time is only by direct statement.

sanskrit_iast: dravyasya karmakālaniṣpatteḥ prayogaḥ sarvārthaḥ syāt svakālatvāt /
meaning: द्रव्यस्य कर्मकालनिष्पत्तेः प्रयोगः सर्वार्थः स्यात् स्वकालत्वात् /
text_mt: Since the substance is produced at the time of the action, its employment would serve all purposes, because it has its own proper time.
And the sacrificial post also, because it does not belong [solely] to the time of [a single] action.
Preparatory purifications, however, would be repeated, because they pertain to the time of the beneficial purpose.

sanskrit_iast: tatkālas tu yūpakarmatvāt tasya dharmavidhānāt sarvārthānāṃ ca vacanād anyakālatvam /
meaning: तत्कालस् तु यूपकर्मत्वात् तस्य धर्मविधानात् सर्वार्थानां च वचनाद् अन्यकालत्वम् /
text_mt: However, [it belongs to] that time because it is an action pertaining to the sacrificial post, since its details of duty are enjoined [as such], and for those serving all purposes, occurrence at another time is by direct statement.
And [scripture] shows a single measuring.
The chip of the sacrificial post should end with the common procedure, because it does not have its own proper time.
Or its production follows in common, because it is common.
And because its disposal rite is seen at the conclusion of the Soma sacrifice.
And not [at each rite], because it is an originating sentence, just as in the transfer [of properties] regarding the grass-bed.

sanskrit_iast: ahargaṇe viṣāṇāprāsanaṃ dharmavipratiṣedhād ante prathame vāhani vikalpaḥ syāt /
meaning: अहर्गणे विषाणाप्रासनं धर्मविप्रतिषेधाद् अन्ते प्रथमे वाहनि विकल्पः स्यात् /
text_mt: In a multi-day sacrifice, as to the throwing away of the black antelope's horn, because of the conflict of duties, there should be an option either on the last or on the first day.

sanskrit_iast: pāṇes tv aśrutibhūtatvād viṣāṇāniyamaḥ syāt prātaḥ savanamadhyatvāc chiṣṭe cābhipravṛttatvāt /
meaning: पाणेस् त्व् अश्रुतिभूतत्वाद् विषाणानियमः स्यात् प्रातः सवनमध्यत्वाच् छिष्टे चाभिप्रवृत्तत्वात् /
text_mt: Since the hand is not mentioned in direct scriptural statement, there should be a restrictive injunction for the horn, because it is within the morning pressing, and because it has already begun to be employed in what was taught.
And because it has already begun to be employed in what was taught.
The release of speech by the call to the preparer of the oblation would be likewise when there is a difference of grains.
And in the animal sacrifice and in the sacrificial cake, there should be a common procedure.
The harnessing serves the subsidiary elements and the principal rite; its unyoking should take place at the completion of all.
Or at the completion of the principal rite, because it is for its sake.

meaning: अवभृथे च तद्वत् प्रधानार्थस्य प्रतिषेधो ऽपवृक्तार्थत्वात् /
text_mt: And in the purificatory bath, it is likewise; the negative prohibition applies to what serves the principal rite, because its purpose has ceased.
And in a multi-day sacrifice, it should occur day by day, because it serves that purpose.
The Subrahmaṇyā litany, however, is a common procedure, like the initiation, because it belongs to another time.
From that time, however, it would be repeated from the beginning, because of a specific connection through the sacrificial post.
[That is not so,] because of the mention of performance, as in the case of different agents.

sanskrit_iast: tadbhūtasthānād agnivad iti cet tadapavargas tadarthatvāt /
meaning: तद्भूतस्थानाद् अग्निवद् इति चेत् तदपवर्गस् तदर्थत्वात् /
text_mt: If it be said that it is like the sacred fires, because of standing in a place that has become that, its completion [follows] because it serves that purpose.
[That is] not [so], because of the commonality of the performance.
[That is] not [so], because it is untaught, and because the other principle applies.
[That is] not [so], because the whole is performed again, as in the case of the principal rite.
In worldly matters, however, it may be as one desires, because there is no loss of purpose of the preparatory purification.
The sacrificial implements should be preserved, because their disposal rite is enjoined, like the Soma dregs.

sanskrit_iast: yajamānasaṃskāro vā tadarthaḥ śrūyate tatra yathākāmī tadarthatvāt /
meaning: यजमानसंस्कारो वा तदर्थः श्रूयते तत्र यथाकामी तदर्थत्वात् /
text_mt: Or it is heard as a preparatory purification of the sacrificer for that purpose; in that case, it is as one desires, because it serves that purpose.
Or there is maintenance during life, because death is of uncertain occurrence.

sanskrit_iast: yo vā yajanīye 'hani mriyeta so 'dhikṛtaḥ syād upaveṣavat /
meaning: यो वा यजनीये ऽहनि म्रियेत सो ऽधिकृतः स्याद् उपवेषवत् /
text_mt: Or whoever should die on the day of sacrifice would be the one entitled, as in the case of the fire-stirring stick.
Or there is production [of the vessels], because it is an instigating factor, as in the case of milk for curdling.
If it be said that there is incongruity in the words;

sanskrit_iast: śāstrāt tu viprayogas tatraikadravyacikīrṣā prakṛtāv athehāpūrvārthavad bhūtopadeśaḥ /
meaning: शास्त्रात् तु विप्रयोगस् तत्रैकद्रव्यचिकीर्षा प्रकृताव् अथेहापूर्वार्थवद् भूतोपदेशः /
text_mt: From scripture, however, there is separation; there, the intention is to use a single substance in the archetypal sacrifice, whereas here, the teaching refers to existing things possessing a transcendental potency.
They should be made at the Full-Moon sacrifice, because they serve the purpose of the archetypal sacrifice.
Or [they should be made] at the setting up of the sacred fires, because there is no conflict; one should preserve them, because death is not an occasion [for their making].
Or it is a disposal rite, as in the case of other [substances].
[In the text:] 'After the Soma libations, they proceed with the victims for Prajāpati';
If it be said that an inversion of subsidiary elements [would result] without a direct statement;
[We reply:] there is transposition because of syntactical connection; in the other case it is merely time.
If it be said that they belong to those possessing recitation chants, because of proximity to the time of the archetypal sacrifice;

sanskrit_iast: utkarṣe sūktavākasya na somadevatānām utkarṣaḥ paśvanaṅgatvād yathā niṣkarṣenānvayaḥ /
meaning: उत्कर्षे सूक्तवाकस्य न सोमदेवतानाम् उत्कर्षः पश्वनङ्गत्वाद् यथा निष्कर्षेनान्वयः /
text_mt: In the case of the transposition of the Sūktavāka formula, there is no transposition of the Soma deities, because they are not subsidiary to the animal sacrifice, just as in following by extraction.
Or there is transposition because of connection in the sentential context, because of a common procedure; [and] there is no following, because of the loss of purpose.

meaning: चोदनैकत्वाद् राजसूये ऽनुक्तदेशकालानां समवायात् तन्त्रम् अङ्गानि /
text_mt: In the Rājasūya sacrifice, because the injunction is one, and because those whose place and time are unspecified are combined, the subsidiary elements form a common procedure.

sanskrit_iast: pratidakṣiṇaṃ vā kartṛsambandhād iṣṭivad aṅgabhūtatvāt samudāyo hi tannirvṛttyātadekatvād ekatvād ekaśabdopadeśaḥ syāt /
meaning: प्रतिदक्षिणं वा कर्तृसम्बन्धाद् इष्टिवद् अङ्गभूतत्वात् समुदायो हि तन्निर्वृत्त्यातदेकत्वाद् एकत्वाद् एकशब्दोपदेशः स्यात् /
text_mt: Or [they should be performed] at each priestly gift, because of connection with the performer, because of being subsidiary elements like the new- and full-moon oblations; for the aggregate is effected by that, and because it is one, the instruction should be by a single word.
And likewise is the indicative mark seen for another purpose.
The direct scriptural statement, however, is meant without distinction.

sanskrit_iast: aveṣṭau caikatantryaṃ syāl liṅgadarśanād vacanāt kāmasaṃyogena /
meaning: अवेष्टौ चैकतन्त्र्यं स्याल् लिङ्गदर्शनाद् वचनात् कामसंयोगेन /
text_mt: And in the Aveṣṭi rite, there should be a single common procedure, on account of the perception of indicative textual marks and on account of scriptural statement through connection with a desire.
If [it be argued that it is] serving the sacrificial rite, [we say] no, because of the connection with [social] classes.
In the Pavamāna offerings, there is a single common procedure, because the injunctive performance-rule is single.
Because of designation in the present tense, however, by explicit statement there would be a division of the common procedure.
If there is simultaneousness, it would be a reiteration of what is constant.

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśāhe tu prakṛtitvād ekaikam ahar apavṛjyeta karmapṛthaktvāt /
meaning: द्वादशाहे तु प्रकृतित्वाद् एकैकम् अहर् अपवृज्येत कर्मपृथक्त्वात् /
text_mt: In the Dvādaśāha, however, because it is an archetypal sacrifice, each single day should be completed [separately], on account of the distinctness of the rites.

sanskrit_iast: ahrāṃ vā śrutibhūtatvāt tatra sāṅgaṃ kriyeta yathā mādhyandine /
meaning: अह्रां वा श्रुतिभूतत्वात् तत्र साङ्गं क्रियेत यथा माध्यन्दिने /
text_mt: Or, because the days are directly expressed in scripture, the rite should be performed there along with its subsidiary elements, as at the midday [pressing].

sanskrit_iast: api vā phalakartṛsambandhāt saha prayogaḥ syād āgneyāgnīṣomīyavat /
meaning: अपि वा फलकर्तृसम्बन्धात् सह प्रयोगः स्याद् आग्नेयाग्नीषोमीयवत् /
text_mt: Or rather, because of the connection with the fruit and the agent, there should be a combined performance, like [the rites dedicated to] Agni and Agni-Soma.
Or, because scripture mentions time with the subsidiary elements, there would be a modification of their respective places.
And the number of consecrations and Upasad rites belongs distinctly to each, because of their direct connection [with each day].

sanskrit_iast: vasatīvarīparyantāni pūrvāṇi tantram anyakālatvād avabhṛthādīny uttarāṇi dīkṣāvisargārthatvāt /
meaning: वसतीवरीपर्यन्तानि पूर्वाणि तन्त्रम् अन्यकालत्वाद् अवभृथादीन्य् उत्तराणि दीक्षाविसर्गार्थत्वात् /
text_mt: The prior [subsidiaries] ending with the Vasatīvarī waters constitute a single common procedure because they have a different time; the subsequent ones, beginning with the final ablution, [are also common] because their purpose is the release of consecration.
And similarly there is perception of another purpose.
Even when the injunctions are distinct, there is a single common procedure for those [elements] that are brought together, on account of the connection with time.

sanskrit_iast: bhedas tu tadbhedāt karamabhedaḥ prayoge syāt teṣāṃ pradhānaśabdatvāt /
meaning: भेदस् तु तद्भेदात् करमभेदः प्रयोगे स्यात् तेषां प्रधानशब्दत्वात् /
text_mt: A separation, however, [should occur] on account of that division; there would be a division of actions in performance, because those [terms] express principal rites.
And similarly there is perception of another purpose.
The statement about tomorrow's extraction of soma is likewise.

sanskrit_iast: sutyāvivṛddhau subrahmaṇyāyāṃ sarveṣām upalakṣaṇaṃ prakṛtyanvayād āvāhanavat /
meaning: सुत्याविवृद्धौ सुब्रह्मण्यायां सर्वेषाम् उपलक्षणं प्रकृत्यन्वयाद् आवाहनवत् /
text_mt: When there is an increase of extraction days, in the Subrahmaṇyā formula there is indication of all [days], through connection with the archetypal sacrifice, like the invocation [of deities].

sanskrit_iast: api vendrābhidhānatvāt sakṛt syād upalakṣaṇaṃ kālasya lakṣaṇārthatvāt /
meaning: अपि वेन्द्राभिधानत्वात् सकृत् स्याद् उपलक्षणं कालस्य लक्षणार्थत्वात् /
text_mt: Or rather, because it is an address to Indra, the indication should occur once, since it serves to mark the time.
In a group of animals, because the cooking pot, the spit, and the omentum-cookers are adequate, there should be a single common procedure.
A separation, however, would arise in the case of a different recipient deity, on account of doubt.
Or, because of purpose, the action would have an indicative mark.
Because they are to be disposed of, there would be a separation of the fats, since they are offered with their own offering-verses.

sanskrit_iast: api vā pratipattitvāt tantraṃ syāt svatvasyāśrutibhūtatvāt /
meaning: अपि वा प्रतिपत्तित्वात् तन्त्रं स्यात् स्वत्वस्याश्रुतिभूतत्वात् /
text_mt: Or rather, because it is a disposal rite, it should be a single common procedure, since ownership is not directly stated by scripture.
On account of the difference in cooking, there would be a separation of the cooking pot, the spit, and the omentum-cookers.
Among different species, there is separation because of inequality of cooking.
And the potsherds are like the cooking pot, in the case of equal numbers.
Or [they are arranged] for each principal rite, as in the archetypal sacrifice.
Or there should be spreading out for all of them.
In the case of a single substance, the preparatory purifications have been explained, because it is a single action.

sanskrit_iast: dravyāntare kṛtārthatvāt tasya punaḥ prayogān mantrasya ca tadguṇatvāt punaḥ prayogaḥ syāt tadarthena vidhānāt /
meaning: द्रव्यान्तरे कृतार्थत्वात् तस्य पुनः प्रयोगान् मन्त्रस्य च तद्गुणत्वात् पुनः प्रयोगः स्यात् तदर्थेन विधानात् /
text_mt: In the case of another substance, because the purpose [of the first] has been accomplished, by repeated performance of it, and because the mantra is subordinate to it, there should be repeated performance, because it is enjoined for that purpose.
And in the acts of measuring out, mowing [the grass], spreading [the barhis], and taking the clarified butter, [the rule is] as with a single substance, because the purpose is single.
Or it should be treated like a different substance, because it is a preparatory purification of that.
In sprinkling the altar, there is repetition of the mantra, because the action is repeatedly performed.

sanskrit_iast: ekasya vā guṇavidhir dravyaikatvāt tasmāt sakṛt prayogaḥ syāt /
meaning: एकस्य वा गुणविधिर् द्रव्यैकत्वात् तस्मात् सकृत् प्रयोगः स्यात् /
text_mt: Or rather, it is an injunction of a subsidiary quality for a single [altar], because the substance is single; therefore, there should be a single performance.
In scratching, [the mantra should be repeated] for each limb, because of the division of actions.
Or rather, there should be a single action, having the same time as the injunction.
And so it is in the cases of sleeping, crossing a river, raining upon, and addressing an unholy thing with mantras.
In setting out on a journey, however, [it applies] until the purpose is accomplished.
The mantra for the Uparava sounding-holes should be common, as in ordinary worldly usage, because of the plural expression.

sanskrit_iast: na sannipātitvād asannipātikarmaṇāṃ viśeṣagrahaṇe kālaikatvāt sakṛd vacanam /
meaning: न सन्निपातित्वाद् असन्निपातिकर्मणां विशेषग्रहणे कालैकत्वात् सकृद् वचनम् /
text_mt: Not so: because [the act] is directly productive, for non-productive actions there is a single utterance when a particular is apprehended, because the time is one.
There should be repetition of the Haviskṛt formula, the Adhrigu formula, the invokatory verse, and the Manotā hymn, because of the difference of time.
And because the Adhrigu formula is transposed.

sanskrit_iast: tantrisamavāye codanātaḥ samānānām ekatantryam atulyeṣu tu bhedaḥ syād vidhiprakramatād arthyāt śrutikālanirdeśāt /
meaning: तन्त्रिसमवाये चोदनातः समानानाम् एकतन्त्र्यम् अतुल्येषु तु भेदः स्याद् विधिप्रक्रमताद् अर्थ्यात् श्रुतिकालनिर्देशात् /
text_mt: When procedures coincide, there is a single common procedure for those that are equal by injunction; but among unequal ones there would be separation, because the commencement of the injunctive rule is for its own purpose, and because direct scripture specifies the time.
And because of modification of secondary elements and time, there would be a division of the common procedure.

sanskrit_iast: tantramadhye vidhānād vā mukhyatantreṇa siddhiḥ syāt tantrārthasyāviśiṣṭatvāt /
meaning: तन्त्रमध्ये विधानाद् वा मुख्यतन्त्रेण सिद्धिः स्यात् तन्त्रार्थस्याविशिष्टत्वात् /
text_mt: Or, because of being enjoined within the common procedure, accomplishment would be through the primary common procedure, because the purpose of the common procedure is not distinct.

sanskrit_iast: vikārāc ca na bhedaḥ syād arthasyāvikṛtatvāt /
meaning: विकाराच् च न भेदः स्याद् अर्थस्याविकृतत्वात् /
text_mt: And on account of modification, there would be no separation, because the purpose is not modified.
According to Jaimini, because of falling under another's common procedure, there would be a prohibition of its own independent procedure.
[Purvapakṣa:] In the Soma sacrifice, because the purpose is different, the work on the altar should belong to the rites that have the New- and Full-Moon sacrifices as their base paradigm.
[Siddhānta:] Or it is not an [additional] action, [since the other altar] would [otherwise] be spoiled when made.
[Purvapakṣa:] And with regard to the sacrificial vessels there would be an incidental application, because they serve the purpose of homa offerings.

sanskrit_iast: nyāyyāni vā prayuktatvād aprayukte prasaṅgaḥ syāt /
meaning: न्याय्यानि वा प्रयुक्तत्वाद् अप्रयुक्ते प्रसङ्गः स्यात् /
text_mt: [Siddhānta:] Or they are strictly standard because they are already engaged; only when [the standard one is] not engaged would there be an incidental application.

sanskrit_iast: śāmitre ca paśupuroḍāśo na syād itarasya prayuktatvāt /
meaning: शामित्रे च पशुपुरोडाशो न स्याद् इतरस्य प्रयुक्तत्वात् /
text_mt: And at the Śāmitra fire the animal-cake offering should not take place, because the other [fire] has already been engaged.

sanskrit_iast: śrapaṇaṃ vāgnihotrasya śālāmukhīye na syāt prājahitasya vidyamānatvāt /
meaning: श्रपणं वाग्निहोत्रस्य शालामुखीये न स्यात् प्राजहितस्य विद्यमानत्वात् /
text_mt: Or the cooking of the Agnihotra oblation should not take place in the Śālāmukhīya fire, because the Prājahita fire is available.
[Purvapakṣa:] The two carts in the Havirdhāna shed should serve the purpose of measuring out the oblation material, because they are already engaged.

sanskrit_iast: asiddhir vānyadeśatvāt pradhānavaiguṇyād avaiguṇye prasaṅgaḥ syāt /
meaning: असिद्धिर् वान्यदेशत्वात् प्रधानवैगुण्याद् अवैगुण्ये प्रसङ्गः स्यात् /
text_mt: [Siddhānta:] Not accomplished [by them], or rather, because of difference in place; because of defect in the principal rite; only if there were no defect would there be incidental application.
And their being harnessed [is distinct] because of difference of time.
And the Vedic recitations [are distinct] because of direct physical connection.
Because its purpose is maintenance [of the fires], adding fuel to the fires does not exist in the Soma sacrifice.
Likewise the vow [of fasting does not exist], because it has passed away.
And the [action] prior to the animal sacrifice is for the sake of the Soma cups, because it serves their purpose.

sanskrit_iast: śeṣavad iti cen na vaiśvadevo hi syād vyapadeśāt /
meaning: शेषवद् इति चेन् न वैश्वदेवो हि स्याद् व्यपदेशात् /
text_mt: If it be said: like the remainder [of an action]; no, for it would be the Vaiśvadeva [cup], because of specific designation.
And the girding [of the wife is not repeated], because it has already occurred.

sanskrit_iast: anyavidhānād āraṇyabhojanaṃ na syād ubhayaṃ hi vṛttyartham /
meaning: अन्यविधानाद् आरण्यभोजनं न स्याद् उभयं हि वृत्त्यर्थम् /
text_mt: Because another [subsidiary] is prescribed, the eating of wild produce should not occur, for both serve the purpose of subsistence.
If it be said that the consumptions of the remainder are likewise; no, because they serve a different purpose.
And the hiring [of priests does not apply again] because they are already retained.
If it be said that the consumptions of the remainder are likewise;

sanskrit_iast: pravṛttavaraṇāt prati tantravaraṇāt pratitantravaraṇaṃ hotuḥ kriyeta /
meaning: प्रवृत्तवरणात् प्रति तन्त्रवरणात् प्रतितन्त्रवरणं होतुः क्रियेत /
text_mt: [Purvapakṣa:] From the choosing [of priests] in progress, a separate choosing per central procedure should be made for the Hotṛ priest.
No, because of the prior restriction, for [he was chosen] for that purpose.
When there is an instruction for the production of the sacrifice, because of differences in the performance of the completed rites, it should be done per central procedure.
Because of difference in place, the Vedic recitation turns away [from incidental application].
If it be said that the girding and the carrying are likewise;
[Purvapakṣa:] The sacrificial fire-ground should accomplish the purpose of worldly [actions], because of its capacity.
And the prohibition against cooking meat is likewise [an indicator].
[Siddhānta:] Or rather, because of specific designation, it should belong [only] to Vedic [actions].
And because worship is seen to occur when [the fire] is present.
The cooking of meat is a prohibition of what is enjoined, because of connection with an oblation.
Or [the prohibition of meat-cooking] in the southern fire is a supplementary statement to the uncontextualized injunction.

sanskrit_iast: savanīye chidrāpidhānārthatvāt paśupuroḍāśo na syād anyeṣām evam arthatvāt /
meaning: सवनीये छिद्रापिधानार्थत्वात् पशुपुरोडाशो न स्याद् अन्येषाम् एवम् अर्थत्वात् /
text_mt: [Purvapakṣa:] Because the purpose is covering defects at the pressing rites, the animal cake should not be offered, because other [offerings] serve that purpose.
[Siddhānta:] Or rather, it is an action [to be performed], because it serves the purpose of the recipient deity.

sanskrit_iast: haviṣkṛt savanīyeṣu na syāt prakṛtau yadi sarvārthā paśuṃ pratyāhūtā sā kuryād vidyamānatvāt /
meaning: हविष्कृत् सवनीयेषु न स्यात् प्रकृतौ यदि सर्वार्था पशुं प्रत्याहूता सा कुर्याद् विद्यमानत्वात् /
text_mt: [Purvapakṣa:] The 'oblation-maker' [call] should not occur at the Savanīya cakes; if in the base paradigm it serves all purposes, being called with reference to the animal, it would perform [both], because it is already available.
[Siddhānta:] But because it is prescribed when the animal has already been prepared;

sanskrit_iast: yogād vā yajñāya tadvimoke visargaḥ syāt /
meaning: योगाद् वा यज्ञाय तद्विमोके विसर्गः स्यात् /
text_mt: Or because of employment for the sacrifice, there should be dismissal at the completion of that.
In the night sacrifice, the archetypal [procedure] should not operate, because [the night rites are] directly taught.
And because of differences in time and syntactical statement, there should be a split of the central procedure.
The vow of digging up the altar would be the very same, because of incompatibility.
Or, because of injunction in the middle of the central procedure, it shares that central procedure, like the Savanīya cakes.

sanskrit_iast: vaiguṇyād idhmabarhir na sādhayed agnyanvādhānaṃ ca yadi devatārtham /
meaning: वैगुण्याद् इध्मबर्हिर् न साधयेद् अग्न्यन्वाधानं च यदि देवतार्थम् /
text_mt:
Because of defect, [the prior preparation of] firewood and sacred grass would not accomplish [the subsequent purpose]; and [likewise] adding fuel to the fire, if it serves the purpose of the deity.

And adding fuel to the fire, if it serves the purpose of the deity.

sanskrit_iast: ārambhaṇīyā vikṛtau na syāt prakṛtikālamadhyatvāt kṛtā punas tadarthena /
meaning: आरम्भणीया विकृतौ न स्यात् प्रकृतिकालमध्यत्वात् कृता पुनस् तदर्थेन /
text_mt: [Purvapakṣa:] The introductory offering should not occur in an ectypal sacrifice, because it falls within the time of the base paradigm, having already been performed for that purpose.
Because of connection with a single commencement.
[Siddhānta:] Or rather, it should take place, because the time [of the ectypal rite] is not a remainder [of the base paradigm].
In the concurrence of conflicting ritual details, those belonging to the majority should prevail.
Or rather, the principal rite [should determine the properties], because of its prior injunctive rule, as in common life.
And so there is textual indication of another purpose.
And because, in the conflict between a subsidiary element and a secondary detail, [the subsidiary prevails] since the latter is for its sake.
Because the enclosing-stick has a dual purpose, it should have the properties of both.
However, in case of conflict, those of the sacrificial post should prevail, due to its proximity to the principal rite.

sanskrit_iast: itaro vā tasya tatra vidhānād ubhayoś cāṅgasaṃyogaḥ /
meaning: इतरो वा तस्य तत्र विधानाद् उभयोश् चाङ्गसंयोगः /
text_mt: Or rather, the other [set of properties belongs to it], because it is enjoined in that respect, and both have connection as subsidiary elements.

sanskrit_iast: paśusavanīyeṣu vikalpaḥ syād vaikṛtaś ced ubhayor aśrutibhūtatvāt /
meaning: पशुसवनीयेषु विकल्पः स्याद् वैकृतश् चेद् उभयोर् अश्रुतिभूतत्वात् /
text_mt: In the case of the animal and savanīya offerings, there should be an option if [the rite] is ectypal, because neither is directly stated in scriptural text [as principal].

sanskrit_iast: pāśukaṃ vā tasya vaiśeṣikāmnānāt tadanarthakaṃ vikalpe syāt /
meaning: पाशुकं वा तस्य वैशेषिकाम्नानात् तदनर्थकं विकल्पे स्यात् /
text_mt: Or rather, the animal-offering [procedure should govern], because of the mention of its specific rules; under an option, that would be purposeless.
And because of the distance of the animal rite, its injunction being situated in the middle of the procedure.

sanskrit_iast: apūrvaṃ ca prakṛtau samānatantrā ced anityatvād anarthakaṃ hi syāt /
meaning: अपूर्वं च प्रकृतौ समानतन्त्रा चेद् अनित्यत्वाद् अनर्थकं हि स्यात् /
text_mt: And the transcendental potency is in the archetypal sacrifice; if they share the same common procedure, it would indeed be purposeless, because of its non-permanence.

sanskrit_iast: adhikaś ca guṇaḥ sādhāraṇe 'virodhāt kāṃsyabhojivad amukhye 'pi /
meaning: अधिकश् च गुणः साधारणे ऽविरोधात् कांस्यभोजिवद् अमुख्ये ऽपि /
text_mt: And an additional secondary quality [applies] in a common framework without conflict, even to the non-principal, like one eating from a bronze vessel.

sanskrit_iast: tatpravṛttyā tu tantrasya niyamaḥ syād yathā pāśukaṃ sūktapākena /
meaning: तत्प्रवृत्त्या तु तन्त्रस्य नियमः स्याद् यथा पाशुकं सूक्तपाकेन /
text_mt: However, by its commencement, there should be a restrictive injunction of the procedure, as the animal rite by the Sūktavāka offering.
And because it is not characterized by scriptural injunction.

sanskrit_iast: viśvajiti vatsatvaṅnāmadheyād itarathā tantrabhūyastvād ahataṃ syāt /
meaning: विश्वजिति वत्सत्वङ्नामधेयाद् इतरथा तन्त्रभूयस्त्वाद् अहतं स्यात् /
text_mt: In the Viśvajit, because of the name 'calf-skin' [there is a specific garment]; otherwise, due to the predominance of the common procedure, an unwashed [garment] would be used.
Or it is not conflicting, for the calf-skin is an upper garment.

sanskrit_iast: anunirvāpyeṣu bhūyastvena tantraniyamaḥ syāc chviṣṭhakṛddarśanāc ca /
meaning: अनुनिर्वाप्येषु भूयस्त्वेन तन्त्रनियमः स्याच् छ्विष्ठकृद्दर्शनाच् च /
text_mt: In the supplementary offerings, the determination of the procedure should be by the majority, and because of the observation of the Sviṣṭakṛt offering.

sanskrit_iast: āgantukatvād vā svadharmā syāc chrutiviśeṣād itarasya ca mukhyatvāt /
meaning: आगन्तुकत्वाद् वा स्वधर्मा स्याच् छ्रुतिविशेषाद् इतरस्य च मुख्यत्वात् /
text_mt: Or rather, because it is an adventitious rite, it should have its own properties, due to specific direct scriptural statement and because the other is primary.
If it is argued that it is not so because of the cooking for the Sviṣṭakṛt, [we say:] there is a modification, as in the Pavamāna offerings.

sanskrit_iast: avikāro vā prakṛtivac codanāṃ prati bhāvāc ca /
meaning: अविकारो वा प्रकृतिवच् चोदनां प्रति भावाच् च /
text_mt: Or rather, there is no modification, as in the archetypal sacrifice, and because of existence with respect to the injunctive rule.

sanskrit_iast: eka karmaṇi śiṣṭatvād guṇānāṃ sarvakarma syāt /
meaning: एक कर्मणि शिष्टत्वाद् गुणानां सर्वकर्म स्यात् /
text_mt: Because they are taught in connection with a single action, all secondary qualities should apply to every action.

sanskrit_iast: ekārthās tu vikalperan samuccaye hy āvṛttiḥ syāt pradhānasya /
meaning: एकार्थास् तु विकल्पेरन् समुच्चये ह्य् आवृत्तिः स्यात् प्रधानस्य /
text_mt: However, those having the same purpose should be optional; for in conjunction there would be repetition of the principal rite.
If it be objected that [the rite] should be repeated because of [each item's] utility;

sanskrit_iast: nāśrutatvād dhi vikalpavac ca darśayati kālāntare 'rthavattvaṃ syāt /
meaning: नाश्रुतत्वाद् धि विकल्पवच् च दर्शयति कालान्तरे ऽर्थवत्त्वं स्यात् /
text_mt:
And [scripture] shows [it] to be like an option.

[It] would have purpose at a different time.

sanskrit_iast: prāyaścitteṣu caikārthyān niṣpannenābhisaṃyogas tasmāt sarvasya nirghātaḥ /
meaning: प्रायश्चित्तेषु चैकार्थ्यान् निष्पन्नेनाभिसंयोगस् तस्मात् सर्वस्य निर्घातः /
text_mt: And in expiatory rites, because of having the same purpose, there is connection with what has occurred; therefore, all [sin] is eliminated.
Conjunction, however, is for the sake of [various] faults.

sanskrit_iast: mantrāṇāṃ karmasaṃyogaḥ svadharmeṇa prayogaḥ syād dharmasya tannimittatvāt /
meaning: मन्त्राणां कर्मसंयोगः स्वधर्मेण प्रयोगः स्याद् धर्मस्य तन्निमित्तत्वात् /
text_mt: The connection of mantras with ritual action should be a performance according to their own properties, because the property is occasioned by that.

sanskrit_iast: vidyāṃpratividhinād vā sarvakāraṇaṃ prayogaḥ syāt karmārthatvāt prayogasya /
meaning: विद्यांप्रतिविधिनाद् वा सर्वकारणं प्रयोगः स्यात् कर्मार्थत्वात् प्रयोगस्य /
text_mt: Or rather, because the performance is for the sake of the action, the performance should have all causes according to the injunctive rule of each discipline.
Because of the instruction on accent and speech, there is prohibition of the prevailing recitation, as in the case of the aira chant.

sanskrit_iast: mantropadeśo vā na bhāṣikasya prāyopapatter bhāṣikaśrutiḥ /
meaning: मन्त्रोपदेशो वा न भाषिकस्य प्रायोपपत्तेर् भाषिकश्रुतिः /
text_mt: Or rather, it is the instruction of the mantra; the direct scriptural text on recitation does not belong to the prose commentary, because prevailing usage applies.

meaning: विकारः कारणाग्रहणे तन्न्यायत्वाद् दृष्टे ऽप्य् एवम् /
text_mt: When no cause is perceived, modification follows that principle; even when [a reason] is seen, it is so.
Or because of its arising from that, since it is characterized by the oral teaching.

sanskrit_iast: mantrāṇāṃ karaṇārthatvān mantrāntena karmādisannipātaḥ syāt sarvasya vacanārthatvāt /
meaning: मन्त्राणां करणार्थत्वान् मन्त्रान्तेन कर्मादिसन्निपातः स्यात् सर्वस्य वचनार्थत्वात् /
text_mt: Because mantras are meant to be instruments, the end of the mantra should coincide with the beginning of the action, because everything is meant for expression.
Because of the prescription of continuity, there is conjunction with the beginning in a continuous stream.
Or rather, there is continuity of action, because of the variety of actions and because the other is impossible.
And in the case of the Āghāra libation, because of the long stream.
Because mantras are directly contributing, those having a single purpose should be alternative.
In the case of those enjoined with a number, there is conjunction, because they are not directly contributing [individually to distinct actions].
And in the case of those enjoined by Brāhmaṇa passages, all are instructed like those having a number.
And the observation of the conjunction of the offering-verse and the Vaṣaṭ-call is like that.
Or rather, there should be an option, because conjunction is not directly stated in scriptural text.
Because the instruction is for the sake of a secondary quality.

sanskrit_iast: vaṣaṭkāre nānārthatvāt samuccayo hautrās tu vikalperann ekārthatvāt /
meaning: वषट्कारे नानार्थत्वात् समुच्चयो हौत्रास् तु विकल्पेरन्न् एकार्थत्वात् /
text_mt: In the Vaṣaṭ-call, because of distinct purposes, there is conjunction; but the duties of the Hotṛ should be optional, because of having a single purpose.
Or rather, there is conjunction of the duties of the Hotṛ, because they reiterate what is being performed.
And [scripture] shows conjunction.

sanskrit_iast: japāś cākarmasaṃyuktāḥ stutyāśīrabhidhānāś ca yājamāneṣu samuccayaḥ syād āśīḥpṛthaktvāt /
meaning: जपाश् चाकर्मसंयुक्ताः स्तुत्याशीरभिधानाश् च याजमानेषु समुच्चयः स्याद् आशीःपृथक्त्वात् /
text_mt: And whispered prayers not connected with an action, expressing praise and benediction among the duties of the sacrificer, should be in conjunction, because of the distinctness of benedictions.
And [scripture] shows conjunction.
However, among offering-verses and introductory verses, there should be an option, because their purpose is the indication of the recipient deity.
In purchase substances, however, there should be an option, because of having a single purpose.
Or rather, there is conjunction, because of the co-presence of the substances of performance.
And [scripture] shows conjunction.
And in preparatory purification, because that is primary.
However, among numbers there should be an option, because of direct scriptural prohibition.

sanskrit_iast: dravyavikārāt tu pūrvavad arthakarma syāt tayā vikalpena niyamapradhānatvāt /
meaning: द्रव्यविकारात् तु पूर्ववद् अर्थकर्म स्यात् तया विकल्पेन नियमप्रधानत्वात् /
text_mt: But due to modification of the substance, there should be a primary functional action as before, because it is primary in restrictive injunction through option with it.

sanskrit_iast: dravyatve 'pi samuccayo dravyasya karmaniṣpatteḥ pratipaśukarmabhedād evaṃ sati yathāprakṛti /
meaning: द्रव्यत्वे ऽपि समुच्चयो द्रव्यस्य कर्मनिष्पत्तेः प्रतिपशुकर्मभेदाद् एवं सति यथाप्रकृति /
text_mt: Even when being a substance, there is conjunction, because the action is accomplished by the substance; because of the difference of actions for each animal, it is thus according to the archetypal sacrifice.
No, because the action is for the sake of another.
The disposal rite, however, [applies to each], because of being a remainder.

sanskrit_iast: vikalpyo 'nvarthakarmaniyamapradhānatvāc chese ca karmakāryasamavāyāt tasamāt tenārthakarma syāt /
meaning: विकल्प्यो ऽन्वर्थकर्मनियमप्रधानत्वाच् छेसे च कर्मकार्यसमवायात् तसमात् तेनार्थकर्म स्यात् /
text_mt: Because it is optional, because of the primacy of the restrictive injunction for a primary functional action, and because the function of the rite inheres in the remainder; therefore, through it there would be a primary functional action.

sanskrit_iast:
ukhāyāṃ kāmyanityasamuccayo niyoge kāmadarśanāt /
asati cāsaṃskṛteṣu karma syāt /
meaning:
उखायां काम्यनित्यसमुच्चयो नियोगे कामदर्शनात् /
असति चासंस्कृतेषु कर्म स्यात् /
text_mt:
In [the case of] the ukhā pot, there is cumulative application of the optional and the obligatory, because the desire is seen in the prescription.

And when it is absent, the rite would apply to unconsecrated [materials].
And because it serves the purpose of the recipient deity.
Or rather, there is a modification of the obligatory fire by the optional one, for the reason stated.
By explicit statement, the rite would take place in unconsecrated [fires].
And in the case of commingling, there would be a fault.

sanskrit_iast: vacanād iti ced athetarasminn utsargāparigrahaḥ karmaṇaḥ kṛtatvāt /
meaning: वचनाद् इति चेद् अथेतरस्मिन्न् उत्सर्गापरिग्रहः कर्मणः कृतत्वात् /
text_mt: If it is said: '[It is] on account of explicit statement,' [we say:] then, in the other case, there is abandonment and non-acceptance, because the action has already been performed.
That would be the Āhavanīya fire, because of connection with the oblation.
Or it is another, because of fetching after taking [it] out; in that [fire] the consecratory action [takes place], because it is taught [by scripture].
On account of the place, however, they would be omitted.

sanskrit_iast: nityādhāraṇe vikalpo na hy akasmāt pratiṣedhaḥ syāt /
meaning: नित्याधारणे विकल्पो न ह्य् अकस्मात् प्रतिषेधः स्यात् /
text_mt: There is an option regarding the perpetual maintenance [of fire]; for a negative prohibition would not arise without cause.
Or rather, there is a negative prohibition of perpetual maintenance [of fire] for one who has attained prosperity.

meaning: परार्थान्य् एकः प्रतियन्तिवत् सत्राहीनयो यजमानगणे ऽनियमो ऽविशेषात् /
text_mt: One [sacrificer performs actions] that serve another's purpose, as in the case of the Pratiprasthātṛ; in the group of sacrificers in a sacrificial session and a multi-day sacrifice, there is no restriction, because there is no distinction.
Or rather, [it is performed by] the principal [sacrificer], because there is no conflict.

sanskrit_iast: satre gṛhapatir asaṃyogād dhautravad āmnāyavacanāc ca /
meaning: सत्रे गृहपतिर् असंयोगाद् धौत्रवद् आम्नायवचनाच् च /
text_mt: In a sacrificial session, the householder [performs it], because of non-connection [with others], as in the case of the Hotṛ's function, and because of scriptural statement.
Or rather, by all, because it serves that purpose.
Because of capacity, the office of officiating priest would belong to all social classes.
Or rather, by virtue of traditional recollection, it would belong to Brāhmaṇas.
And because the cup of fruit-juice is prescribed for the others.
Even with regard to the curd-and-milk oblation, there is a similar negative prohibition, because of being the cause of Soma-drinking.
And on account of the designation in the division into four parts.
